data.name: Arrow Fun Time
data.description_full:
Arrow Fun Time is a relaxing, brain-training logic puzzle game. Featuring simple controls and strategic gameplay, it delivers fun and challenging puzzle experiences for all players.
How to Play
The grid is filled with four-directional arrows that only fly straight along their pointing path. Carefully observe the arrow layout and find the correct tapping order. Tap an arrow with an unblocked path, and it will fly out and disappear from the grid.
Plan your every move in advance. Tapping a blocked arrow will fail your move. Sort out the elimination sequence step by step and clear all arrows to complete each level.
Game Features
Super Simple Operation
One-tap gameplay with no learning curve. Jump into puzzle challenges instantly for players of all ages.
Gradual Difficulty Levels
Hundreds of well-designed levels with progressive difficulty. From easy casual rounds to complex logic challenges, constantly train your thinking ability.
Great Clearing Satisfaction
Smooth animations and comfortable level rhythm bring fulfilling clearing moments, helping you relax and sharpen your observation skills.
Mild Reward System
Finish levels and daily tasks to earn nice bonus rewards. Enjoy puzzle fun while gaining casual extra benefits.
Game Highlights
A thoughtful logic puzzle instead of mindless casual games. It exercises your brain, relieves stress and kills spare time. We will keep updating new levels to bring you lasting fresh gameplay.
data.description_short: Tap & clear arrows in order, solve logic levels and get gentle rewards!

BotRaid delivers an engaging idle strategy experience where automated robot combat meets endless tactical expansion. Prepare for continuous war as you deploy your mechanical legion, seize enemy cores, and grow your empire without interruption, ensuring your current period of domination continues.

Command Your Robot Horde

• Deploy a diverse array of automated robots to crush enemy defenses and expand your territory with minimal oversight.
• Watch your custom-built units clash in real-time, adapting your forces on the fly to secure victory.
• Add new units directly to the battlefield as combat rages, influencing the tide of war instantly.

Conquer Cores, Grow Your Arsenal

• Seize enemy cores to instantly boost your gold and material income, fueling your war machine.
• Expand your deployment capacity with every core captured, gaining 8 new spaces for powerful robot units.
• Push deep into hostile territory, turning enemy infrastructure into your own resource-generating assets.

Uninterrupted Robot War

• Dive into a continuous combat loop with no tedious build phases, battle phases, or start buttons
Tired of manually managing every move? BotRaid excels as an idle strategy game where the war never stops.
• Experience constant action as new platforms dock every 45 seconds, bringing fresh challenges and opportunities.
• Call in the next hostile platform early when you're ready for more action, keeping the strategy flowing.

Craft & Evolve Your Machines

• Collect valuable parts from destroyed enemy robots, using them to craft entirely new units and expand your chassis library.
• Upgrade your existing chassis types with salvaged components, enhancing their power, defense, and unique abilities.
• Assemble an unstoppable army by strategically breaking down foes and rebuilding stronger, smarter bots.

Master Over 50 Chassis Types

• Discover and deploy over 50 unique robot chassis, each with distinct abilities and tactical roles on the battlefield.
• From arcing mortars and grappling units to self-sacrificing kamikazes and essential repair bots, strategic thinking is key.
• Adapt your robot composition to counter any foe, ensuring your army is always one step ahead in the automated combat.

Strategic Grid Expansion

BotRaid redefines idle strategy by placing your war on an ever-expanding grid map where every platform is up for grabs. Your home base is impregnable, but the rest of the world is a dynamic battlefield, constantly shifting and evolving with each engagement. This provides hours before new challenges arise, keeping the game fresh.

Adaptive Tactics for Victory

Mastering BotRaid's idle strategy requires constant adaptation. The units you encounter on the battlefield directly influence the parts you collect and the robots you can build, pushing you to evolve your army and deploy clever tactics against ever-tougher adversaries.

Advanced Combat Features

• Engage with an intuitive interface that makes managing your robot army simple and effective.
• Benefit from a game design that rewards clever unit combinations and timely upgrades.
• Enjoy strategic depth without complex controls, allowing you to focus on the fun of conquest.

Designed for strategy enthusiasts who crave deep tactical gameplay without constant micromanagement, BotRaid brings robot war to your fingertips. Whether you prefer a quick skirmish or a long-term campaign, this game offers an unparalleled experience.

Welcome to Idletopia: Farm & Merge, a cozy farm tycoon adventure where cute animal friends, relaxing merge gameplay, and charming town building come together.

This game showcases idle gameplay with clicker mechanics in a farm world.

Start with a small farm and grow it into a lively farm town full of adorable residents, useful buildings, and exciting new opportunities. Plant and harvest crops, gather resources, merge helpful items, and expand your land step by step. Every improvement helps your world become more productive, more beautiful, and more full of life.

In Idletopia: Farm & Merge, you are not only farming — you are building your own cheerful farm tycoon world. Develop your town, unlock new areas, improve production, and create a cozy settlement where animal characters can live, work, and thrive. From simple farm buildings to busy town locations, each new place adds more charm and more ways to grow.

Merge items to unlock upgrades, improve efficiency, and support the development of your farm. As your progress continues, your town becomes stronger, richer, and more lively. The game combines relaxing farming, satisfying merge mechanics, and light tycoon progression in one warm and rewarding experience.

Collect hero cards and meet lovable animal characters who bring useful bonuses and special charm to your journey. Each hero helps your farm grow faster and makes your town feel more alive. Discover friendly faces, sweet stories, and memorable moments as your community expands.

Trade resources, improve your economy, and build your dream farm town at your own pace. Whether you enjoy managing production, collecting heroes, merging items, or simply watching your world grow, Idletopia: Farm & Merge offers a comforting and enjoyable adventure.

If you enjoy farm tycoon games, merge games, and charming town building adventures, Idletopia: Farm & Merge is the perfect place to create your dream village

どうしても隠れた文字が見つからない？そんな時も大丈夫！ゲーム内には実用的な「ヒント」機能を搭載。思考がハチ切れそうな時、あなたの盲点をそっと突いて、流れるようなプレイ体験をサポートします。

👥 こんな方にオススメ！
文字パズルや言葉遊び（クロスワード、ナンクロなど）が大好きな方。

通勤・通学、ちょっとしたスキマ時間に、心地よく脳を動かしたいビジネスパーソンや学生。

観察力を鍛え、大人の脳トレを楽しみながら、日本語の線の美しさを再発見したいすべての方。

一筆一画に驚きがあり、一字の中に新しい世界が広がる。
今すぐ『文字の中に文字！』をダウンロードして、文字の奥深さを探求する知的な冒険へ出かけましょう！

data.description_full:
Tam Quốc băng giá, chơi cực chill, thắng cực đã!
Một đợt hàn lưu quét qua Tam Quốc, tiểu Trinh – mỹ nữ lưu dân đang xoa tay hà hơi nhìn Chúa Công…
Hãy nhóm lửa trại lên trước, gọi anh em cùng chặt cây, xây dựng gia viên! Có tiểu Trinh ở đây, chắc chắn sẽ giúp Chúa Công chơi Tam Quốc chill nhẹ nhàng, nằm không cũng thắng!
[Cứu giúp lưu dân, nhóm lửa Chill ấm lòng]
Lưu dân biến thành đội ngũ lao động siêu đỉnh! Hệ thống Dân tâm giúp bạn quản lý công việc chỉ với một cú click, phân công nhiệm vụ hợp lý. Giải quyết các sự kiện dân cư để tăng Dân tâm, mở khóa kỹ năng dân tâm, nâng cao hiệu quả xây dựng và sản xuất gia viên!
[Bạn bè làm việc, anh em chăm chỉ Chill hết mình]
Hệ thống bạn bè cư trú độc đáo – Chúa Công mau gọi anh em vào thành! Tăng độ thân mật qua các tương tác hằng ngày để tăng hiệu suất làm việc của bạn bè!
[Thu thập tài nguyên, xây thành trực chiến Chill nhẹ nhàng]
Chặt cây, khai khoáng, săn bắn để thu về các loại tài nguyên. Dùng tài nguyên nâng cấp lò sưởi, xây nhà, doanh trại... Mở rộng lãnh thổ, chiêu binh mãi mã, gia tăng chiến lực để luôn sẵn sàng tác chiến!
[Cách chơi thư giãn, khám phá Tam Quốc Chill thú vị]
Hàng loạt mini-game giải trí lần lượt ra mắt! Điền Kỵ Tái Mã thể hiện mưu lược, hộ tống cướp tiêu mở rộng tuyến đường tài nguyên, tất cả mang đến trải nghiệm Tam Quốc nhập vai mới lạ cho Chúa Công!
[Thách đấu BOSS, tổ đội tướng Chill uy mãnh]
Đăng nhập 7 ngày nhận ngay tướng SSR siêu mạnh Điêu Thuyền, Quách Gia!
Tăng cấp Tướng cực nhàn – toàn đội chia sẻ cấp độ, không lo phân bổ tài nguyên!
Dễ dàng lập đội hình mạnh mẽ, kích hoạt chế độ tự động tập kết, sẵn sàng tấn công BOSS thế giới mọi lúc – kể cả khi offline vẫn thu về tài nguyên đều đều!
[Mở rộng lãnh thổ, chinh phục thiên hạ Chill cực dễ]
Liên minh công thành được miễn phí trị liệu thương binh chỉ với một cú click! Kể cả khi offline cũng có thể ủy thác đội quân cho đồng minh trông nom! Chinh phục thiên hạ chưa bao giờ dễ đến thế! Mau rủ các Thành Chủ chí hướng tương đồng lập bang, mở rộng thế lực, hướng đến ngôi vương châu Á, thống trị Tam Quốc!

data.name: 永夜幻想：契約之戰
data.description_full:
《永幕幻想：契約之戰》是一款哥特美少女放置卡牌 RPG。

暗夜降臨，契約者覺醒。以中世紀歐洲幻想世界為背景，光與暗的戰爭再次展開，神秘古老的城堡、被黑霧籠罩的聖域、隱藏真相的禁忌遺跡，都等待你親自探索。你將扮演被命運選中的契約者，穿梭於不同陣營之間，召喚風格各異的美少女夥伴，組建專屬光暗戰隊，揭開永幕世界背後的黑暗真相。

【暗夜降臨，契約者覺醒】
在這片被永夜籠罩的幻想大陸上，光明與黑暗長久對立，各大勢力因信仰、血脈與契約而彼此牽引。作為契約者，你不只是旁觀者，而是能改變戰局的關鍵存在。與少女們締結契約，理解她們的過去、信念與使命，帶領她們穿越戰火與迷霧，在哥特暗黑世界中尋找屬於自己的答案。

【哥特美少女，集結你的夢幻隊伍】
高冷御姊、神秘魔女、聖潔修女、暗夜少女、戰場女武神等多種角色陸續登場。每位美少女角色都擁有獨特形象、陣營定位、技能特色與戰鬥風格。你可以依照喜好收集角色，也能根據戰鬥需求培養核心英雄，打造屬於自己的最強美少女戰隊。無論你喜歡二次元美少女、暗黑幻想角色、哥特風立繪，還是策略卡牌養成，都能在這場契約之戰中找到心動的夥伴。

【策略卡牌 x 放置掛機】
《永幕幻想：契約之戰》結合策略卡牌、放置養成、九宮格站位與自動戰鬥。戰鬥不只是比拼數值，更考驗陣容搭配、角色定位、技能連動與站位安排。前排承傷、後排輸出、輔助治療、控制牽制、爆發收割，每一個角色都能在不同隊伍中發揮價值。透過合理搭配光暗陣營、職業技能與英雄羈絆，即使面對強大首領與競技場對手，也有機會逆轉戰局。

【九宮格站位，打造你的戰鬥流派】
自由調整九宮格站位，讓坦克守護核心輸出，讓控制角色搶先出手，讓爆發英雄在關鍵時刻釋放必殺技。不同敵人、不同副本、不同競技場陣容，都需要不同策略應對。你可以組建穩定推圖隊、爆發速攻隊、持久續戰隊、控制反擊隊，也能依照喜愛角色打造專屬流派。策略卡牌 RPG 的樂趣，就在於每一次編隊都有新的可能。

【放置收益，離線也能成長】
沒有時間長時間刷關，也能輕鬆享受養成樂趣。遊戲提供放置收益、掛機資源、自動戰鬥與多種減負設計，讓角色在你離線時也能持續累積成長資源。登入即可領取收益，培養英雄、強化裝備、提升戰力，輕鬆推進主線副本與活動挑戰。無論是休閒玩家、上班族玩家，還是喜歡慢慢培養角色的二次元 RPG 玩家，都能依照自己的節奏享受冒險。

【開服豐富福利，召喚不停歇】
開服期間準備了多重福利，登入即可領取高級十連抽，召喚券、養成道具、裝備資源與成長獎勵持續解鎖。完成主線關卡、每日任務、簽到活動與限時挑戰，還有機會獲得 SSR+ 英雄與稀有資源。新手玩家也能快速建立核心陣容，輕鬆體驗角色收集、卡牌養成與策略戰鬥的爽快感。
※ 實際獎勵內容、活動時間與領取條件，請以遊戲內公告為準。

【無課也能爽快養成】
在《永幕幻想：契約之戰》中，角色成長來源豐富，日常任務、放置收益、副本挑戰、活動玩法與登入獎勵都能穩定提供養成資源。即使不追求高強度付費，也能透過時間累積與策略搭配逐步提升隊伍實力。收集喜愛角色、培養核心英雄、調整陣容站位，用你的策略帶領少女們突破重重黑暗。

【華麗暗黑美學，沉浸式幻想冒險】
哥特美學、暗黑角色立繪、精美場景與華麗技能演出，共同構築出神秘浪漫的永幕世界。從中世紀歐洲風格建築，到被詛咒的古老戰場；從幽暗城堡，到光暗交會的聖殿，每一處場景都呈現濃厚的幻想氛圍。搭配沉浸式劇情與角色故事，讓你在戰鬥之外，也能感受世界觀、陣營衝突與少女們背後的命運牽絆。

【副本挑戰，探索永幕真相】
主線副本、資源關卡、首領挑戰、限時活動等多樣玩法，帶來持續成長目標。你將跟隨劇情推進，逐步揭開黑暗降臨的真相，挑戰更強大的敵人，解鎖更多角色與養成內容。每一次通關都是隊伍實力的證明，每一次失敗也能透過調整站位、強化裝備與更換陣容找到突破口。

【PVP競技場，策略決定勝負】
想驗證你的隊伍強度？進入 PVP 競技場，與其他契約者展開策略對決。競技場不只看戰力數字，更考驗角色組合、技能克制、出手順序與站位判斷。面對不同流派的對手，靈活調整陣容，讓你的哥特美少女戰隊在競技場中脫穎而出，贏得榮耀與獎勵。

【角色養成，打造專屬戰隊】
培養英雄、提升等級、強化裝備、突破能力、搭配技能，逐步打造你的核心陣容。不同角色可在主線推圖、首領挑戰、活動副本與 PVP 競技中發揮不同作用。喜歡收集的玩家可以追求角色圖鑑，喜歡策略的玩家可以研究陣營搭配，喜歡養成的玩家可以專注提升戰力，讓每位少女都成為戰隊中不可或缺的力量。

【光暗陣營，命運交錯】
光明、黑暗與各大勢力彼此對立又互相牽引。不同陣營角色擁有各自特色與戰鬥定位，透過合理配置陣容，可觸發更強大的戰鬥效果。選擇你信任的夥伴，締結契約，面對即將吞噬世界的黑暗。這不只是一次冒險，更是一場關於命運、羈絆與選擇的契約之戰。

【輕鬆上手，深度可玩】
簡單操作、快速戰鬥、放置掛機，讓新手玩家能輕鬆進入遊戲；而陣容搭配、九宮格站位、角色養成、技能組合與 PVP 策略，又提供了足夠深入的研究空間。無論你是二次元美少女遊戲玩家、放置卡牌 RPG 愛好者、策略養成玩家，還是喜歡暗黑幻想世界觀的冒險者，都能在《永幕幻想：契約之戰》中找到自己的玩法。

【現在締結契約，開啟永幕之戰】
暗夜已至，命運的契約正在等待回應。召喚哥特美少女夥伴，組建光暗戰隊，挑戰副本、首領與競技場，在放置掛機中輕鬆養成，在策略卡牌戰鬥中逆轉勝負。現在加入《永幕幻想：契約之戰》，成為契約者，揭開永幕世界的真相，開啟屬於你的暗黑幻想冒險！

data.name: Code Word
data.description_full:
Solve clever word clues, guess words, and complete phrases while giving your brain and logic a fun daily workout with Code Word!

Code Word is a smart and satisfying puzzle game where every answer helps unlock the next. Solve clues, guess words, match numbers to letters, and complete the message at the top of the board. It combines the familiar feel of a crossword with the discovery of a word puzzle, creating a challenge that keeps your brain active and rewards clear logic.
Each level gives you several clues and partially completed answers. Use the clues to guess words, enter the missing letters, and follow the matching numbers across the board. Every correct answer helps you decode letters in other places, making the next riddle easier to solve. The more you play, the more naturally your brain begins to spot patterns and use logic to connect every clue.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of word puzzle challenges to complete
• Clever number-to-letter matching that helps you decode letters
• Helpful hints when a difficult riddle slows you down
• A relaxing puzzle game that tests vocabulary, brain power, and logic
• Simple controls that make it easy to guess words anywhere
• Bright visuals, clear feedback, and easy-to-learn rules

HOW TO PLAY
• Read each clue and guess words that fit the available spaces.
• Enter letters to complete every crossword-style answer.
• Use matching numbers to decode letters across the board.
• Check the new letters and solve the next riddle.
• Complete all answers to finish the word puzzle.

Code Word is made for anyone who enjoys a clever word puzzle, a classic crossword, or a puzzle game built around steady discovery. Some clues test vocabulary, some challenge logic, and others ask you to think about a familiar riddle from a new angle. Every answer gives your brain another useful piece of the solution.

Play for a quick break or enjoy a longer solving session. As the board fills, it becomes easier to decode letters, understand each riddle, and see how every answer connects. The challenge feels fair, the progress feels rewarding, and every completed word puzzle gives you a satisfying sense of achievement.

Download Code Word and put your brain and logic to the test. Guess words, complete each puzzle, and enjoy a game where every letter matters.
data.description_short: Guess words, match letters, and solve clever word puzzles!

data.name: Spot & Shot: Hidden Hunt

Can you spot what others can't see? 🔍

Spot & Shot: Hidden Hunt is a brand-new hidden object puzzle game that puts your eyes to the ultimate test! Camouflaged stickmen are hiding in plain sight all around you, blending in between shelves, boxes and barrels in colorful warehouses, shops and rooms. • Spot the camouflaged stickmen blending into their surroundings

🧩 A NEW KIND OF HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE

• Dozens of unique levels with increasing challenge
• Satisfying "found it!" moments in every round

• Free to play!

Do you have the eagle eyes it takes? Some stickmen hide behind shelves, some blend into boxes, and some are right in front of you. You just haven't noticed them yet! 👀

data.name: Fantasy Life i
data.description_full:
From thrilling adventures to building up your own island, the anything-goes slow-life RPG comes to mobile!
Experience an epic story, explore a vast open world, or simply relax with fishing, cooking, and crafting.
Do what you want, whenever and wherever you like—all in the palm of your hand. Start your very own Fantasy Life!

■ Play Anytime on Your Smartphone
Whether you want to enjoy a laid-back life as a farmer and grow crops at your own pace, or simply run free across a vast landscape, your fantasy life is always waiting whenever you have a spare moment.
Cross-play support lets you play together with friends on both mobile devices and consoles!

■ Guided by a Dragon to a Mysterious Island
You are an adventurer who sets sail alongside the archaeologist Edward and his team.
Following the guiding light from a fossilized dragon, you discover an uncharted island.
The Depths, a mysterious skeletal dragon, and a message from a girl pleading, "Save this world..."
Travel between the island's golden age 1,000 years ago and the present day to uncover the mystery behind its destruction!

■ Shape Your Adventure with 14 Unique Lives
In this world, a Life is your chosen profession, and each Life has its own identity and playstyle.
Switch to a Gathering Life to gather ingredients and materials, a Crafting Life to create weapons and meals, or a Combat Life to battle monsters. Swap between Lives anytime and create a Fantasy Life that's uniquely yours.

■ Craft Your Island
Put your Lives to work and gather resources to restore the island to its former glory!
Place houses and objects, reshape the landscape, and even create your own rivers and roads to build an island that's truly one of a kind.
Expand your home, freely arrange furniture, and customize your interiors!

■ Embark on an Open-World Adventure!
Explore the largest continent in the series and venture wherever your heart takes you!
Climb towering cliffs, swim across rivers and lakes, or ride across the land on your favorite mount.
Oh, and the Teleportation Gate lets you easily travel to the continent from anywhere.

■ Continue Your Adventure Across Devices
Cross-save support lets you continue your adventure on your smartphone from your existing console save data.
Gather materials on the go with your smartphone, then switch back to your console at home for more in-depth crafting.
You can also enjoy multiplayer by inviting friends to your island or exploring dungeons together. How you play is entirely up to you.
*The 2P Family Co-op feature is not available in the mobile version.

data.name: Save My Home
data.description_full:
Save My Home is a relaxing room decoration puzzle game where you unpack items, match the reference design and turn empty spaces into cozy rooms.

Each level gives you an empty room and a completed reference image. Your goal is to unpack furniture, decorations and small room details, then place every item in the correct spot to recreate the room design. From sofas, beds and tables to books, plants, lamps and tiny decorative objects, every piece helps bring the room to life.

Save My Home is designed for players who enjoy interior design, organizing games, unpacking puzzles and relaxing home makeover experiences. The gameplay is simple, satisfying and easy to enjoy during short breaks or quiet moments.

Dash through four themed episodes filled with enemies, obstacles, collectibles, weapons, and powerups. Swipe left and right to move, swipe up to jump or double jump, and swipe down to slam onto enemies as you race away from increasingly difficult bosses.

Explore four original environments, each with its own boss:

• Bendy in Treasure Trouble — Dash across sandy islands, wooden docks, and pirate ships while Chester the treasure chest chases you through the tropics.

• Bendy in Death and Taxis — Race through city streets and tunnels to escape Gaskette, a taxi cab with a death wish ... yours.

Keep running and try to defeat the boss again and again, pushing your score higher until the nightmare finally consumes you.

MORE CARTOON CRAZINESS TO COME!

Get ready for endless mode, player profiles, leaderboards, new costumes, seasonal events, new episodes, new bosses and more!

A CARTOONY NIGHTMARE IN THE BENDY UNIVERSE

Bendy's Nightmare Run returns with its distinctive cartoon-themed runner gameplay, featuring Bendy, Boris, and Alice alongside original bosses and environments created specifically for Bendy's Nightmare Run.

data.name: Vice Throne
data.description_full:
On the surface, this city has towering skyscrapers, nonstop traffic, and bustling prosperity. But when night falls, the turf wars and rival factions quietly unfold beneath the surface. Each faction keeps a close eye on the throne of the underworld.

I've come back to where it all began, driven by the ambition to restore the family to its former glory and the determination to make a comeback.

In the rundown estate, the seat once occupied by the former boss has been vacant for a long time. Now, it has finally found its rightful owner.

Rebuild the Base, Restore the Family

After losing a strong leader to hold it together, the family became vulnerable to unwanted intruders. They seized the legacy left by the former leader and claimed the family's territory as their own.

First, we need to clean house, drive out every crew squatting around the estate and the surrounding neighborhoods, and get the family's business running again. Only then can we start planning for the long haul. Every block, dock, and racket that once belonged to the family, I'll take back one by one.

Spot the Opportunity, Make a Quick Buck

Cash and supplies are running low, putting our rebuilding efforts at risk. We need to get the family's trade network back up and running, fast.

Fortunately, we still control several lucrative businesses across the city. Make the rounds, and you may stumble upon a little "bonus." After all, some fortunes belong only to those who know when to seize an opportunity.

Build Your Inner Circle

The former boss left behind a loyal crew. While I was lying low, they fought tooth and nail to keep the family's legacy alive. But their strength alone won't be enough.

I'll use strategy, leverage, and whatever means necessary to bring the best people into the fold, then train them to reach their full potential. Knowing your people, putting them in the right roles, and making the most of their talents: that's what separates a true boss from the rest.

Train Your Crew, Become a Trusted Leader

Loyalty is the family's creed. Power is the only currency this city respects.

I'll build an elite crew that answers to me alone and lead them in swift, decisive operations. Every move we make will send the same message to anyone standing in my way: nothing will stop my rise to power.

Build a Worldwide Network and Find Reliable Allies

"Friendships come and go. Business is business." When our goals align, striking a deal with the city's other power players is easy enough.
"Just put the word out that we're looking for allies," and offers will come in from across the world. We coordinate operations, share resources, and trade intelligence. For now, we stand together.

Meet the City's Finest and Win Their Hearts

If luck is on my side, I'll cross paths with someone special. She won't care about my name or rank. All she wants is to stay by my side.
When she sends messages, asks me out, or opens her heart to me, I won't take her feelings for granted. A true boss knows how to hold on to power and win a heart.

Take on the World and Rise to the Top

The empire I intend to build won't end at this city's limits. Every stronghold, every port, every city has a place in my grand design.
We'll advance from the outskirts, consolidate our resources, expand our territory, and join forces with those strong enough to stand beside us. Then we'll make our way to the center of power, because there's only room for one at the top.

Vice Throne is a free-to-play game. Some in-game items (including random items) can be purchased.

Download the game now. Start your rise to power and unlock more exciting content!

The Hell Clock Is ticking..

In the 19th century, Canudos became a refuge for thousands. When its people defied the new Republic, they faced brutal retaliation, leaving 25,000 dead.

Play as Pajeú, a warrior fighting to rescue the soul of The Counselor, his fallen mentor. With each descent, time warps, and your power grows as you confront the dark forces that claimed his head and trapped his soul.

Every second counts as you battle the undead forces of your oppressors. Risk delving deeper for powerful loot and face the nightmarish incarnations of those who sought to bury the truth.

Hunt down ancient Relics infused with the strength of resistance. Create devastating combinations that channel Canudos' unbreakable spirit into unstoppable power.

Master a diverse selection of devastating abilities born from righteous fury. Dance through hordes with lightning-fast knife strikes, smash enemies with Canudos' great bell, or rain rapid-fire death from your trusty sidearm.

data.name: Rock Paper Scissors Ninja
data.description_full:
A strategy board game built on the one game everybody already knows how to play: rock paper scissors.

Except this time it is not one hand against one hand. It is an army against an army. Twelve ninja fighters stand on your side of the board, each one holding a hidden weapon that only you can see, plus a flag to defend and a trap lying in wait. Facing you are identical enemy soldiers with no way to tell which is rock, which is paper, which is scissors, and which square hides his trap.

That is how rock paper scissors turns into a real strategy game. You move one square per turn. You read your opponent by the way he advances. You push a ninja forward just to see what happens. You let him believe your scissors are a rock. He is doing all of it right back at you. And when two ninjas finally meet on the same square, the oldest duel in the world decides who stays on the board. A tie means both players secretly choose a weapon again and clash a second time, and a third, until it breaks.

The rules need no tutorial. What is new is what happens when you give them a board, an army, a hidden trap, and a flag your opponent must never find.

Free to download and play. This version has no ads and no in-app purchases.

THE RULES
• A 7 by 6 board. Each player commands 14 pieces: a flag, a trap, and four of each weapon.
• Hide your flag, bury your trap, shuffle your fighters and start.
• Move one square per turn, up, down or sideways. Step onto an occupied enemy square and combat begins.
• Rock breaks scissors. Scissors cut paper. Paper wraps rock.
• A tie? Both sides secretly pick a new weapon and fight again until there is a winner.
• A ninja who wins a fight is revealed for the rest of the match, and keeps the weapon he won with.
• A ninja who steps on a trap is gone, and the trap stays hidden, waiting for the next one.
• The first player to step onto the enemy flag wins the match.

ONLINE ARENA AGAINST REAL PLAYERS
• Enter an arena with a coin entry fee, get matched with a real opponent, and the winner takes the whole prize pool.
• Three arenas at different levels. Each one has a higher entry fee and a bigger pool.
• Nothing is taken out of the pool. The winner takes everything.
• The entry fee is only charged once an opponent is actually found.

ONLINE AGAINST A FRIEND

【Thư thái tận hưởng, quái tan biến trong chớp mắt】
Từ lúc bắt đầu tới khi hoàn thành hành trình, hệ thống auto hoàn toàn giúp bạn rảnh tay. Mỗi trận chiến là một màn nhặt đồ mãn nhãn, nhiệm vụ chính tuyến, hang động, bí cảnh đủ cả – kiểu chơi dành riêng cho dân văn phòng, ngồi uống trà vẫn thấy chỉ số tăng vùn vụt.
【Chạm là bay, đòn đánh sướng tận óc】
Võ học muôn màu, cảm giác va chạm sắc lẹm từng cú. Hiệu ứng chiến đấu gọn mà uy lực, chẳng kiểu đứng chờ số như game cũ. Luyện thành tuyệt học rồi thì sát thương bung màn hình, nhìn thôi đã thấy đã.
【Vô số danh hiệp, chờ ngày hội ngộ】
Biết bao hảo hán kinh điển hội tụ, mỗi người một tuyệt kỹ độc bản. Cộng thêm đội hình tùy tùng quầng sáng hùng hậu, tự tay tạo nên bản trận hình trong mơ của chính mình.
【Xây dựng tự do, trí tuệ mới là vua】
Tâm pháp, võ kỹ, thần khí, y phục – đủ mọi hướng phát triển nhân vật. Thuộc tính đa dạng, từ khóa kết hợp linh hoạt cùng tùy tùng quầng sáng. Trang bị rơi theo may mắn, vừa cần tư duy chiến thuật vừa cần chút vận khí.
【Phong vị Đông Phương, giang hồ riêng biệt】
Khung cảnh cổ trang đậm chất giang hồ, những kỳ nhân dị sĩ lần lượt xuất hiện. Họa phong hoạt hình nhẹ nhàng hài hước mà vẫn giữ trọn tinh hoa võ hiệp Á Đông. Thỏa sức mix đồ tạo phong cách riêng, đừng để lỡ nhé!

data.name: Pointaway: Arrows Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
Pointaway: Arrows Puzzle is a brain-teasing logic puzzle game where every move matters. Solve hundreds of arrow puzzles by studying the board, finding open paths, and tapping arrows away in the correct order. Each level is a new brain teaser that tests logic, spatial reasoning, concentration, and problem-solving skills.

Puzzles and Brainteasers for Your Brain

The goal is simple: clear every arrow from the board. Each arrow can move only in the direction it points, but other pieces may block its way. Look for a free path, choose the correct sequence, and open new space with every successful move. Each level works like a compact escape puzzle: find the correct order and get every arrow out. Solving the puzzle takes observation, planning, and logical thinking—not speed.

How to Solve Each Arrow Puzzle

• Examine the board and follow the direction of every arrow.
• Find arrows with a clear route out of the grid.
• Tap a free arrow to remove it and open another path.
• Use color and direction to point out the next free move.
• Think ahead before choosing the next arrow.
• Avoid blocked paths and collisions that cost hearts.
• Clear the full board to complete the logic puzzle.
• Use hints and power-ups when a brain teaser gets tricky.

Why Puzzle Players Will Love Pointaway

• Hundreds of puzzles and brainteasers to solve.
• Logic-based gameplay with simple one-touch controls.
• Clever arrow puzzles that challenge spatial thinking.
• Increasing difficulty that keeps every level engaging.
• Brain training through focus, planning, and problem-solving.
• Relaxing play without timers or time pressure.
• Helpful hints for difficult logic puzzles.
• Offline puzzle gameplay whenever you want to think.

A Logic Game That Grows with You

The first puzzles help you learn the rules, while later boards require deeper strategy and careful planning. Every arrow you remove changes the puzzle, reveals new possibilities, and brings the solution closer. There is always a logical way forward—study the grid, predict the result, and find it.

Pointaway is designed for players who enjoy brain games, IQ puzzles, logic games, strategy puzzles, spatial reasoning games, color puzzles, escape puzzles, and puzzle games for adults. Each level combines the calm flow of a relaxing puzzle with the rewarding “aha!” moment of solving a challenging brain teaser.

Play one quick level or work through a longer set of arrow puzzles. With hundreds of boards to clear, there is always another logic challenge waiting.

Ready for Your Next Brain Teaser?

Arrows out, board clear, puzzle solved. Find the free paths, avoid collisions, and train your brain one puzzle at a time.

data.description_full: Welcome to Tap Arrow & Earn Money – the fast-paced puzzle game where every smart move puts real cash in your pocket! Your goal is simple: tap a marker and watch it glide off the board the way it points. But there’s a catch. Markers can get in each other’s way. If the exit path is blocked by another marker, the move fails and that marker becomes jammed. Every marker can survive up to two jams, but if it gets stuck a third time, the marker locks up completely and the level is lost. You’ll need to plan the perfect tapping order – clear the obstacles first, free the pathways, and remove every marker without breaking anything. Earn Real Money & Withdraw via PayPal Every marker you successfully clear adds instant in-game cash to your balance. Beat more puzzles, and your stack keeps growing – all convertible into real money. Cashing out is effortless: Keep playing until your in-game balance reaches the minimum payout amount. Open the Wallet or Cash-Out section inside the app. Choose PayPal as your withdrawal method, enter your PayPal email, and confirm. Your earnings will be sent straight to your PayPal account. Just play, earn, and get paid. Key Features Easy to pick up, hard to put down – one-tap sliding puzzles that start simple but soon test your logic and foresight. Real PayPal payouts – every cleared marker brings you closer to actual cash you can use. 100% free – no entry fees, no forced purchases, just genuine puzzle fun. Bright, polished presentation – enjoy crisp visuals, lively animations, and deeply satisfying clear effects. Huge level variety – fresh board layouts and escalating challenges make every session feel new. Why You’ll Love It Tap Arrow & Earn Money blends the calm, strategic satisfaction of a puzzle game with the genuine thrill of building up real-world rewards. It’s perfect whether you have a couple of minutes to relax or want to dive into a focused play session, stacking up cash level after level. No tricks, no clutter – just pure tapping fun that pays.

data.name: Kitty Pack: Cat Color Sort
data.description_full:
Sort cats by color, fill the boxes, and take the picture apart. Kitty Pack is a relaxing color sort puzzle where every level is a pixel art picture built from cats, and you unpack it one box at a time.

No timer. No move limit. The only limit is five open boxes, so the whole game comes down to one calm decision: which box to open next.

HOW THE SORT PUZZLE WORKS
Every level starts as a picture made of colored blocks, and there is a cat inside each block. Pick a box from the queue and it opens on the shelf. Every cat of that color hops in on its own until the box is full, closes, and frees the slot for the next one. The blocks above settle down, the picture shifts, and a new row of cats is ready to go.

Five open boxes, a queue of colors waiting, and a picture that only comes apart if you choose well. That is the whole puzzle.

CAT GAMES THAT LET YOU BREATHE
Nothing counts down and nothing pushes you. Sort one color, watch the cats hop in, see the box close, and pick the next one when you are ready. If you like calm cat games with cute animals and zero pressure, these are your kind of puzzle games — made for the quiet ten minutes at the end of the day.

A PIXEL ART PICTURE IN EVERY LEVEL
Every board is a picture: a tree, a penguin, a lighthouse, all built from colored blocks. You are not sorting for the sake of sorting, you are taking a piece of pixel art apart block by block, and the board looks different every time you open the game. Most color sort games stop at matching. This one gives you something to uncover.

BLOCK PUZZLE MEETS SORTING GAMES
Every board is a color block grid, and every box is a small planning problem. Which color goes first? Which slot do you keep free? Get it right and the whole picture comes apart in one satisfying run. It is the thinking part of block puzzle games and the calm part of sorting games in one place.

EASY TO START, MORE TO THINK ABOUT
• One rule: open a box, and the cats of that color pack themselves
• Question blocks keep their color hidden until you reach them
• Boards get wider and new colors arrive as you level up
• Three boosters unlock as you level up: pull any box out of the queue, shuffle what is waiting, or instantly fill your open boxes with a color you choose

BRAIN GAMES FOR EVERY POCKET OF TIME
Short sessions on the bus, long ones on the sofa. These brain games ask for real planning and give you all the time in the world to do it. Nothing hurries you, nothing counts down your fun.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Players who like color sort, color block and block puzzle games without the pressure
• Cat people, and anyone who likes cute pet games and animal games
• Logic and brain puzzle fans looking for something gentler
• Fans of pixel art, mosaic and picture reveal puzzles
• Anyone after relaxing games, matching games or a calm color match session

Kitty Pack is a calm color sort puzzle with a pixel art picture in every level. Open a box, pack the cats, and take your time.

data.name: Super Hand
data.description_full:
Super Hand is a platformer game about a hand. Just a hand. No body, no plan, no business being this determined. It wants a donut, and honestly, that's enough of a reason.
It used to belong to a baker named Varnava, who really should have kept a closer eye on it. The hand had a mind of its own and a serious weakness for anything glazed. One night it reached for a donut it definitely should not have touched, there was a glass case, there was a very loud noise, and long story short, the hand now lives its own life. The baker took it surprisingly well.
Then a pigeon showed up and stole the good donut. Not just any pigeon. An evil one. It grabbed the one donut that mattered and scattered a thousand others across the world, presumably for fun, because that is exactly the kind of thing this pigeon does. The hand took this personally.
So now it crawls. Finger over finger, ledge to ledge, hurling itself across gaps no five fingers should survive. It grabs onto walls. It flops off cliffs. It lands wrong and gets right back up, because it has exactly one goal and absolutely no shame. At the end of every level there's a donut, and the hand snatches it, and struts off looking for the next one.
And it will not stop talking. This hand has no eyes, no mouth, no ears, and a great deal to say about all of it. It will narrate its own jumps. It will insult the pigeon. It will get emotional about a donut. You are along for the ride whether you like it or not.
Inside the game:
A cozy, hand-painted platformer that is a lot sillier than it looks. Crawl, climb and jump through dozens of levels. Grab a donut at the end of each one. Hunt down one deeply unpleasant pigeon. Enjoy the running commentary of a hand who thinks it's hilarious. Get pulled through a story that makes almost no sense and completely works.
Super Hand is out now. Somewhere out there is a donut, an evil pigeon, and a hand with a point to prove.
data.description_short: Super hand crawls across the adventure world looking for donuts. Please help it.

data.name: Volcano Slots
data.description_full:
🌋 VOLCANO SLOTS

The crust holds exactly as long as you stand on it.

Volcano Slots is a turn-based puzzle game on frozen volcanic ground. Every tile you step off begins to burn: first thin orange cracks, then glowing fractures, and within a few moves — boiling molten collapse. There's no way back. Only the route you're creating right now.

Your goal sounds simple: collect gold and reach the vent. The challenge? The field burns exactly as fast as you walk across it.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

🧩 Swipe or tap a neighboring tile — that's one move
🔥 Tiles ignite only after you leave them
⚠️ You can return to a cracked tile, but the countdown won't stop
💎 The vent opens when you've gathered enough gold
🎯 Losing isn't about bad timing — it's about trapping yourself

🌡️ THREE TEMPERATURES

• Ember — crust lasts 4 moves. Learn to think one step ahead.
• Magma — 3 moves. One careless loop costs the level.
• Inferno — 2 moves. The tile behind you is already almost molten.

Difficulty can be changed anytime — level progress is shared, but stars are counted separately for each temperature. Beating all 12 levels on Ember and beating them on Inferno are two different experiences.

⭐ GAME FEATURES

🗺️ 12 handcrafted levels — no generation, each has a precise solution
🏆 3 stars per level: reach the vent, collect all gold, meet the move target
⏱️ No timers — think as long as you need
⚡ Short sessions: first completion takes a minute, hunting three stars takes much longer
📊 Full statistics: stars earned, gold collected, completion percentage
📴 Works offline

This isn't about quick fingers. It's about seeing the trap three moves before you step into it.

ℹ️ GOOD TO KNOW

Volcano Slots is a skill-based puzzle game. Your success depends entirely on planning, decision-making and strategic thinking — not on chance. All rewards (stars, gold points) are virtual, simulated game elements with no real-world value. They cannot be exchanged, withdrawn or converted into real money. The game does not involve real-money gambling, betting or payouts. No purchases are required to play or progress.

The ground won't wait. Move now.

data.name: Speed Escape: Obby Parkour

Race through speed obby stages, complete each 3D obstacle course, and survive an obby run filled with platforms, narrow paths, and traps. Fans of obby parkour games can test their timing in Keyboard Parkour, classic Obby Parkour, Escape from Lily, and a maze-like corridor mode.

The obby runner gameplay gives you direct control over movement and jumping. Learn each layout, improve your timing, and complete increasingly complex parkour routes across all four modes.

• Four modes with different routes and escape goals
• Speed obby and fast obby stages
• 3D obstacle courses with traps and platforming
• Direct obby runner movement and jumping
• Keyboard Parkour and classic obstacle levels

Tap and hold to pick an object, slide to adjust, release to collect
Match 3 identical objects to pop them with a satisfying burst
Uncover hidden items buried deep in the pile
Plan ahead — your collection bar has limited space!

🎯 COMPLETE YOUR TARGETS

🚀 SMART BOOSTERS

Stuck with a tricky pile? Use boosters wisely:
Hint — instantly finds and collects a matching triple
Shuffle — mixes the entire pile with satisfying physics
Extra Slot — adds temporary space to your collection bar

🧠 THINK BEFORE YOU COLLECT

Finding a match is easy — managing your bar is the real puzzle. Grab the wrong objects and you'll run out of room. Search deeper, reveal what's underneath, and choose your next pick carefully. Strategy beats speed!

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

Hundreds of levels with fresh objects and layouts
Relaxing yet brain-teasing gameplay
Vibrant graphics and juicy pop effects
Play offline, anytime, anywhere
Free to play, easy for everyone
Perfect for fans of match 3 games, triple match puzzles, sorting games, object finding games, tile matching, and casual brain teasers.

data.name: Wonderland Re: Star Ark
data.description_full:
ตำนานบทเก่ากว่าสองทศวรรษได้ถูกปลุกขึ้นมาอีกครั้ง!
เหล่านักผจญภัยเอ๋ย... ท่านยังจำเสียงเพรียกแห่งการผจญภัย และสายใยแห่งมิตรภาพในปาร์ตี้วันวานได้หรือไม่?

ปลดล็อกเนื้อเรื่องใหม่สุดเข้มข้น! อัปเกรดงานภาพวาดใหม่ยกเซ็ต จัดเต็มความคมชัดระดับ CG สุดอลังการ พร้อมพลิกโฉมเหล่าตัวละครและฉากระดับตำนานให้สวยล้ำทะลุมิติ!
เสริมทัพด้วยระบบใหม่ที่ถูกอัปเกรดมาเพื่อเหล่านักผจญภัย! พบกับ 'ตลาดแลกเปลี่ยน', 'ระบบพัฒนากิลด์', 'การเก็บเกี่ยวทรัพยากรอัตโนมัติ' และ 'การตั้งคิวคราฟต์ไอเทม'... พร้อมการปรับปรุงระบบอีกมากมาย! ก้าวสู่โลกใบเดิมที่ท่านคุ้นเคย พร้อมรับประสบการณ์ผจญภัยรูปแบบใหม่ (Wonderland Re: Star Ark) วิวัฒนาการแห่งความคลาสสิกที่ช่วยให้การเดินทางของคุณอิสระและง่ายดายยิ่งกว่าที่เคย!

✦ Star Ark การผจญภัยครั้งใหม่สุดมันส์ เปิดฉากขึ้นอย่างเป็นทางการแล้ว! ✦
เมื่อจักรวาลและตำนานบทใหม่ถูกร้อยเรียงขึ้น... สู่การเดินทางอันไร้ซึ่งขอบเขต! ร่วมก้าวเดินไปพร้อมกับมิตรสหายที่แสนคิดถึงจาก 《Wonderland》 ในเส้นทางการผจญภัยที่เต็มไปด้วยกลิ่นอายแห่งความแปลกใหม่ หากแต่สิ่งเดียวที่ยังคงเดิมไม่เลือนหาย คือความทรงจำอันแสนงดงามที่ตราตรึงอยู่ในหัวใจของนักเดินทางนับล้านตลอดมา!

✦ บุกเบิกดินแดนใหม่สุดท้าทาย! ทะลวงมิติสู่การผจญภัยที่จำลองฉากจากโลกแห่งความจริง ✦
คราฟต์พาหนะสุดเจ๋ง แล้วตะลุยเช็กอินให้ทั่วทุกมุมโลก! ตั้งแต่ ไต้หวัน ญี่ปุ่น โรม ยันอียิปต์... ออกสำรวจแลนด์มาร์กชื่อดังและซากโบราณสถานสุดลึกลับ ทุกเกาะมีปริศนาและของแรร์ซ่อนอยู่เพียบ! ออกล่าขุมทรัพย์และตบบอสสุดโหด งานนี้ไม่ได้ทำไปเพื่อกอบกู้โลกจากอำนาจมืดอย่างเดียวนะ... แต่หลักๆ คือเพื่อหาทางกลับบ้านด้วย(?)!

✦ คราฟต์ได้ครอบจักรวาล! ตำราเอาชีวิตรอดสุดป่วนที่สตาร์ทจากมะพร้าวแค่ลูกเดียว ✦
เดินสายฟาร์มของและเก็บทรัพยากรให้เกลี้ยงแมพ! แม้เริ่มเกมมาจะมีแค่มะพร้าวลูกเดียว ก็ปั้นเป็นเครื่องมือและแท่นคราฟต์สุดล้ำได้สบาย! ไม่ว่าจะอยากสาดกระสุนด้วยปืนกล แบกบาซูก้า หรือคราฟต์ของใหญ่อย่างเรือดำน้ำและยูเอฟโอ... ขอแค่ฟาร์มของมาให้ครบ ทุกไอเทมสุดป่วนและสุดเท่ คุณก็กดสร้างเองได้หมด!

✦ บ้านพักสุดคิวท์! จัดวางเฟอร์นิเจอร์และสร้างสเปซในฝันได้ตามสไตล์คุณ ✦
เป็นเจ้าของสเปซส่วนตัวสุดชิค! จะแต่งผนัง จัดวางเฟอร์นิเจอร์ หรือประดับโคมไฟ ก็คัสตอมได้ตามสไตล์คุณ 100%! ออกตะลุยฟาร์มของแรร์มาคราฟต์ของแต่งบ้านสุดเก๋ เพื่อเนรมิตเต็นท์ของคุณให้แหวกแนวไม่เหมือนใคร แล้วทักแชทชวนแก๊งเพื่อนซี้มานั่งเล่นชิลๆ ปาร์ตี้เมาท์มอยกันได้เลย!

✦ สตอรี่สุดอินกินใจ! ถักทอสายใยผูกพันในเรื่องราวที่คุณจะไม่มีวันลืม ✦
จัดเต็มความคลาสสิกสไตล์ JRPG! ออกเดินทางไปตั้งปาร์ตี้กับแก๊งเพื่อนสุดยูนีค ปลดล็อกเควสต์เนื้อเรื่องเฉพาะตัว เพื่อขุดคุ้ยอดีตและความลับที่ซ่อนอยู่ สตอรี่ที่อาจจะทำให้คุณอินจนซึ้ง... หรือปวดตับไปตามๆ กัน! กอดคอลุยฝ่าฟันและอัปเลเวลไปด้วยกัน รับรองเลยว่าทริปผจญภัยยาวๆ ทริปนี้ คุณจะไม่มีวันเหงาแน่นอน

data.name: Lumen Lanes

Watch each falling lumen, wait until it reaches the bottom catch zone, then tap the matching lane before it slips away. Use hints to spot the next lane, build a steady rhythm, and push through higher stages with more catches and quicker drops ahead.

data.name: SkyBounceHero
data.description_full:

Core Gameplay Rules:

Launch Timing: Tap the screen at the right moment to hit the character and launch them into the sky.

Bounce Mechanics: Use objects, animals, and trampolines scattered along the ground to maintain speed and bounce higher upon landing.

Flight Control: Tap mid-air to activate downward boosts or adjustments to hit optimal bounce targets.

Distance Goal: Travel maximum distance in each flight to earn coins based on performance.

Game Features:

Attribute Upgrades: Use earned coins to upgrade launch power, bounce force, speed, and air resistance reduction.

Gear & Equipment: Unlock different bats, launchers, and outfits that modify in-game launch stats.

Obstacles & Boosters: Features both helpful items (like rocket boosters and trampolines) and hazards that slow down momentum.

Offline Play: Play single-player offline mode without requiring an active internet connection.
data.description_short: Launch your character, bounce off objects, and fly long distances.

data.name: CellPopManiaPro
data.description_full:
CellPopManiaPro is an arena-based io action game where players control a cell to consume food, expand their size, and outmaneuver opponents.

Core Gameplay:

Eat and Grow: Move across the map to consume food items like pizza slices and cakes to increase your size and score.

Swarm Expansion: Collect and increase the number of cells under your control to build a larger swarm.

Game Features:

Upgrades System: Spend coins to upgrade stats including starting cell count and movement speed.

Custom Skins: Unlock different character skins to customize your in-game appearance.

Leaderboard: Compete for top positions on the live match leaderboard.

Controls: Simple touch controls designed for smooth movement and navigation.

data.name: Aurora Snap
data.description_full: Aurora Snap is a bright timing puzzle about catching playful light sprites with a magic camera lens. Watch each sprite drift across the aurora sky, tap only when it enters the golden frame, and finish the level before your moves run out. data.description_short: Tap, track and snap glowing sprites through the magic lens!

data.name: ClearArenaPro
data.description_full:
ClearArenaPro is an arena-based action puzzle game where players control a character or machine to clear objects from the map within a limited time.

Core Gameplay Rules:

Absorb and Grow: Move around the arena to swallow small objects scattered across the map. As you absorb more items, your cleaner increases in size.

Size Mechanics: Increasing your size allows you to absorb larger obstacles and structures in the environment.

Compete and Clear: Outmaneuver opponents in the arena by absorbing objects faster to achieve the highest score or clear the entire map before time expires.

Game Features:

Touch Controls: Drag your finger on the screen to navigate your character smoothly across the arena.

Arena Maps: Features different map environments with various objects, obstacles, and layouts.

Power-Ups: Includes in-game speed boosts and magnets that temporarily draw nearby objects toward your character.

Offline Play: Enjoy single-player offline mode without requiring an active internet connection.
data.description_short: Control a cleaner to absorb objects, grow in size, and clear the arena.

data.name: LinkPairPuzzlePro
data.description_full:
LinkPairPuzzlePro is a tile-matching puzzle game where players find and connect pairs of identical tiles to clear the board within a given time limit.

How to Play:

Match Tiles: Select two tiles with the same pattern to remove them.

Connection Rule: The path between two identical tiles cannot exceed more than two 90-degree turns (up to 3 line segments), and no other tiles can block the line.

Clear the Board: Remove all tiles before the timer runs out to complete the level.

Game Features:

Multiple Levels: Features progressive level designs that challenge observation and recognition skills.

In-Game Boosters:

Hint: Highlights a valid matching pair on the board.

Shuffle: Rearranges all remaining tiles to create new connection opportunities.

Offline Mode: Play anytime without requiring an active internet connection.

User Interface: Features clear tile icons, adjustable sound effects, and simple touch controls.
data.description_short: Connect pairs of identical tiles within the time limit to clear the board.

Experience Congklak online like never before. Challenge real players, compete in tournaments, create private games with friends, and enjoy one of the world's most beloved strategy board games on your mobile device.

Congklak.com offers a complete multiplayer experience built for players of every skill level.

WHY PLAY CONGKLAK.COM?

Play for Free
Jump straight into the action without paying. You can start playing immediately and explore the game before creating an account.

Real Multiplayer Matches

In-Game Chat
Communicate during matches with real-time chat. Talk with friends in private games or interact with opponents while competing online.

HOW TO PLAY CONGKLAK

Congklak is a classic strategy game played between two players on a board containing fourteen pockets and two stores.

At the beginning of the game, each pocket contains seven stones. Players take turns selecting one of their pockets and distributing all stones clockwise around the board. Stones are placed into pockets and the player's own store, while the opponent's store is always skipped.

Landing your final stone in your store grants an extra turn. If your final stone lands in an empty pocket on your side of the board and the opposite pocket contains stones, those stones are captured and moved into your store.

The game ends when one player no longer has stones available in their pockets or when a player resigns. The player with the most stones collected in their store wins the game.

Easy to learn but full of strategic depth, Congklak rewards planning, timing, and smart decision-making.

data.name: Pantry Pods
data.description_full: Drag glowing fruit capsules into matching pantry pods before the move counter runs out. Each level changes the active colors, pod positions, capsule starts, and move budget, so every shelf asks for a fresh route. Read the pod shapes, guide each capsule around obstacle bars, and use hints to reveal the next match when the board gets busy. Clear all pods to unlock the next level and keep refining your drag path.
data.description_short: Drag capsules, match pods and fill the pantry!

data.name: Mango Shuttle
data.description_full: Mango Shuttle is a bright drag-and-drop puzzle set in a sunny tropical depot. Each level gives you mango shuttle pieces, color-coded baskets, and a limited move budget. Drag each shuttle to the basket with the same color, watch correct deliveries vanish in a burst, and avoid wrong drops that end the run. Use hints to spot the next piece, then clear every delivery to unlock deterministic layouts with new color orders and tighter move planning.
data.description_short: Drag, match and deliver mango shuttles before moves run out!

data.name: Pattern Pop
data.description_full: Watch the glowing sequence, then tap the candy pads in the same order. Each level previews a new pattern across a 3x4 board, mixing target pads with gray decoys and a tight move limit. Follow the rhythm, remember each position, and avoid wrong taps that spend precious moves. When the board gets busy, use a hint to reveal the next pad. Clear the full sequence to advance into longer, trickier patterns.
data.description_short: Watch patterns, tap pads and pop the sequence!

data.name: Gummy Gauge
data.description_full: Gummy Gauge is a bright timing puzzle about pressure, size, and control. Press and hold to inflate a glossy gummy bubble, then release when its ring fits the green target zone on the gauge. Every try spends a move, so watch the needle, learn each target size, and use hints when the window gets tight. Clear all required fits to finish the level. Later stages change speed, target count, and safe windows for sharper timing.
data.description_short: Hold, release and fit each gummy into the target zone!

data.name: Echo Glyphs
data.description_full:
Echo Glyphs is a bright memory puzzle built around glowing rune tiles. Watch the numbered echo chain, then tap each glyph in order before your moves run out.
Decoy symbols sit beside the real path, so every choice asks for focus and recall. Hints can reveal the next target when the board gets busy. As levels advance, target counts, decoys, palettes, and move budgets shift to keep each sequence fresh and satisfying.
data.description_short: Memorize, tap and chain glyphs through bright puzzle levels!

data.name: Feather Juggle

data.name: PawTrail
data.description_full:
Pawtrail is a logic puzzle game where you place dogs on a grid using number clues. No guessing and no luck — every level has exactly one solution you can reach through deduction.

You act as a territory planner for a group of playful pups, finding each one an exclusive spot on the board.

How to Play
- Double-tap a cell to place a dog. Its paw prints sweep across the entire row and column in a cross shape, stopping only when blocked by an obstacle.
- Dogs are territorial: any cell already covered by paw prints cannot hold another dog.
- Numbers on the board show how many dogs surround that cell. A 0 means no dogs adjacent; a 3 means exactly three.
- Fill every cell with either a dog or paw prints to complete the level.

Features
- Difficulty range from short introductory grids to large expert boards
- Single tap to mark a cell with an X and rule it out
- No timer, and no pressure to rush a level

Solving Tips
- Start from extreme numbers. A 0 or a 4 gives you the most information on the board.
- Mark cells you have ruled out with an X to keep your reasoning visible.
- Trace where a dog's cross-shaped paw prints will reach before you place it.

Pawtrail suits players who enjoy Minesweeper-style number deduction and grid logic puzzles solved with reasoning rather than reflexes.

data.description_full:

Designed for users aged 18 years and older.

【Gameplay】
Master Rummy:Classic 13 is a landscape four-player casual rummy practice game. Play with three smart AI opponents using a single standard 52-card deck—draw, meld, and discard to empty your hand first.

【How to play】
• After the bottom loading bar finishes, you enter the table directly
• Each player starts with 7 cards; the rest form the stock; one card starts the discard pile
• On your turn: draw (stock or top discard) → optionally lay valid melds → discard one card
• Valid melds: a set of 3–4 same ranks, or a run of 3+ consecutive same-suit cards
• First to empty their hand scores opponents’ leftover deadwood; first to 100 practice points wins the match
• Open Rules in the top-right corner anytime

【Selection & settlement】
• Selected hand cards lift only—no highlight flash
• Round and match end with settlement screens showing practice scores

Take your skills to breathtaking heights in Goal Jump, an addictive vertical bouncing arcade heavily inspired by classic platform-jumping mechanics! In this high-flying soccer challenge, you control an athletic ball leaping endlessly upward from one floating beam to another. Your primary mission is to maintain your momentum, accurately navigate the changing environment, and climb as high as possible into the open sky to claim unbeatable score records!
The gameplay loop delivers pure arcade fun mixed with rewarding customization and maps:
Tilt or slide to direct your bouncing ball as it automatically leaps up the stadium platforms.
Use powerful springs and trampolines on the field to gain a massive vertical velocity boost.
Grab helpful gadgets along the path, including protective energy shields and heavy magnets that instantly sweep up floating gold coins.
Travel through different unlocked environments like Cloud kingdoms, deep Jungles, or mysterious outer Space, and visit the sports store to trade your wealth for dozens of unique patterned ball designs!
Key Game Features:
Addictive Vertical Journey: Master your movement patterns in a thrilling endless climb that constantly challenges your reaction speed and focus.
Diverse Maps and Skins: Keep the experience fresh by switching between multiple stylized stadium backdrops and unlocking a massive collection of colorful ball skins.
Trophy and Milestone Center: Complete fun in-game achievements, trace your lifetime gameplay statistics, and track your progress to become a field legend.
Signature Fortune Wheel: Take a short break between your massive vertical sessions to spin the interactive prize wheel and walk away with great free rewards.

data.name: Royal Fruits
data.description_full:
👑 You are the royal overseer in Royal Fruits. The pharaoh has handed you a commission 📜 a Mastaba, a Sun Temple ☀️ a Step Pyramid or the Great Pyramid 🏛️ and only the seasons of a single reign to raise it before the deadline ⏳

🌊 Every turn is one season: Flood, Sowing 🌱 Harvest 🌾 and back to the Flood. The river moves your stone cheaply by barge 🚤 the fields feed your workers 🍞 and both demand the same hands. How you divide your workforce determines whether the monument rises or the granary runs dry.

⚒️ Assign work gangs 👷 set rations 🥣 respond to unexpected events ⚠️ and trade with passing caravans. At the end of every season you'll receive a complete report explaining every block quarried, hauled and placed, every sack of grain consumed and every change in morale 😊 health ❤️ and the pharaoh's favor. Read the outlook, adjust your strategy and begin the next season in Royal Fruits.

🏗️ Build course by course. Finish two years early for a Triumph 🏆 finish on time for an Honored Reign ⭐ or let famine ☠️ collapse 🪨 or royal displeasure write a different ending. Every reign is preserved in your Chronicle 📖

🎮 WHAT YOU'LL DO
🏛️ Choose from four monument projects with different difficulty levels.
👷 Manage work gangs across quarry, hauling, building, farming, workshops and rest.
🌾 Balance grain, stone and tools while keeping workers alive and loyal.
🌊 Time your farming around the Nile's floods.
⚠️ Face meaningful events with clear consequences.
🐪 Trade resources with traveling caravans.
👑 Earn or lose the pharaoh's favor through your decisions.

📈 TRACK EVERYTHING in Royal Fruits
📊 Forecasts showing your progress and bottlenecks.
📖 A Chronicle of every completed reign.
📝 Personal journal with notes and photos.
🪵 Export a beautifully decorated stela to share your achievements.

⏰ Every result has a clear reason behind it, your strategy, the passing seasons and the race to build a monument worthy of eternity.

data.name: Arrio: Arrow Games & Puzzles
data.description_full:
Arrio: Arrow Puzzle is a satisfying arrow puzzle escape game where every move matters. Study the board, follow the direction of each piece, and tap them in the correct order to clear the entire puzzle.

The rules are simple: every arrow can move only in the direction it is pointing. However, other arrows may block its path. Think carefully, find the open route, remove the correct pieces, and create a way for every arrow to escape.

Easy to play, relaxing to explore, and challenging to master.

SOLVE CLEVER ARROW PUZZLES

Each level presents a new arrangement of arrows, blocked paths, and maze-like escape routes. Look at every direction before making your move because tapping the wrong piece can block another path.

To complete a level:

• Study the direction of every piece
• Find an arrow with a clear escape route
• Tap arrows in the correct order
• Remove blockers and open new paths
• Clear the full board to win

The early levels are simple and relaxing, while later arrow puzzle games require sharper observation, better planning, and more advanced logic.

PLAY WITH 8 UNIQUE THEMES

Change the appearance of your puzzles with eight creative themes:

• Classic Arrow
• Chain
• Snake
• Pencil
• Rope
• Skeleton
• Worm
• Alternate Snake

Turn arrows into twisting snakes, linked chains, pencils, ropes, worms, skeleton-style pieces, and more. Every theme gives the board a fresh visual style while keeping the satisfying arrow puzzle gameplay you enjoy.

Choose your favorite design and become an arrow master across every theme.

A RELAXING MAZE AND ESCAPE CHALLENGE

Arrio combines arrow games, maze games, path puzzles, and logic challenges in one clean puzzle experience. Every board feels like a compact maze arrow challenge where you must discover which piece can move, which path is blocked, and which move should come next.

There is always a route out. The challenge is finding it.

Clear crowded boards, solve tricky escape sequences, and guide every arrow toward freedom. Each successful move creates more space and reveals new solutions.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ARRIO

• Satisfying arrow puzzle escape gameplay
• Simple one-tap controls
• Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
• Eight colorful and creative themes
• Increasing difficulty as you progress
• Clever maze and path-solving challenges
• Smooth animations and responsive gameplay
• Relaxing levels with satisfying solutions
• Logic puzzles that train concentration
• Great for short sessions and longer puzzle runs

BECOME AN ARROW MASTER

Arrio begins with easy arrow puzzles that help you understand movement and direction. As you progress, the boards become more crowded, the routes become harder to identify, and every move requires better planning.

Observe the complete board before tapping. Find the correct starting point, open a route through the maze, and create the perfect escape sequence.

Can you become the ultimate arrow master and solve every arrow master puzzle?

Arrio is ideal for players who enjoy:

• Arrow puzzle games
• Arrow escape puzzles
• Arrow games
• Maze games
• Path puzzles
• Tap-away puzzles
• Unblock games
• Logic games

• Snake puzzles

Whether you want a relaxing puzzle break or a challenging brain workout, Arrio delivers a smooth and satisfying experience with creative boards, clever escape logic, and multiple visual styles.

Follow the arrows, master every maze, unlock all eight themes, and clear every board.

data.name: Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match
data.description_full:
Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match is a relaxing sliding tile puzzle where every move brings the board to life. Match identical mahjong tiles, enjoy satisfying collisions, and discover clever routes through each layout. With large, readable tiles and simple controls, it offers adults, seniors, and casual puzzle fans an inviting mix of calm play and thoughtful challenge.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
Find two identical mahjong tiles on the board.
Tap matching tiles that are already aligned, or slide a tile horizontally or vertically to line it up with its match.
When the matching tiles are in the same row or column with an unobstructed path between them, they connect and disappear.
Remove every tile from the board to complete the level.

⭐ WHAT MAKES MAHJONG FLOW DIFFERENT?
🀄 Slide, Align, and Match
Pairs do not always begin next to each other. Shift tiles across open spaces, create a direct route, and bring matching symbols into position. How you move one tile can reshape the choices that follow.

🌊 Smooth, Satisfying Tile Flow
Tiles glide into place, matching pairs collide, and routes appear as the layout changes. A good sequence of moves gives every puzzle its own natural rhythm.

🧠 Spatial Thinking Made Enjoyable
Look beyond the first available pair. Choosing which tile to move can open one route while closing another, turning simple matching into an enjoyable exercise in spatial reasoning and logic.

👀 Easy-to-Read Tiles and Comfortable Design
Bold symbols, generous tile sizes, and an organized board make important details easy to recognize. The interface stays out of the way, so you can concentrate on each move.

💡 A Nudge for Tricky Moments
Hint can point out an option when you miss a route, while Shuffle changes the arrangement when you want a fresh view of the board.

📶 Offline Casual Play
No Wi-Fi is required for regular puzzle play. Continue a board during a commute, between appointments, or whenever you have a few minutes to yourself.

👴 EASY TO SETTLE INTO
Large mahjong tiles, bold symbols, and direct sliding controls keep the screen comfortable to follow. The rules are approachable for adults and seniors, while route-based decisions provide enough depth for experienced puzzle players.

Download Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match and set the tiles in motion!

Note: Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match is a casual tile-matching puzzle that uses mahjong-inspired symbols. Its slide-and-match rules are separate from traditional multiplayer mahjong gameplay.

data.name: Bola Capture
data.description_full:
Draw a line. Fling the bola. Watch it wrap.

Bola Capture is a physics playground built around one irresistible move: throwing
a weighted cord and watching it coil around whatever it touches. Your targets
stagger and flail on fully simulated ragdoll bodies — and one well-aimed throw
turns that wobbling mess into a neatly bound bundle.

■ ONE SIMPLE MOVE
Drag anywhere on the screen to draw your throw.
- The direction you draw is the direction the cord spins.
- The longer the line, the longer the rope.
- Let go, and the bola whips away, spinning and trailing, in cinematic slow motion.
Long strokes reach farther and sweep up more targets at once. Short ones snap in
fast and close. Keep up to three bolas in the air at the same time.

■ CHAOS, THEN COLLAPSE
Nothing here is a canned animation. Every stumble, tangle and tumble falls out of
live physics.
- Wrap a single leg and they lose their footing all on their own.
- Catch a whole crowd in one throw and cinch them into a single struggling bundle.
- Rope them to lampposts, girders and steel trusses to pin them down for good.
- Sunglasses pop off. Eyes go wide. They squirm, they glare right back at you.
- Whatever they were carrying slips out of their hands and clatters to the floor.
Because it all runs on real simulation, the same throw never plays out twice.

■ TEN SHORT STAGES, BUILT BY HAND
Among them:
- A skyscraper rooftop, high above the city
- An office floor, desks and all

data.name: 森之歌：世界
data.description_full:
神木之下，萬物有靈。
森之紀元，永恆樹生於虛無，深紮大地、根連地脈，以樹果誕下世間萬千生靈。血性蒼狼、純淨玄鹿、靈動青狐、孤傲古龍、聰慧螢蝶，五大種族皆源於這棵神木。
第五個千年將至，永恆樹似乎有枯萎跡象，妖物也開始肆虐大地。古老的預言警示：「若永恆樹落，森歌斷絕，永夜將吞噬一切。」​
現在，與同伴一同走進《森之歌：世界》，踏上守護永恆樹、重奏森之歌的奇幻冒險之旅吧！

▶ 五大種族・相遇大世界
青丘、螢蝶、玄鹿、龍姬、蒼狼——五大森靈種族齊聚森靈大世界。每個種族皆有專屬天賦及覺醒外型，還能自由組合各式秘法戰技，輕鬆打造獨一無二、各具風采的戰鬥美學。

▶ 並肩作戰・共誅邪伐妖
危難籠罩永恆古樹，各地妖物傾巢出動。號召各族夥伴結隊同行，組建戰隊征討妖物，攜手抵擋永夜來襲，合力守護孕育萬靈的森靈大世界。

▶ 森林奇遇 · 邂逅那個TA
漫遊蒼鬱層巒、溪澗河谷與永恆古樹秘境，行走途中隨機觸發各式奇遇劇情。偶遇命中注定的夥伴與知己，共賞林間朝暮、歷遍山川險境，在這片森靈大世界締結長久羈絆與浪漫情緣。

▶ 千態森靈・靈寵伴你行
整片大陸棲息各式獨特森靈寵物，形態各異、能力迥然。馴服靈寵培育成得力夥伴，戰場上輔助作戰，閒暇時隨身相伴，旅途從此不再孤單。

Players need to drag falling trash (items) into the correct trash cans, testing their reaction and identification abilities regarding trash sorting.

### Controls

- Drag trash to the corresponding trash can

- Trash can types, such as:

- Recyclable

- Kitchen waste

- Hazardous waste

- Other waste

### Game Flow

- Trash items fall from the top of the screen

- Drag the item into the correct can before it lands

- Correct: Score + combo control

- Incorrect: Deduct points/reduce health

### Winning/Losing Rules

- Timed Mode: Score as many points as possible within 60 seconds

- Endless Mode: Ends when HP runs out

### UI Layout

```
[Trash Item 1]

↓
?? ?? ?? ⚫ ← Trash Can Area

Score: 180 Combo: x3

```

------

### 1. Special Trash Relics

- Deceptive: such as "Plastic Apple," increasing the difficulty of identification

- Relic: Score boost, speed reduction, screen clearing, invincibility, etc.

### 2. Combo System

- Combo multiplier increases with consecutive correct sorting

- Combo resets after an error

### 3. Achievement System

- Sorting 100 plastic bottles → "Plastic King"

- Survive for 3 minutes → "Environmental Warrior"

### 4. Daily Challenges

- Specific trash combinations, timed completion

- Local/Online leaderboards

### 5. Garbage Encyclopedia System

- Correctly sorting unlocks garbage encyclopedia entries

- Includes interesting descriptions

- Added sorting rules for different regions

Bamboo Shelf: Panda Puzzle is a cozy goods sorting and triple match puzzle game set on bamboo shelves. Sort goods, clear space, and solve each brain puzzle with calm focus.

Step into a bright bamboo world where shelves are filled with snacks, drinks, plants, toys, and cute surprises. Move matching items into the right places, complete shelf goals, and enjoy a smooth match puzzle flow with a playful panda theme.

🎮 How to Play

Look at each shelf and plan your next move.
Sort goods into open spaces and group matching items together.
Complete a triple match by lining up the same goods.
Clear shelves step by step as each brain puzzle becomes more layered.
Use careful shelf sorting to open new space and keep the board moving.

✨ What You’ll Enjoy

  • 🧩 Goods Sorting Levels — Enjoy goods sorting levels built around clear logic puzzle goals.

  • 🎯 Triple Match Tasks — Complete triple match tasks with snacks, bottles, plants, dolls, and more.

  • 📦 Smooth Match Puzzle — Solve each match puzzle with simple controls and satisfying shelf movement.

  • 🐼 Panda Puzzle Theme — Explore a panda puzzle theme with bamboo leaves, soft colors, and cheerful shelves.

  • 🌿 Shelf Sort Strategy — Practice shelf sort strategy as layouts become tighter and more thoughtful.



Every level asks you to observe, plan, and sort goods with care. Some shelves look easy at first, while others need patient moves and clever item matching. If you like a relaxing puzzle with tidy shelves and gentle progress, Bamboo Shelf: Panda Puzzle gives you a calm place to think.

Play Bamboo Shelf: Panda Puzzle and enjoy goods sorting, triple match challenges, and a cozy brain puzzle journey on bamboo shelves!
data.description_short: Enjoy goods sorting, shelf matching, and a calm panda puzzle game!

data.name: Starshift - Universe Shooter
data.description_full:
STARSHIFT - Universe Guardian and Space shooter game

Earth is only the beginning.
Enemy fleets are spreading across the universe, destroying planetary defenses and blocking every rescue route. Commander Lyra has selected you to become the Universe Guardian—the last pilot capable of pushing back the invasion.
Launch your fighter, clear hostile sectors, rescue threatened worlds, and confront colossal Guardian motherships protected by multiple shield layers.
MASTER ARCADE SPACE COMBAT
Meet new enemies, learn their attack patterns, survive combined formations, escape environmental hazards, and face Guardians that remix everything you have learned.
Enemies do more than fly straight toward you. They assemble into circles, half-circles, triangles, V-formations and coordinated attack groups. Advanced formations generate shared shields that must be destroyed before their ships become vulnerable.
BREAK THE GUARDIAN DEFENSE
Guardian motherships cannot escape the battlefield. They dodge, reposition, deploy reinforcements and attack through multiple combat phases.
Break every shield layer, expose the central hull and survive long enough to destroy the Guardian. Each victory ends with a powerful five-second destruction sequence of rupturing armor, collapsing reactors and expanding shockwaves.
CONTROL TIME AND TURN DANGER INTO POWER
Activate Focus mode to slow the battle and navigate dense bullet patterns with precision.
Fly close to enemy fire to trigger Chrono-Graze, slow time and increase your score multiplier. When your fighter reaches critical health, Desperation Mode transforms it into a fragile but powerful glass cannon.
BUILD YOUR COMBAT LOADOUT
Earn up to two optional upgrade opportunities during each level. Upgrade icons remain available without interrupting combat, allowing you to open them when the battlefield is safe.
Combine damage, fire-rate, critical-hit, drone and projectile upgrades to unlock powerful combat fusions. Store missiles and multiple ULT charges for the moments when the enemy formation becomes overwhelming.
Prepare carefully before a Guardian mission—your collected powers, missiles and stored ULT energy carry into the Guardian battle.
EXPLORE AN EVOLVING UNIVERSE
Travel through changing galaxies filled with planetary orbits, lunar eclipses, comet fields, crystal expanses, gravity wells, cosmic rifts and destination sieges.
Discover:
• 100 uniquely designed Guardian motherships
• More than 100 progressively revealed enemy threats
• Multi-layer shields and multi-phase boss battles
• Commander Lyra’s narrated mission transmissions
• Focus, Chrono-Graze and Desperation combat systems
• Missiles, rechargeable ULT attacks and companion drones
• Upgrade combinations and powerful fusion abilities
• Dynamic difficulty across Normal, Hard and Nightmare modes
• Changing music, environments and enemy formations
The invasion has already begun.
Receive your mission. Protect your fighter. Break the shields. Save every world.
Become the Universe Guardian.
data.description_short: Space shooter game : Dodge bullet storms, break Guardian shields, and save world

data.name: Silkroad Origin Mobile Arabia
data.description_full:
سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا هي النسخة الرسمية للموبايل من سيلكرود أونلاين، والمرخصة عالميا من قبل وي ميد ماكس (كوريا الجنوبية)، المعروفة سابقا باسم جوي ماكس، وقد طورت خصيصا لمجتمع العالم العربي.

مستوحاة من طريق الحرير الأسطوري، الذي ربط عبر التراث الممتد لآلاف السنين بين الحضارات والتجار وقوافل الكارفان، تعيد سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا اللاعبين إلى رحلة المسافرين، حيث أصبحت الشجاعة، وروح الأخوة، والكرم قيما خالدة تتوارثها الأجيال..

التراث يفتح الطريق - والضيافة ترشد الدرب

على الطرق الممتدة عبر الصحراء، لم تكن النجوم وحدها هي التي تهدي المسافرين إلى وجهتهم، بل أيضا نور مجلسٍ مفتوح الأبواب دائما، حيث يستقبل كل ضيف بالتقدير والكرم وبروح التآخي والتعاون.

لقد أصبح هذا النهج جزءًا أصيلًا من الثقافة العربية، وهو أيضًا مصدر الإلهام الذي بُنيت عليه سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا. فهي ليست مجرد لعبة، بل مساحة يلتقي فيها أفراد المجتمع، ويتواصلون، ويواصلون معًا كتابة أسطورة سيلكرود في عصرٍ جديد.

تعود أسطورة سيلكرود إلى الحياة على الموبايل

ترث سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا روح سيلكرود أونلاين الكلاسيكية بكل تفاصيلها، مع الحفاظ على الرسومات الأصلية التي أحبها اللاعبون. فمن الصحارى الشاسعة، إلى المدن المزدهرة، وصولًا إلى السراديب العريقة التي تخفي الكنوز وأسرار التاريخ، تحمل كل رحلة تحدياتٍ جديدة بانتظار المسافرين الشجعان.

المهن الكلاسيكية الثلاث: التاجر، الصياد، واللصوص

اختر طريقك الخاص على طريق الحرير: التاجر، اللصوص، أو الصياد، وهي المهن الثلاث الكلاسيكية التي صنعت أسطورة طريق الحرير. لكل مهنة أسلوب لعبها الخاص، واستراتيجيتها المميزة، ودورها الفريد في الصراع للسيطرة على طرق التجارة الحيوية بين الصين وأوروبا. أما نظام المهارات الأصلي، الذي جرى تحسينه ليتناسب مع الموبايل، فيمنحك تجربة قتال واقعية ومتوازنة.

ساحة الشرف

من معارك النقابة الضخمة إلى الصراع من أجل السيطرة على طرق التجارة، لا تجلب كل انتصار المكافآت فحسب، بل يرسخ أيضا شرف المجتمع بأكمله، وشجاعته، وقوته.

هنا تُولد الأساطير الجديدة.

نسخة مخصصة للعالم العربي

لا تقتصر سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا على الترجمة إلى اللغة العربية فحسب، بل خضعت أيضا لعملية توطين متكاملة لتنسجم مع ثقافة المنطقة ولغتها وعادات لاعبيها.

ابتداء من الواجهة العربية، والرسومات، والرموز، والفعاليات، وصولًا إلى الأنشطة المجتمعية، صمم كل عنصر باحترام للهوية المحلية، ليقدم تجربة أصيلة، قريبة من اللاعبين، ومستدامة.

لم يكن طريق الحرير يوما مجرد طريق للتجارة..

بل كان رحلة جمعت بين الشعوب، والثقافات، والقيم التي توارثتها الأجيال. واليوم، تستمر تلك الأسطورة على الموبايل. ابدأ رحلتك على الطريق الذي كان دائمًا طريقنا.

data.name: Silverscript Moonvault
data.description_full:
Restore a silverscript seal in a moonlit arcane archive.

A target seal of moon, star, and crystal runes appears above. Below, a 3×3 manuscript waits. Tap a folio to advance its rune and its up, down, left, and right neighbors by one state. Match the entire board to the seal to score and receive a new rite.

Long-press a folio to pin it against archive drift. Spend Ink on a Hint to nudge one mismatched folio. Check Seal while the board is incomplete costs a heart. Chain successful seals for combo bonuses. Three lost hearts end the run.

data.name: 777 Xlazing Rxush
data.description_full:
## Gameplay Instructions

### 1. Basic Rules

- **Slide Controls:** Move all blocks by swiping up, down, left, or right on the screen.

- **Merge & Evolution:** Blocks with the same number will merge into a higher-level element upon collision.

- **Goal:** Continuously synthesize blocks, challenging higher numbers and evolution stages, ultimately synthesizing 2048 (Star Core) or higher!

### 2. Element Evolution System

Each number represents an element stage. Synthesizing not only upgrades the number but also triggers unique icons and animations:

| Number | Element Form | Icon |

|-------|------------------|-------|

| 2 | Water Drop | ?? |

| 4 | Small Leaf | ?? |

| 8 | Sprout | ?? |

| 16 | Small Tree | ?? |

| 32 | Forest | ?? |

| 64 | Sand Grain | ⏳ |

| 128 | Relic Fragment | ?? | | 256 | Temple | ?? |

| 512 | Ice Crystal | ❄️ |

| 1024 | Glacier | ?? |

| 2048 | Star Core | ⭐ |

| Higher | Cosmic Wonder | ?????? |

### 3. Skill System

- Reaching specific blocks (e.g., 128, 256, 512) unlocks skills:

- **Storm Rearrangement**: Shuffles the grid but retains all block values.

- **Time Reversal**: Returns to the state before the last merge.

- **Clear a Column**: Click to clear an entire column.

- Skill uses are limited and can be obtained by crafting energy or achievements.

### 4. Dynamic Themes and Achievements

- As the evolution stage increases, different dynamic theme backgrounds (forest, desert, polar, space) automatically switch.

- A rich achievement system unlocks badges, skins, and rewards.

- The leaderboard records your highest score in real time, allowing you to compete against your friends.

### 5. Unique Features

- **Smooth Animations:** Merging, evolving, and skill releases all feature cool animations.

- **Customizable Settings:** Supports multiple grid modes (4x4, 6x6, 8x8) and dynamic/minimalist background switching.

- **Undo and Restart:** You can undo one free round per game and start a new challenge at any time.

"

Every round gives you eight eggs to organize. Pick an egg, identify its matching wagon—Small, Warm, or Striped—and load it correctly. Choose the wrong wagon and the egg simply bounces back, giving you another chance to get it right without a penalty.

Complete the loading and send the train on its journey, or race the clock before time expires. At Arrival, your performance is measured by how many eggs you successfully packed, along with your accuracy and star score.

Stars earned during your journeys add up over time, giving you a reason to keep improving each run. Simple to learn but satisfying to master, Chick Line turns egg sorting into a cheerful test of speed, recognition, and precision.

data.name: My Little Village
