My Little Village — a Vietnamese village-building game in an idle simulation style. Build houses, expand your neighborhood, recruit residents, trade, and grow your very own rural community! A simulation game that captures the essence of traditional Vietnamese life, deeply filled with nostalgic childhood memories.

🏡 BUILD & EXPAND YOUR VILLAGE
Start from a few simple cottages, and step-by-step build and upgrade them into a bustling, lively neighborhood. Construct residential houses, street-corner tea stalls, rural markets, schools, medical clinics, and dozens of other community buildings. Each new structure unlocks new professions, daily life activities, and trading opportunities for the whole village. Plan, arrange, and decorate your neighborhood in your own unique style.

👫 RECRUIT & MANAGE RESIDENTS
Every resident in the village has their own distinct personality, dream job, and daily routine. Recruit new residents and match the right person to the right job — from the hard-working farmer in the field, the cheerful vendor at the rural market, to the highly skilled carpenter. Build close-knit neighborly relationships and watch your community grow stronger every day. Complete quests from residents to earn rewards and unlock new content.

🌾 ENJOY THE VIBE OF VIETNAMESE COUNTRYSIDE
Golden rice fields, water buffaloes lazily grazing, a shimmering fish pond in the afternoon, and the cheerful laughter of neighbors — a peaceful, tranquil atmosphere that brings you back to your most beautiful childhood memories. The traditional Vietnamese countryside setting is authentically recreated with a cute, bright, and familiar art style. Experience the beauty of folk culture, traditional crafts, bustling village markets, and vibrant village festivals.

⏰ IDLE - RELAXING CASUAL GAMEPLAY EVERY DAY
My Little Village is an idle game - gather resources automatically without needing to be online constantly or connected to the internet 24/7. Just open the game for a few minutes a day to manage your village, harvest resources, and feel the warm, little joys of life. Perfectly suited for busy people who want to unwind with a gentle, pressure-free, and non-competitive game - play at your own pace.

data.name: 777ㅤReflex
data.description_full:
777 Reflex is a fast-paced arcade test built around one simple goal: stop all three moving columns on the number 7. Sounds easy? The real challenge begins when the numbers start moving faster and your timing has to be razor-sharp.

Watch the changing numbers and tap at exactly the right moment, when 7 reaches the central zone. You need to stop all three columns correctly, turning every attempt into a test of concentration, timing, and reflexes.

After each attempt, the pace increases, leaving less time to react. Just when you think you have found your rhythm, a column may suddenly change direction or briefly disappear behind a flash, forcing you to stay focused and react without hesitation.

777 Reflex is all about the moment between seeing the 7 and making the perfect tap. Trust your eyes, sharpen your reactions, and find out how long you can keep up as the speed rises.

data.name: Віg Wіn
data.description_full:
Enter Big Win, an arcade challenge where every drop demands timing, precision, and a steady hand.

Your goal is to build a tower of 25 coins by dropping each swinging coin onto the stack and aiming as close to the center as possible. One mistake costs a life, and you have only three lives to complete the tower. Every successful drop brings you closer to the finish, while every miss puts your progress at risk.

data.name: Ranch Legacy: Idle Farm Tycoon
data.description_full:
One field. One tractor. A patch of Mato Grosso soil on a real satellite map. That's where every farming empire begins.

Ranch Legacy: Idle Farm Tycoon isn't another tap-and-merge farm. You build a real agri-business on an actual world map: claim fields, read the soil, plant corn, soy and wheat, then turn raw grain into high-value flour through your own supply chain. Field to silo, silo to mill, mill to market. Every link you build is worth more than selling the crop raw.

WHAT YOU DO
Tap a field on the map and choose a crop. Send your fleet to prep, plant and harvest it. The grain flows to your silo, your mill turns it into flour, and that flour fills lucrative orders or sells on a live market. Reinvest in land, machines, staff and processing, and watch a single farm grow into a global operation.

KEY FEATURES
🌍 Real-world map — Your whole empire lives on a real satellite map. Zoom from the world down to a single field.
🏭 Build value chains — Don't just sell grain. Mill it into flour and earn far more. Supply chains run on autopilot.
😌 Casual CEO mode — No harsh timers, no punishing decay. Your crops, mills and trucks keep earning while you're offline.
🚜 Fleet synergy — Add tractors and harvesters and watch jobs finish faster. More machines, more output.
📦 Rush orders — Fill timed orders for big bonus payouts. Beat the clock, bank the reward.
🌱 Real soil science — pH, nitrogen, crop rotation and weather all shape your yield. Plan smart, harvest big.
🐔 Livestock loop — Add a coop for eggs, side income and free fertilizer that feeds your fields.
📈 Two ways to play — Relaxed Casual CEO or deep Realism mode for players who love the numbers.

GROW AT YOUR OWN PACE
Check in for thirty seconds to collect a harvest, or sit down for a long session to optimize rotations, expand your fleet and build a new processing line. Whatever the session length, you always finish with a win.

FROM ONE FIELD TO A GLOBAL EMPIRE
Buy new land, place hubs and silos, hire field and logistics staff, and unlock bigger production chains as your reputation grows. The map is the game, and the whole world is yours to farm.

Plant the first field. Build the legacy.

從小小快餐店起步，你的每一點努力都會讓你離「富婆夢」更近一步！開連鎖超市、高級服裝店、盲盒公仔城⋯⋯每種店都有不同的經營玩法，考驗你的腦力～隨著資金和經驗一直累積，你還能直接把整座商場買下來，把每一家店都變成爆紅名店，成為真正的商業大亨！

Drive through intense traffic, race against rivals, drift through corners, escape police chases and push your car to the limit across a large network of roads. From fast highways and city routes to technical mountain roads, every road is designed to create a different driving experience.

The game focuses on dynamic driving, responsive car control and physics-based handling. Each car has its own behavior, weight, grip and performance, giving every race, drift run and chase a different feel.

Customize and upgrade your cars with a deep tuning system. Improve performance, adjust key parameters and build your car for speed, grip, drift, control or aggressive street racing.

Game features:
• High-speed racing in dense traffic
• Physics-based car handling
• Physics-based drifting and free driving across different roads and conditions
• Police chases and intense action gameplay
• Rival racers with challenging driving styles
• Large connected road network
• Highways, city streets, mountain roads, desert routes, snowy roads and more
• Deep car tuning and performance upgrades
• Cars with different handling and characteristics
• Stylish visuals and dynamic camera movement
• Dynamic day-night cycle, changing weather and an immersive driving atmosphere

Every race in DRIFT RIDE is about control under pressure: choosing the right line, managing speed, taking risks and pushing your car to the edge.
data.description_short: High-speed racing, dense traffic, realistic drifting and police chases.

data.name: 777YK Lone
data.description_full: ElowynBriar is a vertical rhythm reaction mobile game centered on observing an expanding energy crystal and tapping precisely within the scoring window. The white ring is the tap‑ready start point, and the red ring is the burst limit—once the crystal passes the white ring, the screen shows a READY / TAP prompt; tapping at that moment scores points. The closer to the red ring, the higher the score, but touching the line causes it to burst and costs a life. Tapping too early also costs a life. During play, variations such as ring drift, speed surges, and boundary shrink may occur, and a double‑score window can flash within the scoring zone. Synchronizing taps with floating star shards on the track grants bonus points. Combos increase the multiplier, and perfect captures build extra chances and courage bonuses; filling the focus bar unlocks a slow‑motion round. With three lives, players challenge extreme waves—the rules are intuitive, yet each decision involves a trade‑off between expansion rhythm and risk‑reward.
data.description_short: ElowynBriar is a rhythm reaction mobile game.

Đấu trường, bảng xếp hạng đỉnh phong, đối chiến liên server… hàng loạt thử thách đang chờ bạn chinh phục. Đối đầu cùng cao thủ toàn server, tranh đoạt vinh quang tối thượng!

data.name: Crazy Joker
data.description_full:
Welcome to Crazy Joker, a memory puzzle game where you reveal hidden puzzle pieces, remember their positions, and rebuild the complete picture.
Each level begins with a short preview of the full puzzle. After a few seconds, every piece is turned face down. Use your memory to reveal pieces and drag them into the correct positions.
As correctly matched neighboring pieces come together, they automatically connect into groups. Connected groups move together, helping you gradually restore the entire picture.
The game becomes more challenging as puzzle boards grow larger, requiring better memory and careful planning.
Features
• Preview the puzzle before the challenge begins
• Reveal hidden puzzle pieces
• Drag and swap puzzle pieces
• Automatically connect correctly matched pieces
• Memory-based puzzle gameplay
• Smooth and simple controls
• Increasing puzzle difficulty
• Relaxing brain-training experience
Can you remember every piece and complete the whole picture?
Download Crazy Joker and enjoy a fun memory puzzle challenge!
data.description_short: A fun memory puzzle game

data.description_full:
Get ready for a soft, bouncy, and satisfying puzzle adventure in Jelly Drop: Puff Up Puzzle!

Tap and hold to create and puff up a jelly ball, making it as large as possible to complete the goal of each level. There is no timer, so you can observe the puzzle, plan your strategy, and choose the best position before making your move.

Watch how the obstacles move, find a safe position, and choose the right moment to inflate your jelly. Narrow spaces and dangerous traps will test your accuracy, planning, and control.

Your mission is gathering the score of each jelly to earn enough points to reach the required score target. Bigger jelly balls can give you more points, but they also require better positioning and careful size control. Use your limited moves wisely, avoid dangerous obstacles, and create each jelly in the best possible place to collect enough points before your moves run out.

GAME FEATURES:
- Simple tap-and-hold controls
- Limited moves in every level
- No timer - Relaxing Time!
- Challenges obstales: Lasers, sharp spikes, and moving blades,...
- Smart positioning and size control
- Colorful and satisfying jelly effects
- Creative levels with unique challenges
- Easy to play, hard to master
- Smooth and playful animations

How to play
- Tap and hold on your screen to create and puff up a jelly ball
- Release your finger when the jelly reaches the right size
- Each jelly you create uses one move, and every level has a limited number of moves, so choose the position carefully before you start.
- Avoid lasers, sharp spikes, and moving blades while using the available space wisely. Control the size and placement of each jelly to complete the level objective before running out of moves.

data.name: Word Puzzle Game: Letter tiles
data.description_full:
Letter Tiles is a new genre of word puzzle games, a mix of a 5 letter word game and slide puzzle. These free word games for adults aren’t just about finding a word — you also have to arrange the word tiles to spell this word!

It works great both as educational games for middle and high school students, and as relaxing games for adults. Guess the word and start sliding tiles to victory!



🎮 How to play our free games for adults?


Unlike other slide puzzle games where the goal is to arrange numbers in order or complete a picture, the goal of our word puzzle games is to spell the words hidden in each puzzle. The word is always 5 letters long but it can appear horizontally or vertically.

Guess the word and spell it — swipe left, right, up, or down to move word tiles and form the hidden word:


  • 🟩 Green: The word tile is located in the correct position.

  • 🟨 Yellow: The word tile is correct but located in the wrong position.


🧩 Over 1,000 levels in the main mode


Each level is a new 5 letter word game and a new challenge:


  • Form a word horizontally

  • Form a word vertically

  • Form a word starting with a specific letter (horizontally or vertically, 1 to 4 words)

  • Form a word within a limited number of moves

  • Form a word within a time limit

  • Form a word while letters are shuffled every N moves (except those already in place)

  • Form a word when some letters are already fixed in place (cannot be moved)


📅 "Word of the Day" Mode


One word for the whole world. Guess it today — earn your reward. Check in every day — train your brain and collect achievements.



🗺️ "Adventure" Mode — 30 days, 30 words


Non-stop word games: log in daily and guess the words! Complete this challenge without missing a single day or word and get a reward!



🎁 Bonus hints


They’ll help you if you get stuck on a tricky word.



🔥 Why Letter Tiles?


  • ✅ Huge number of levels, modes, and mechanics

data.name: Codoku
data.description_full:
Codoku: Colors Sudoku is a vibrant, logic-based puzzle game that strips away traditional numbers and replaces them with a spectrum of distinct colors. By swapping digits for visual elements, the game transforms classic grid deduction into an engaging, pattern-recognition challenge that exercises visual memory and spatial reasoning. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Core Gameplay Mechanics
The game takes the foundational mechanics of traditional Sudoku and maps them to a multi-colored layout. Instead of relying on numerical tracking, players must think visually. [6, 7]

* The Rainbow Grid: The puzzle features a standard 9 × 9 layout. This major grid is split into nine standalone rows, nine vertical columns, and nine smaller 3 × 3 zones. [1, 7]
* The Objective: Fill the entire board so that each row, column, and 3 × 3 zone contains nine distinct colours without a single duplicate. [1]
* The Starting Setup: Each puzzle boots up with a fixed set of pre-placed colour blocks. These "clues" are locked into place and cannot be altered or moved, serving as your logical anchor points for the rest of the board. [1, 7, 8]
* Pure Deduction: No mathematical calculations or counting are required. Victory is achieved entirely through the process of elimination, pattern tracking, and careful visual placement. [2, 9, 10, 11, 12]

How to Play & Basic Strategy
Because your brain registers hues differently than it does numbers, the mental approach shifts away from counting to spatial scanning.

1. Isolate a Single Palette: Focus your attention on one specific colour at a time. Trace its pre-existing positions across the board to figure out where its placement is restricted in adjacent zones.
2. Scan the Boundaries: Look for rows, columns, or 3 × 3 sections that are already heavily crowded with colors. The fewer open slots a region has, the easier it is to deduce which remaining shades fit perfectly. [1, 6, 13]
3. Cross-Reference Intersection Points: If a particular cell sits at the intersection of a row and column that collectively display eight of the nine possible variations, that cell's true identity is immediately revealed by the process of elimination. [7, 13]

Key Benefits & Audience Appeal
Codoku alters how the brain processes logical constraints, offering unique advantages over its numerical predecessor:

* Overcoming Math Anxiety: Many individuals shy away from traditional puzzles because numbers feel intimidating. Codoku provides an identical cognitive workout using purely artistic and visual cues.
* Brain Activation: Studies on colour-based puzzle games reveal that tracking vibrant hues activates a broad network across multiple brain lobes. This balances spatial recognition with hard logic.
* Accessibility for All Ages: The visual layout makes the game highly intuitive for children. It acts as an excellent tool for developing early problem-solving skills, and its scale can be adjusted down to a 4 × 4 or 6 × 6 layout for beginners.
* Digital Convenience: Modern digital adaptations feature responsive click-to-select palettes, clear mistake highlighting, and hint mechanisms designed to keep gameplay moving seamlessly without the mess of paper and pencils. [2, 7, 14, 15]

Essential Rules to Remember
* Each color must appear exactly once per horizontal row.
* Each color must appear exactly once per vertical column.
* Each color must appear exactly once per bordered 3 × 3 box.
* Locked starting blocks cannot be modified. [1, 7, 16, 17, 18]

If you want to dive deeper, let me know:

* Would you like tips on designing a physical DIY version using tiles or pegs?
* Are you looking for a python algorithm to automatically solve colour grids?
* Do you want to see how to handle advanced strategies like color-chain linking?

data.name: Bee Buzzing
data.description_full:
Buzz into a cozy little world where hard-working bees do the sorting for you! Bee Buzzing is a relaxing color sort puzzle built around one oddly satisfying idea: pull a colored bee box out of the tray, and watch them fly out to pluck matching cubes from a colorful 3D structure and carry them home to the honeycomb.

Every level starts with a bright voxel structure sitting in the middle of the board, shaped like a rocket, a slice of watermelon, a patterned cube, and more. Nothing is hidden. Your job is simply to clear it all away, cube by cube, until the board is empty and the honeycomb is full.

HOW TO PLAY
- Look at the 3D cube structure and the colors it’s made of.
- Pick a hexagon bee box from the tray, each box shows a number for how many cubes its bees can carry.
- Drop the box onto an empty hex slot and let them pluck every matching cube.
- Choose the right colors in the right order to clear the whole structure and finish the level.
- Plan ahead: empty hex slots are limited, so think before you place.

FEATURES
🐝 Pluck-out color sort gameplay, pull colored bee boxes and watch the cubes disappear
🧩 Bright 3D voxel structures shaped like fun, recognizable objects
🍯 Cute bees that carry cubes home to the honeycomb on the tree
⚡ Handy ×2 speed toggle when you want the bees to hurry
🔨 Helpful boosters, undo a move, hammer away a cube, or use a rocket boost when you’re stuck
📈 Level-by-level progression with a round timer for every stage
🧠 Easy to learn, satisfying to master, a gentle brain teaser for every age

WHY YOU’LL LOVE BEE BUZZING
Bee Buzzing turns a simple color match idea into a calm, satisfying routine. There’s no rush and no clutter, just you, the bees, and the quiet joy of watching a colorful cube structure vanish one piece at a time. Whether you have five minutes or fifty, this cube puzzle is the perfect way to relax, unwind, and give your brain a light, happy workout.

Open a fresh box of bees and start sorting, the hive is waiting!

data.name: Arrow Rush: Tap Away Puzzle
data.description_full:
Every arrow points somewhere. Tap one and it shoots that way, straight off the board, unless something is standing in its path. One order clears the whole thing. Your job is to find it.

That stays simple for about eight levels.

Then the boards get bigger, the arrows get shorter, and the tangles start doubling back on themselves. By level 100 you are sequencing thirty pieces. By level 500 the board has grown past the screen and you are pinching to reach the corners. By level 2,000 there are more than eighty arrows on one board, and exactly one of them can move first.

WHAT YOU ARE UP AGAINST

• 2,000 levels, every one hand-checked and guaranteed solvable
• Six special arrows that break the rules: ice, stone, mud, slime, ghost and chained
• Picture levels that reveal a hidden shape as you clear them
• Giant Labyrinth boards you navigate by pinching and dragging
• Impossible 100, a hundred days of boards built to end runs
• A new Daily Challenge every day, the same board for everyone

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

Relax mode has no timer, no hearts, and no way to lose. Sit on one board for an hour if that is what it takes.

Challenge mode gives you three hearts and takes them seriously. It is not the mode most people finish on.

A HARD PUZZLE, NOT A BUSY ONE

There is no energy meter counting down while you think. No board is unsolvable, so every time you are stuck it is because you have not found the order yet, not because the level was built to stop you. The hint button is there. Most boards do not need it. Some absolutely do.

MAKE IT YOURS

data.name: Junkyard Tycoon: Car Business

🛠️ RESTORE & DEAL IN THE SHOWROOM
Dismantling is only half the fun! Become a master mechanic, upgrade your skills at the Institute, and breathe new life into salvage vehicles. Restore junk cars from zero to pristine condition and display them in your premium Auto Gallery Showroom. Sell complete restored cars to high-paying buyers for ultimate profits.

🏭 RUN MASSIVE FACTORIES & SUPPLY CHAINS
Expand your business beyond the scrapyard. Establish and upgrade 4 unique production factories: Bricks, Concrete, Forestry, and Stone Quarry. Recycle raw scrap metal into advanced construction materials to feed your self-sustaining corporate economy and skyrocket your revenue streams.

data.description_full: KA678Ember is a vertical lightweight puzzle mobile game that splits the picture into droplet‑shaped pieces, allowing players to reassemble them on a mist‑like board. Players drag pieces to the correct positions to score; placing them incorrectly or into occupied slots counts as a mistake, and three mistakes end the round. After completing a round, the difficulty increases to 4×4, with a faster pace and stronger strategic feel. Simple controls make it suitable for short challenges and high‑score sprints.

Train your logic with a sleek path puzzle centered on arrows, planning and precise line drawing. Each arrow links to a full board solution, and only smart path layout lets you wipe all arrows clean.
The more rounds you beat, the more smooth combos and clever solving tricks you’ll unlock.
Whether you have a short spare minute or want to dive into tough brain teasers, Arrow Go! delivers gentle mental training without complicated rules.
How to Play
Check the pointing direction of each arrow tile.
Drag to draw connected lines between matching arrows.
Leave open space to avoid blocking subsequent paths.
Clear all arrow pairs to pass the current level.
Beat stages to unlock harder, trickier puzzle boards.
Smart Hint Prompt
Stuck on a tricky puzzle? Just pause for a moment.
The game will softly highlight one usable arrow pair as a gentle tip, never finishing the puzzle for you.
Path Preview Mode
Turn on path preview to extend every arrow’s direction across the whole grid.
Preview lets you spot crossing conflicts early and make smarter drawing choices before confirming lines.
Custom Visual Themes
Pick from four distinct color sets.
Swap background tones and arrow hues for a brand-new look while keeping puzzle lines clear and readable.
Features
Hundreds of handmade unique puzzle levels.
Clean, lightweight minimalist art style.
Auto intelligent hint prompts.
One-tap path preview toggle.
Four adjustable visual color themes.
Zero time pressure, no rush limits.
Full offline support, play without Wi-Fi.

data.name: Knock Away
data.description_full:
🎯 Blast & Clear – Shoot, Smash, and Unwind! 🎯

If you're looking for a stress‑melting shooting game that still gives your brain a little workout, this is it. Grab your cannon, take aim, and fire away at a platform full of targets. No complicated rules, no endless tutorials – just pure, satisfying demolition. Each level gives you a limited number of shots, so every trigger pull counts. Clear the platform, and you move on to the next challenge. Simple, punchy, and incredibly relaxing.

💥 How It Works
You control a cannon at the bottom of the screen. Above you, a platform is stacked with various objects – wooden crates, ceramic pots, iron barrels, and more. Your job is to knock every single one of them off the platform using your cannonballs. Aim carefully, consider the angle, and fire! When a target gets hit, it tumbles and falls to the ground. Once the platform is completely empty of targets, you've cleared the level. No time limits, no pressure – just you, your cannon, and a pile of things waiting to be smashed.

📦 From Wood to Iron – The Challenge Grows
At first, you'll face lightweight wooden crates that are easy to topple. A single well‑placed shot can send them flying. But as you progress, things get tougher. Ceramic pots are heavier and take more hits to break. Then come iron barrels – they're sturdy, stubborn, and require precise, repeated strikes. And it's not just the materials that change – the targets start stacking higher and higher. Towers of crates, piles of pots, and fortified stacks of barrels make each level a fresh puzzle of angles and force.

⚖️ Weight & Stacking – A Real Test of Aim
The added weight changes everything. A heavy barrel on top of a crate might crush it if you hit the right spot – or it might stay put if you don't. You'll need to think about which target to hit first, which angle sends the most objects tumbling, and how to make the most of your limited ammo. Sometimes a single shot in the right place can trigger a chain reaction, toppling half the platform in one glorious explosion. Other times, you'll need to chip away piece by piece.

🧘 Pure Satisfaction, No Rush
There's no timer breathing down your neck. You can take all the time you need to line up your shot, study the stack, and plan your attack. Each successful hit feels incredibly rewarding – the satisfying crash of breaking objects, the clatter of debris, and the gradual clearing of the platform. It's the kind of game you can play for five minutes or an hour, and it always leaves you feeling relaxed and accomplished.

🏆 Ready to Become a Master Blaster?
With dozens of levels, each more challenging than the last, you'll never run out of things to smash. Progress through wooden villages, ceramic workshops, and iron fortresses. Upgrade your cannon, unlock new ammo types, and prove your aiming skills. Can you clear every platform with the fewest shots possible? Jump in, take aim, and start blasting your stress away – one target at a time! 💣🔥🧨

data.name: Mist Lichen Haven
data.description_full: Mist Lichen Haven is a vertical jungle‑themed multiple‑matching elimination mobile game that blends quick reflexes with mental arithmetic strategy. The board is a 5×4 tropical fruit array, each fruit bearing a number from 2 to 9. Within a 60‑second time limit, players swipe to connect two fruits—when the larger number is exactly a multiple of the smaller one, a jungle pet leaps up to collect the pair and score. A wrong match causes the target fruit to rot and deducts points. Five consecutive correct matches trigger a “Monkey Feast,” doubling the score for a period. Empty slots are filled by fruits falling from above with physics. Simple controls, yet you need to watch the clock, calculate multiples, and maintain combos all at once—perfect for high‑score sprints and sustained strategic challenges.

data.name: 三國觀滄海：水墨風三國戰棋
data.description_full:
【遊戲介紹】
三國戰棋，縱覽滄海
《三國觀滄海》以傳統水墨工筆美術，描摹出令人耳目一新的三國亂世。各位明公將在這亂世繪卷中扮演那個時代割據一方的英雄，用經典戰棋玩法調兵遣將，思當年豪傑之慮，謀當年明公之策，再現當年傳奇之路。

滾滾長江東逝水，浪花淘盡英雄
《三國觀滄海》現已同《三國演義》電視劇主題曲達成正式合作。在此也非常感謝原曲方對我們製作的三國故事的認可。諸位明公將伴隨《滾滾長江東逝水》的旋律，感受沉浸式視·聽·玩體驗，共繪這卷亂世水墨三國。

水墨工筆描摹的三國亂世
狼毫揮灑間，三國亂世徐徐展開。本作採用我們最熟悉的水墨工筆、傳統工筆美術，在遊戲中勾勒出一幅中式畫卷。在您入兗州、平豫州、收徐州的征伐過程中，恍若展開兒時珍藏的連環畫冊。

英雄視角展開的三國百態
諸侯會盟討董，官渡決戰袁紹。在第一個劇本【魏武揮鞭】中，諸位明公將以曹操的第一視角親歷風雲激盪的漢末三國。從舉事發跡到大戰轉折，您將體驗曹操波瀾壯闊的戎馬生涯，細品魏武一生……本次更新至官渡之戰，而以劉備為主角的【匡扶漢室】及更多英雄劇本，也將逐步為大家呈現。

奇謀戰術定勝的戰場棋局
謀定而後動，一計定乾坤。在步步為營的戰棋戰場上，《三國觀滄海》遵循一套敵我雙方共通的合擊系統，兩名武將將敵人夾擊時即可打出合擊。輔以拓寬決策廣度的經典奇謀，敵軍壓境時，可使猛火計火燒連營；攻城難下時，可使洪水計灌城克敵；陷入重圍時，可使奇兵天降援助逆襲……多角度構成立體化的博弈體驗。

酣戰豪雄數合的單挑決戰
斬顏良誅文醜，過五關斬六將。本作在先前版本的單挑對決表演上，更新了單挑環節的手操對戰。還原了演義中的經典單挑場面，溫酒斬華雄的利落斬將、馬超許褚大戰上百回合的巔峰對決……是一場短兵相接，火星四濺；亦是百步穿楊，弓折刀盡，都將由明公專屬的單挑戰術決定。

狼煙已起，墨硯已備，恭候明公執子入局，共繪三國！

【聯繫我們】
FB粉絲團：https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61577529445738

- When you're stuck, the smart hint item gently lights up a safe move without breaking your thinking flow. 💡

On your commute, during a short break – just one minute is enough for a quick mental refresh. If you have more time, hundreds of carefully crafted layouts will keep you engaged. The difficulty ramps up gradually, from simple open patterns to intricate tangles, ensuring a satisfying challenge that never feels boring or frustrating.

Download Arrows Amaze Puzzle now. Plan your routes, protect every water droplet 💧, and slide each arrow away – at your own pace, enjoying the pure pleasure of focused problem‑solving.

The water is calm. The items are stacked. Your cannon is loaded. Welcome to Splash Kingdom — a sun-soaked world of floating stack puzzles, precision cannon shots, and the most satisfying crashes on the water.
Dive into a world where towering stacks of items float on a shimmering sea just waiting to be brought down. Load your cannon, take aim, and fire off the perfect shot — shattering glass bottles, tipping cargo containers, and chipping away at ice blocks, sending them all tumbling into the water in a cascade of satisfying destruction.
Each level is a physics puzzle that rewards clever thinkers. With limited cannon shots, your eagle eyes will spot the weak point in each structure, plan your angle, and pull off chain reactions that collapse entire stacks at once. Heavy steel anchors hold firm while light wooden crates splinter under pressure, and a single wobbling rope coil can bring it all crashing down! The mechanics are easy to pick up and endlessly rewarding to master.
Every impact is tuned to hit just right. The crunch of ice breaking, the clang of tumbling metal, the splash as it all hits the water — pure ASMR bliss. And that feeling when one perfect shot triggers a full collapse never gets old.
But the water has its secrets. From the earliest levels, you'll see this is no mindless tap-fest. Clever layouts, tricky blockers, and new item types force you to rethink your approach with each challenge. Structures grow more complex, angles get trickier, and the puzzle logic deepens the further you go. But watching it all crash into the sea — with a fresh new stack rising in its place — makes every shot worth it!
Compete with players around the world, climb the leaderboard, and prove your aim is the sharpest at sea. Every cleared level and perfectly executed chain reaction earns you rewards and brings you closer to the top.
Splash Kingdom is your new go-to for physics puzzle satisfaction: a beautifully crafted water world filled with clever puzzles, powerful boosters, and the pure joy of watching structures collapse exactly the way you planned.
Every shot is a chance to crash through. Every cleared level feels like a perfect wave. So load up, take aim, and start the most satisfying physics puzzle on the water.
Download Splash Kingdom today and feel the crash!

data.name: Arrow Smash: Earn Cash
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Smash: Earn Cash, the minimalist puzzle game where logic, precision, and careful planning are your only tools. Every level presents a grid filled with arrows – your task is to extract them all, one by one, without ever causing a collision. It sounds simple, but each move matters. One wrong step and you lose a heart! Solve puzzles, earn rewards, and watch your cash grow.

Gameplay Overview:

Each puzzle presents you with a grid of colorful arrows pointing in different directions. To solve the puzzle, you must tap and extract each arrow in the correct order, ensuring that no two arrows collide along their paths. As you progress, the grids grow larger, the paths become more complex, and your planning skills are pushed to the limit. Every successful clear earns you rewards – the smarter you play, the more you earn!

Key Features:

Simple Yet Deep Mechanics: Easy to understand, but increasingly challenging to master. Every level requires careful thought and strategic sequencing.

Earn Real Cash: Solve puzzles and complete challenges to unlock real cash rewards. The more levels you clear, the more you earn!

Thousands of Handcrafted Levels: Each level is meticulously designed to offer a unique challenge. With thousands of puzzles to solve, you'll never run out of brain-teasing fun.

Minimalist & Clean Design: A distraction-free visual style that lets you focus entirely on the puzzle. Beautiful colors and smooth animations make every move a pleasure.

Relaxing, No-Pressure Gameplay: No timers, no rushing, no stress. Play at your own pace and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.

Hint System: Stuck on a tough level? Use hints to get a gentle nudge in the right direction and keep progressing.

Heart System: You start each puzzle with a set of hearts. Make a mistake and lose one – clear the grid without losing them all to achieve a perfect victory and bigger rewards!

Perfect for Quick Sessions or Long Play: Whether you have five minutes or an hour, Arrow Smash: Earn Cash fits your schedule.

Why You'll Love It:

Arrow Smash: Earn Cash is the perfect game for players who love to exercise their brain without the pressure of timers or fast reflexes. It's just you, the grid, and the satisfying challenge of finding the perfect sequence. Every solved puzzle brings a sense of accomplishment and real rewards – and every mistake teaches you to plan better. It's calm, it's clever, and it's completely addictive.

Download now and see if you can clear the grid without losing a single heart – and start earning today!

data.name: Jigsaw Fall: Solitaire Puzzle
data.description_full:
🧩 Build the picture. Clear the board. Keep the puzzle moving!



Jigsaw Fall: Solitaire Puzzle is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle game with a clever falling-piece twist. Match picture pieces, complete connected sections, and make room as new tiles drop onto the board.



Combining the visual satisfaction of a picture puzzle, the thoughtful planning of a solitaire puzzle, and the space management of a block puzzle, Jigsaw Fall creates a puzzle experience that changes with every move.



🎮 How to Play



• 🧩 Place picture fragments in open spaces

• 🔗 Connect neighboring pieces that belong together

• ✨ Complete picture sections to clear them

• ⬇️ Watch the remaining tiles fall into new positions

• 🧠 Plan ahead and protect valuable board space

• 🖼️ Keep matching until the entire picture is complete



🌟 A Jigsaw Puzzle That Keeps Moving



This is more than a traditional jigsaw puzzle. Each completed section disappears, causing the pieces above it to fall and reshape the board. One clever match can create new possibilities, while every placement affects your next move.



♠️ Solitaire Puzzle Strategy



Every level is a personal challenge between you and the board. Choose where to place each piece, decide which section to finish first, and plan carefully to avoid running out of room.



Simple controls make this solitaire puzzle easy to learn, while changing layouts bring new choices and satisfying strategic depth.



🖼️ Picture Puzzles with a Falling Twist



Piece together colorful scenes one section at a time. As matching fragments connect and completed areas clear, new pieces fall into place. Each picture puzzle becomes an evolving challenge instead of a static board.



🧱 Smart Block Puzzle Decisions



Finding matching pieces is only half the challenge. You must also manage the available spaces like a block puzzle. Keep useful areas open, anticipate where pieces will land, and choose the best order for every move.



😌 Relaxing and Satisfying Gameplay



Enjoy smooth falling animations, rewarding clears, and the calming rhythm of placing pieces in the right position. Play a quick level during a break or spend more time solving relaxing puzzles at your own pace.



✨ Game Features



• 🧩 A fresh combination of jigsaw and solitaire gameplay

• ⬇️ Satisfying matching, clearing, and falling mechanics

• 🎨 Beautiful picture puzzles with colorful scenes

• 🧱 Strategic board and space management

• 👆 Simple and intuitive controls

• 😌 Relaxing puzzle games for adults and casual players

• 🧠 Brain-teasing levels that encourage observation and planning

• 📱 Offline puzzle gameplay you can enjoy anywhere



🚀 Easy to Start, Rewarding to Master



Jigsaw Fall is made for players who enjoy jigsaw puzzles, solitaire games, block puzzles, tile-matching games, picture puzzles, and relaxing brain games.



There are no complicated rules to learn. Study the picture, place the pieces, and find the smartest way to keep the board moving. As you progress, new layouts introduce more interesting decisions and deeper puzzle strategies.



🏆 Can you complete every picture before the board fills up?



Download Jigsaw Fall: Solitaire Puzzle and discover a satisfying picture puzzle where every clear brings a new challenge!
data.description_short: Match jigsaw pieces, clear the board, and enjoy relaxing solitaire puzzles.

There are 10 weapons in the game. Enemies may drop weapons upon death, and you can switch weapons from the Supply panel:

| Weapon | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Pistol | Default weapon, unlimited ammo |
| Shotgun | Area-of-effect spread |
| Gatling Gun | High fire rate |
| Scattergun | Scatter shot |
| Flamethrower | Continuous flame damage |
| Laser | Sustained laser beam |
| Sniper Rifle | High damage, long range |
| Particle Cannon | Particle-based weapon |
| Rocket Launcher | Explosive area damage |
| Lightning Orb | Lightning chain attack |

Weapons can be unlocked by clearing levels, or trialed by watching ads in the Supply panel.

### Power-ups

A power-up or weapon drops every 10 kills. Available power-ups include:

- **Impenetrable Shield**: Immune to damage for 10 seconds
- **Speed Boost**: 1.5x movement speed
- **Heal**: Restore 30% of max HP
- **Gold Multiplier**: Double gold from kills
- **Magnet**: Attract nearby pickups

### Enemies & Levels

- Multiple levels await — clear all enemies in each level to advance.
- A variety of enemy types, including powerful Boss enemies.
- Each level has two phases: Phase 1 spawns enemies slowly, Phase 2 greatly increases the spawn rate.
- A special animation warns you before a Boss appears.
- Enemies chase the player and attack automatically; some fire projectiles.

### Victory, Defeat & Revival

- **Victory**: Eliminate every enemy in the level.
- **Defeat**: Your character's HP drops to zero.
- **Revival**: After death, you enter a revival screen. Watch an ad to revive within the countdown timer. You'll respawn with full HP and a high-tier weapon (3x ammo).

### Gold & Progression

- Earn gold from kills and level completion rewards.
- Spend gold to upgrade weapons and character stats.
- At the results screen, watch an ad to multiply your gold (up to 10x via a lucky wheel).

### Tips

- Use power-ups wisely — they can turn the tide of battle.
- Check the Supply panel frequently and switch weapons to adapt to different situations.
- Watching ads gives you extra resources and makes progression easier.

You have 50 seconds to reach 1,500 points, so every move counts. Consecutive matches help you score faster, while longer chains unlock stronger special candies. With bright cartoon visuals, smooth animations, and satisfying chain reactions, every round offers a fun and rewarding puzzle challenge.

Embark on a mesmerizing interstellar puzzle journey with Fill n Sort: Cosmic Color Quest!

Are you ready to test your brain and conquer the galaxy? Dive into a beautifully designed cosmic space arena where your mission is to sort alien liquids, match vibrant neon colors, and bring order to the universe—one test tube at a time!

Hundreds of Cosmic Levels: Progress through an expansive campaign map with thousands of challenging levels. Start with smooth operations and advance to mind-bending cosmic anomalies!

data.name: Bash Fiesta
data.description_full:
Bash Fiesta is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where you destroy structures by triggering bombs on a connected grid.

Instead of placing objects, the game focuses on interacting with structures and using physics-based reactions to clear each level. Every stage requires timing, logic, and strategic thinking to find the best way to eliminate all targets.

● SIMPLE GAMEPLAY
Tap or trigger structures to activate bombs and destroy connected elements.
Clear all targets on the board to complete the level.
Each action creates chain reactions that affect the entire structure.
Easy to understand but deeply strategic gameplay.

● HOW IT WORKS
Each level is built around physics-based destruction mechanics.
You must find the optimal sequence of interactions to trigger chain reactions.
Some structures collapse instantly, while others require multiple hits or indirect impacts.
As levels progress, layouts become more complex and require careful planning.
Every decision matters and wrong timing can prevent full clearance.

● PROGRESSIVE DIFFICULTY
Early levels introduce basic destruction mechanics.
Later levels add layered structures and more complex interactions.
Advanced stages require precise timing and strategic chain reactions.

● GAME FEATURES
Physics-based destruction puzzle
Chain reaction mechanics
No time limits
Offline supported
Increasing difficulty levels
Clean and satisfying visual effects

Relax and enjoy a satisfying destruction puzzle experience.
Download Bash Fiesta and master the art of strategic explosions.

data.name: Bolt Master
data.description_full: Bolt Master is a satisfying and deeply addictive screw puzzle game where the challenge is deceptively simple — unscrew the bolts in the right order, free the planks, and clear the board. Every level presents you with a wooden board filled with overlapping planks held together by screws and bolts. Your job is to figure out which bolt to remove first, which plank it frees, and how that cascades into clearing the rest of the puzzle. Get the order wrong and you get stuck. Get it right and the whole thing unravels in a deeply satisfying chain that keeps you coming back level after level across the full level-based journey. The core mechanic is all about reading the board before you act. Planks stack on top of each other in layers, and a bolt can be holding multiple pieces at once. Tapping a bolt only removes it when the pieces it connects are free to move — if something is blocked above or pinned by another bolt, you have to work around it first. This creates a chain-thinking puzzle loop where every move affects the next one, and the real skill is learning to see several steps ahead. The puzzle never rushes you and never randomizes on you — everything on the board is there for a reason, every bolt placement is deliberate, and the correct sequence always exists. Finding it is the entire game, and the moment it clicks is one of the most satisfying feelings in mobile puzzles. In the early levels, the logic is gentle and guiding, teaching you the rules through clean, open layouts with a small number of planks and clearly readable bolt placements. These levels are designed to build intuition — the way a bolt pin holds two overlapping pieces together, the way removing one plank from the top of a stack cascades into freeing everything beneath it, the way a seemingly stuck configuration always has one piece that was blocking everything else. Once that intuition is in place, Bolt Master starts building on it. Mid-level stages introduce more planks per board, deeper layering between pieces, and bolt placements that require you to look at the full board rather than just the immediate piece you want to free. The straightforward top-down stack logic from the early levels gives way to arrangements where pieces overlap in multiple directions and a single bolt might be the last thing pinning together three separate sections of the board simultaneously. By the time the level-based progression reaches its later stages, Bolt Master is presenting boards that demand genuine spatial reasoning and patience in equal measure. Custom plank shapes replace the simple rectangular pieces from early levels, creating overlaps and pin points that are harder to read at a glance. Layered configurations mean that the piece you need to move is often buried under two or three other pieces that each have their own bolt dependencies. Tight board arrangements leave little margin for exploratory moves — every tap needs to serve a purpose because tapping the wrong bolt in the wrong order locks out the move sequence you needed and forces you to rethink the entire board from scratch. These levels are where Bolt Master fully reveals itself as a deep spatial puzzle game rather than a casual tap-through experience. The level map gives you a clear visual path through the full progression, with each completed puzzle unlocking the next and showing exactly how far you have come. That map is one of the best motivators in the game — seeing the trail of cleared levels behind you and the ones still ahead creates a pull that makes finishing just one more stage before putting the phone down genuinely difficult to resist. The progression is smooth and continuous, never spiking unfairly but always asking a little more from you than the stage before it did. Bolt Master is built specifically for Android with smooth touch controls that make unscrewing and tapping feel tactile and responsive.

data.name: 天天拼詞王
data.description_full:
《天天拼詞王》是一款結合了中國古典美學與文字拆解樂趣的休閒益智遊戲！在這裡，你需要打破對文字的固有認知，發揮極致的觀察力與想像力，從一個看似簡單的漢字中，找出隱藏在筆畫間的其他「常用字」。
🎮 遊戲特色
🧠 顛覆認知的文字解謎
「字中找字」的核心玩法，將漢字的部首與筆畫重新解構。每一個筆畫、每一個轉折都可能拼湊出全新的字意，一字拆出千萬意，徹底活化你的大腦思維！

📜 清新雅致的古典美學
遊戲採用溫暖的米色紙張背景與傳統的毛筆筆觸設計。在古色古香的視覺氛圍中，讓你一邊解謎、一邊享受沉浸式的靜心體驗。

🏆 海量關卡，成就感滿滿
從簡單的「小試牛刀」到充滿挑戰的「無懈可擊」，豐富的關卡設計讓你百玩不膩。成功通關還能獲得金幣獎勵與專屬成就評價，一步步成為真正的拼詞王者！

💡 貼心提示，不怕卡關
遇到找不到的字怎麼辦？別擔心！遊戲內建實用的「提示」功能，在你江郎才盡時助你一臂之力，輕鬆點破盲點。

適合什麼樣的你？
👉 喜歡文字遊戲、成語接龍或填字謎的玩家。
👉 想在通勤、休閒時間活動一下大腦的上班族與學生。
👉 想要培養觀察力，鍛煉腦力，重新認識漢字之美的各年齡層玩家。

現在就下載《天天拼詞王》，從一筆一畫中發掘驚喜，挑戰你的漢字極限吧！

data.name: One Big Word
data.description_full:
Welcome to One Big Word, a word search with a twist! At the heart of every board lies one big word, and the whole game is about tracking it down. How far will your vocabulary take you?

ONE BOARD, ONE BIG WORD
One Big Word isn't an ordinary word game. It's a chase with a real destination. Every level hides one big word among the letters, and your mission is to reach it. Close in on it by spotting the smaller words tucked inside; every find brings you closer, until the big one has nowhere left to hide.

PLAY YOUR WAY
No countdown, no pressure. Just you and the letters. Move at your own speed and shape your own approach. The only risk: once the "one more level" feeling sets in, stopping isn't easy.

THOUSANDS OF LEVELS TO CRACK
Work your way through thousands of boards, each holding a new big word to uncover. Finish one and the next is ready. Bonuses and hidden words appear along the way, and curiosity is always rewarded.

PICK YOUR STRATEGY
Every board is a fresh grid of scrambled letters, and the extra ones are there to challenge you. Go straight for the big word, or clear the smaller ones until it comes into view? The strategy is yours, and there's more than one way to win.

SPEND YOUR HINTS WISELY
When a word refuses to show itself, hints are there to help, as long as you spend them wisely. Every word you find earns points, and how you use them is entirely up to you. Played at the right moment, even the most stubborn word gives itself away.

LEVEL UP YOUR VOCABULARY
Familiar words and first-time discoveries share every board. How many will you recognize at a glance, and how many will be new additions? The real contest is with yourself, and every big word is a win.

One Big Word is made for everyone who takes word games seriously and has fun doing it. Your first big word is already waiting.
data.description_short: Every level hides one big word. Find the small words to reach it.

data.name: Serpent Survivor
data.description_full:
Serpent Survivor takes you into the Tidevein Expanse, a primal fantasy realm where ancient currents flow through the sea, earth, forests, and every living creature.

For generations, these Tideveins kept the world in balance. Now, the First Oath is raising ritual pillars across the land, forcing sacred Coilvein Serpents from their slumber. Mysterious mists spread through the wilderness, and dinosaurs abandon their territories.

Tidewatch Village stands between the coast and the untamed wild. As its leader, you must rebuild the settlement, recruit mighty dinosaurs, and unite heroes from Tribe, Wild, and Dino.

Build your forces and confront the colossal serpents before the First Oath seizes control of the Tidevein Expanse.

[Build Tidewatch Village]
Transform a fragile coastal settlement into a powerful stronghold. Gather resources, construct facilities, reinforce defenses, develop technologies, and expand across a dangerous land.

[Unlock Ancient Knowledge]
Study ancient carvings and lost knowledge recovered from ruins. Unlock new buildings, production methods, combat abilities, and exploration techniques as Tidewatch Village grows into a center of civilization.

[Explore the Tidevein Expanse]
Send teams to collect supplies, investigate ruins, and uncover the source of the mist. Cross coasts, ancient forests, volcanic ridges, frozen highlands, crystal mountains, and forgotten ritual grounds. Every region offers new resources, enemies, and secrets.

[Unite Three Factions]
Recruit heroes from Tribe, Wild, and Dino. Combine human warriors, indigenous mystics, hunters, beast riders, dinosaurs, and colossal primal creatures. Build powerful formations and use faction counters to defeat stronger enemies.

Old rivalries divide them. Only a capable leader can turn them into a united front.

[Command Dinosaurs and Ancient Beasts]
Some beasts can be tamed and brought into battle. Others have been driven mad by the mist or the First Oath. Track them, challenge them, and use their primal power to defend your territory.

[Challenge Serpents and Dragons]
Coilvein Serpents are sacred guardians bound to the land. The First Oath has awakened and twisted them into instruments of destruction.

Enter corrupted ruins, break ritual seals, and confront ancient serpents. Face the mightier Crowncoil Drakes in elite challenges, where victory restores balance to an entire region.

[Forge Alliances or Fight for Power]
Other leaders are building settlements and expanding their influence. Form alliances, defend strategic routes, occupy valuable resource regions, and fight alongside your allies.

Cooperate against powerful enemies, or compete with rival alliances for control of the Tidevein Expanse. Strategy, diplomacy, and strength will decide who reaches the heart of the world.

[Claim the Tidevein Sanctum]
When the great cycle begins, the mist grows stronger, ancient beasts awaken, and the paths to Mount First Coil are revealed.

At its summit stands the Tidevein Sanctum, the center of the world's ancient order. Alliances will march toward the mountain, and the First Oath will reveal its true purpose. Only the strongest can claim the right to guard the Tideveins.

Build your settlement. Recruit your heroes. Command ancient beasts. Unite your allies.

data.name: Grid Fit
data.description_full:
Looking for a quiet way to sharpen your mind and unwind? Welcome to Grid Fit. This is a gentle spatial logic puzzle where every block reacts to your moves with its own expressive face. Your objective is simple: drag out rectangles based on the numbers on the grid and find the exact space each emotion needs to feel balanced.
✨ Why You Will Love Grid Fit
• Expressive, Reactive Blocks: The grid is alive with feelings! As you drag to form shapes, the faces inside react in real time. Watch them show worry when cramped, surprise when stretched too far, or calm satisfaction when given the correct space.

• Mind Bending Challenges: Start with simple shapes and advance to massive brain teasers. As you progress, you will encounter tricky obstacles like hidden numbers (?) and locked tiles (🔒) that require clever strategies to solve.

• Calming, Focused Gameplay: Designed with clean visuals and minimal interruptions. Sink into a steady, relaxing flow state as you work through each level at your own pace.

• Helpful Boosters: Stuck on a super hard level? Use the lightbulb hint to instantly reveal the perfect fit for a stubborn block and keep the fun going.

•A Low Pressure Environment: There are no stressful timers or harsh penalties. Take your time to analyze the grid, follow the clues, and let the board puzzle together naturally.

💡 How to Play
• Give Each Emotion its Space: The number on each face indicates exactly how many grid squares its rectangle must cover.
• Drag to Fit: Swipe to stretch the block into a square or rectangle.
• Establish Boundaries: Each shape must contain exactly one expressive face, and territories cannot overlap.
• Solve the Puzzle: When the entire grid is correctly filled with the right sized shapes, the board clears and rewards you with a screen of fully satisfied, happy faces!

🧠 Benefits of Playing
• Interactive Logic: The changing micro expressions of the blocks make solving numeric grids intuitive and visually engaging.
• Gentle Brain Training: Quietly exercises your spatial reasoning and logical deduction skills without overwhelming your mind.
• Satisfying Order: Experience the quiet satisfaction of turning a scattered grid of numbers into an organized, harmonious board of perfectly balanced expressions.

Grid Fit is a straightforward logic puzzle built for quiet moments. Easy to learn yet offering a steady mental workout, it is a soothing way to spend a few minutes a day bringing order to a world of colorful emotions.
Download today and find your flow!
data.description_short: Solve relaxing logic puzzles and balance block emotions in Grid Fit.

data.name: Stellar Grid
data.description_full:
Stellar Grid is a relaxing cosmic logic puzzle where every star must be placed with perfect precision.

Each level is a glowing star map divided into colored regions. Your goal is to complete the constellation by following three simple rules:

- Each color region has exactly one star
- Each row has exactly one star
- Each column has exactly one star
- Stars cannot touch, even diagonally

Tap a cell to mark an X. Double tap to place a star. Every choice matters, because a wrong mark ends the attempt. Slow down, scan the board, and solve each puzzle through pure deduction.

Stellar Grid is designed for players who enjoy calm but challenging logic games. Early levels help you learn the rules quickly, while later puzzles require sharper observation, careful elimination, and full-board thinking.

Features:
- Elegant star-themed puzzle boards
- Main level progression with increasing difficulty
- Clear logic rules that are easy to learn
- No timer and no pressure
- Tap to mark X, double tap to place a star
- Atmospheric space visuals
- Relaxing background music and sound effects
- No ads
- No in-app purchases

data.name: Age of Spirits
data.description_full:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? The ancestors are watching. The Old Ones are stirring. The spark of all that is to come rests in your hands. Do you have the will to lead the first tribe into a new age?

GAME FEATURES

Awaken Savages, Bestow Wisdom: Bring untamed savages from the deep Wilds to your hearth-fire and awaken them as villagers. Assign your people to every post that matters, gathering, hunting, crafting, and tending the rites. Watching each pair of hands turn raw labor into the resources that grow your tribe.

Lead Expeditions, Claim the Spoils: Command your heroes on expeditions deep into ancestral grounds. Face perilous trials in turn-based combat, defeat champions of the dark, and bring home precious bounties and the rare materials no settlement can rise without.

Summon Legendary Heroes: Summon spirit-touched champions, such as fierce hunters, far-sighted wizards, and bone-clad guardians, to serve as the heroes of your tribe. Promote and equip them with ancestral weapons and ritual gear, then send your strongest to lead every march and stand at the front of every fight.

Build Your Tribe from a Single Fire: Raise your settlement from a circle of stones into a thriving tribe. Kindle the central hearth, consecrate altars of wisdom and faith, sink quarries and woodyards, train new warriors, and upgrade every structure to unlock new units, rites, and strength.

Challenge Across the World Map: March your armies across a vast living world. Lay claim to resource grounds, raid rival tribes, contest sacred lands, defeat field bosses, and write your name on the map in flame and stone.

Join Forces with Alliances: Form alliances with players from across the world. Coordinate strategies, share resources, defend each other's lands, and wage large-scale battles together against rival forces.

SPECIAL NOTES
· This game includes random-item purchases.
· Network connection is required.
· Privacy Policy: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/
· Terms of Use: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/terms_of_use

data.name: Mahjong Frenzy
data.description_full:
Mahjong Frenzy** is a **Mahjong Solitaire** (also known as Shanghai Mahjong) match-and-eliminate puzzle game. The goal is to clear all tiles from a 3D stacked layout by matching identical pairs. The game features **825 levels** across **9 chapters**, along with daily challenges, leaderboards, and achievement systems.

### Basic Rules

#### 1. Objective
Remove all mahjong tiles from the board by finding and matching **two identical tiles** within the time limit. When you match a pair, both tiles disappear from the board. Clear all tiles to pass the level.

#### 2. Tile Selection (Movability Rules)
Not all tiles can be clicked at once. A tile is **selectable** only when:

- **No tiles are stacked on top of it** — the four positions on the layer above (Z+1 layer) must all be empty.
- **At least one side (left or right) is clear** — if a tile has adjacent tiles on both its left and right sides, it is blocked and cannot be selected.

- **Gray tiles** are blocked/covered and cannot be clicked.
- **White/bright tiles** are free and can be selected.

#### 3. Matching
- Click on a selectable tile to select it (it will be highlighted).
- Click on another identical tile to match and remove the pair.
- If the two selected tiles are not identical, the selection resets.

#### 4. Timer & Scoring
- Each level has a **countdown timer**. Initial time = **number of tiles × 3 seconds**.
- There are **3 stars** on the progress bar that break as time passes:
- **3 Stars**: Remaining time > 50%
- **2 Stars**: Remaining time between 25% and 50%
- **1 Star**: Remaining time < 25%
- **Game Over**: Time runs out (0% remaining)
- The last **10 seconds** trigger a flashing warning.

#### 5. Shuffle Mechanism
- When no matching pairs are available on the board, the game will **auto-shuffle**.

#### Daily Challenge

#### Friend Battle
- Compete with friends via the **leaderboard**.
- Rankings are based on total stars earned.

### Power-ups & Items

### Achievements & Tasks

| Task | Requirement |
|------|-------------|
| Watch Ad ×1 | Watch 1 ad |
| Watch Ad ×2 | Watch 2 ads |
| Pass 5 Levels | Complete 5 levels |
| Pass 10 Levels | Complete 10 levels |
| Pass 15 Levels | Complete 15 levels |

| Pass 50 Levels | Complete 50 levels |

### Leaderboard
- **World Rank**: Global player rankings.
- **Friend Rank**: Rankings among your friends.
- Ranking is determined by **total star count**.

data.name: Weenie Mania
data.description_full:
Weenie Mania is a 2D side-scrolling platform runner for mobile devices. Players control a cute sausage dog (hot dog) character through kitchen-themed levels — running, jumping, collecting coins, dodging obstacles and enemies, and reaching the finish line to clear each stage.

---

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard | Touch |
|--------|----------|-------|
| Move Left | `A` / `←` | Left button on screen |
| Move Right | `D` / `→` | Right button on screen |
| Jump | `W` / `↑` | Jump button on screen |

- **Double Jump**: The character can jump once more while in mid-air (up to 2 jumps total).
- **Virtual Joystick**: A virtual joystick is available on touch devices for finer control.

---

## Game Objectives

- **Win Condition**: Guide the sausage dog from the starting point, traverse platforms and obstacles, and touch the finish flag (prop type `Z`) at the end of the level.
- **Lose Condition**:
- Touching an enemy or fire.
- Falling off the bottom of the screen (y < -1560).
- **Collection Goal**: Gather as many coins as possible in each level to accumulate wealth and purchase new skins.

---

## Level System

- The game includes **31 pre-designed levels** (Level 1 ~ Level 31) with progressively increasing difficulty.
- After clearing Level 30, **Endless Mode** is unlocked, where the system randomly picks levels from range 11 ~ 31 for unlimited play.
- A **tutorial guide** is triggered on the first entry into Level 1, walking the player through basic controls step by step.

---

## In-Level Props

| Icon | Name | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| 🏁 | Start Point (Y) | Player's initial spawn position |
| 🚩 | Finish Point (Z) | Touch to clear the level |
| 🪙 | Coin (L) | Collect to earn coins for buying skins |
| 🥣 | Bowl (K) | Normal platform — stand and jump on it |
| 🍽️ | Plate (J) | Normal platform (used as tutorial marker) |
| 💔 | Cracked Plate (N) | Breaks upon contact; regenerates after 10 seconds |
| 📦 | Elevated Platform (E) | Static platform |
| 🚰 | Sink (B) | Static obstacle or platform |
| 🍴 | Fork (A) | Obstacle — cannot pass through |
| 🔪 | Knife (I) | Obstacle — cannot pass through |
| 🔥 | Gas Stove (G) | Periodically shoots fire — touch = instant death |
| 🗄️ | Shelf (M) | Large platform |
| 🔮 | Portal (O) | Appears in pairs — touch teleports to the partner portal |
| 👩 | Lady Enemy (Q) | Patrols left and right; touch triggers a slap animation and death |
| 🛢️ | Oil (H) | Touching greatly boosts speed (max 1000); normal speed resumes after leaving |
| 🧱 | Decoration (X) | No collision — purely cosmetic |

---

## Enemies & Hazards

1. **Lady Enemy (Q)**: Patrols left and right within a fixed range — contact results in instant death.
2. **Flame Jet (G)**: Gas stove props periodically emit fire jets — touching fire results in instant death.
3. **Bottomless Pit**: Falling below the screen boundary (y < -1560) causes death.

---

## Character Skins

The game offers multiple sausage dog skins powered by Spine skeletal animation, with four animations: idle, run, jump, and death.

| Skin | Price | How to Obtain |
|------|-------|---------------|
| Default | Free | Unlocked from start |
| Skin One | 10 Coins | Purchase in shop |
| Skin Two | 50 Coins | Purchase in shop |
| Skin Three | 100 Coins | Purchase in shop |

---

## Economy System

### Coins
- Collected from coins (prop L) scattered throughout levels.
- Awarded as a level-clear bonus.
- Earn extra coins by watching rewarded video ads (+5 per watch).
- Choose "Watch ad to return to lobby" after clearing a level for a **3× coin reward**.
- Used to purchase character skins in the shop.

### Stamina
- **Maximum Stamina**: 25 points.
- **Cost per game**: 5 stamina points.
- **Auto Recovery**: 1 point every 180 seconds (3 minutes).
- Stamina continues to accumulate while offline.
- When stamina is low, watch a rewarded video ad to refill 10 stamina points.

data.name: Emerald Flower
data.description_full:
Emerald Flower is a survival-RPG that tells the story of a child who lost everything in a war, where your choices lead to multiple different endings.
Gather materials from the environment using the crafting and inventory system to create useful items.
Choose how to treat the characters you meet and alter their fates.
Every character you encounter in this fallen civilization matters. From an old man offering advice to a janitor, everyone has a story to tell.

Experience this intimate yet brutal narrative in depth with 2D retro pixel art graphics.

Damlama Government Classified Archive Records: Emerald Flower Project
Biological Origin & Reproduction:
Emerald Flower (Stapelia Smaragdina) is a parasitic plant originating from the Homo Heidelbergensis era. This species utilizes mammals to reproduce. Its transmission strategy relies on attracting humans with its mesmerizing fragrance. When the host inhales the fragrance, microscopic seeds attach to the olfactory nerve and the host unknowingly leaves the area.

The seed penetrates the brain, feeding on glucose, and extends its roots to the brainstem. Microscopic nanofibers seep into synaptic gaps, taking control of the mammal's instincts. At the end of a roughly 2-week process, the subject feels the urge to feed four times more than normal and to remain unclothed.

Stages of Infection:
There is no point of return at this stage. The host must remain emotionally stable; sudden emotions such as fear or intense happiness trigger the flower. If the host remains stable, the flower spreads throughout the body. However, if activated before fully spreading, it constricts the Carotid Artery (Arteria Carotis), cutting off cerebral blood flow and killing the host. 3 hours after death, the flower blooms through the mouth and nose. It dies if it fails to find a new host within 1 week. If a living being approaches the corpse, the flower releases seeds into the air, restarting the cycle.

Should We Be Concerned?
Humanity brought this nightmare under control years ago, burning all known instances to extinction. Only a single seed is kept secured in a high-security laboratory. Every year, we commemorate the first week of August as "Emerald Flower Awareness Week."

Archive Revisions
** (Revision 1) 12/02/2018**
The final seed and genetic codes of Emerald Flower were lost in an attack on the laboratory. A reward of 15 Million Rayet will be paid to anyone providing information.

** (Revision 2) 04/08/2018**
The Alpu Government claimed responsibility for the theft. They announced that the flower's sap functions as a fuel source 20 times more efficient than petroleum. While the world celebrates an energy revolution, our government pressures Alpu over unethical experiments. However, the international community accuses us of merely trying to preserve our oil dominance.

** (Revision 3) 25/01/2020**
Our government took action and launched Operation Lightning on Alpu, destroying the laboratory. Documents were destroyed and specimens seized. However, hundreds of thousands of civilians perished in the resulting fires. The world condemns us.

** (Revision 4) 30/06/2020**
State representatives united at the "Damlama's Rope" congress to declare war against us. The Damlama Government is now officially at war with the entire world.

** (Revision 5) 02/01/2021**
We are in the 5th month of war; the government fell in the 3rd month. Soldiers are committing massacres everywhere. This is now pure revenge. They threw my neighbor out of a window just for spilling coffee on a soldier. I beat up a grocer to steal tomatoes to feed my 2-year-old son. I took a beating, but I am trying to survive with my family.

Use the Auto Paint button to quickly camouflage your character. Auto Paint uses the environment behind you to help your character match nearby colors and patterns. Choose your hiding place carefully, because even perfect camouflage will not help if a Seeker notices you moving.

PLAY PROP HUNT MODE
Discover Prop Hunt gameplay and use objects, decorations, walls, and other parts of the environment to your advantage. Find a clever hiding place, match your surroundings, and use camouflage to fool the Seekers. Stay hidden until the timer ends and prove that you have chosen the perfect spot.

PLAY AS A SEEKER
As a Seeker, your goal is to search the entire map and find all hidden players. Look carefully at walls, corners, objects, decorations, and unusual shapes. Hiders may be painted to match the environment and could be hiding directly in front of you. You have five minutes to find every Hider before the timer reaches zero.

SURVIVE AS A HIDER
As a Hider, you must remain hidden until the end of the match. Find a smart location, paint your character, stay quiet, and avoid attracting attention. Seekers will inspect every part of the map, so both positioning and camouflage are important. Survive until the countdown ends to win the round.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Join online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt matches with other players. Compete as a Hider or Seeker, discover new hiding strategies, and test whether your camouflage can fool real opponents. Play online with friends or join multiplayer matches with players from around the world.

data.name: Captain Smash
data.description_full:
Captain Smash is a bossy orange pirate cat with one rule on his ship: nothing stays standing. See that stack of crates, barrels, and jars piled up on his deck? He wants it gone, and he's handing you the cannon to do it.

Here's how it works. Tap to fire, and knock the whole pile down. One finger, easy to pick up whenever you've got a minute. You only get so many cannonballs each level, so you can't just blast away. Every stack has to come down before you run out, which turns each level into a fun little puzzle.

The best part is what happens when stuff breaks. Wood splinters, ice cracks and shatters, stone chips off, and jars burst in a splash of color across the sand. Every shot is satisfying, and you'll want to line up the next one right away.

The Captain isn't out there alone. He's got a wide-eyed black crew cat who isn't so sure about all this, and a little blue bird who won't stop chirping. You fire, they cheer, and the Captain takes the credit.

Levels get trickier as you go, with tighter angles and tougher bonus rounds when you want a real challenge. Earn coins along the way and grab boosters for the piles that just won't budge.

• One finger — tap to fire
• Knock down crates, barrels, cans, jars, and blocks
• Wood, ice, stone, and glass each break their own way
• Captain Smash, his crew cat, and a little blue bird
• Coins and boosters for the stubborn stacks
• Trickier levels and harder bonus rounds

Free smash game. The Captain's deck is a mess — grab the cannon and smash it clean.

data.name: VectorVoid: CubeNull
data.description_full:
Welcome to VectorVoid: CubeNull. Six faces. A web of arrows. One rule that changes everything: an arrow can only fall when its path ahead is clear. Step by step, line by line, unravel the tangle across every face of the cube until nothing remains. It looks simple — until you realize every move you make ripples across the entire cube.
What Makes VectorVoid: CubeNull Special:
A Puzzle of Pure Sequence This is not about speed or reflexes. Every arrow on the cube is locked behind another arrow's path. The only way out is forward: find the arrow with a clear trail, remove it, and watch as new paths open across the cube. Every decision is a thread in a larger web. One wrong move and the whole puzzle locks up — forcing you to rethink everything from the beginning.
Six Faces, One Connected Challenge The arrows aren't isolated on individual faces — they cross edges, connect surfaces, and weave the entire cube into a single inseparable puzzle. Rotate the cube, inspect every angle, trace each line from end to end. The solution lives not on one face, but across all six. You're not solving a surface. You're solving a volume.
Where Logic Meets Spatial Intuition VectorVoid: CubeNull trains two parts of your brain at once. You need cold logic to reason through the sequence of removals: if this arrow falls, which path opens next? And you need spatial intuition to track lines across edges and around corners, holding the full 3D picture in your mind. Every level is a workout for both.
Minimalist Design, Maximum Focus Clean lines. Soft colors. No flashing effects, no timers, no pressure. The cube sits at the center of a calm, fog-shrouded space — just you, the arrows, and the puzzle. Every visual decision is made to keep you in a focused, meditative state. The only sound is the satisfying click of an arrow being cleared from the surface.
VectorVoid: CubeNull is for you if:
You love logic puzzles that reward patience over speed.
You enjoy the quiet satisfaction of untangling something complex one step at a time.
You want a game that challenges both your analytical mind and your spatial imagination.
You need a calm, beautiful space to clear your head while keeping your brain engaged.
The cube is waiting. Are you ready to clear it?

data.description_full:
Bộ Lạc 3Q là một tựa game Tam Quốc chắc chắn sẽ làm dậy sóng cho cộng đồng game thủ tại Việt Nam, khi tái hiện thế giới quen thuộc theo phong cách nguyên thủy đầy mới lạ. Dàn thần tướng được tạo hình nhí nhố nhưng vẫn rất cá tính, khoác lên mình những bộ chầy khố độc đáo. Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm một tựa game giải trí độc nhất vô nhị, đây chính là ứng cử viên sáng giá.
⁕⁕⁕ TÍNH NĂNG ĐẶC SẮC⁕⁕⁕
1. Tam Quốc Đồ Đá – Đập Nhau Thấy Đã
Bộ Lạc 3Q quy tụ dàn danh tướng quen thuộc, nay được tái sinh trong hình hài nguyên thủy đầy mới mẻ. Không chỉ combat căng đét bằng những vũ khí được tạo bằng đá còn có các gậy gộc và cung nỏ đều được sử dụng để chiến đấu, kết hợp cùng đồ họa đẹp mắt mang đến cho người chơi trải nghiệm thích thú về một thế giới Tam Quốc bí ẩn.

2. Tặng 1000 Lượt Chiêu Mộ - Phúc Lợi Khổng Lồ
Mỗi ngày đăng nhập là được tặng nhẹ 1000 lượt chiêu mộ, say mê quay tướng thoải mái, không cần nghĩ nhiều. Cơ hội sở hữu những cái tên xịn sò như Gia Cát Lượng, Trương Phi trở nên dễ dàng hơn bao giờ hết với tỷ lệ ra tướng cực kỳ hấp dẫn. Dù là người chơi muốn cày chay, vẫn có thể thu thập được đủ các danh tướng cực mạnh, từ đó xây dựng đội hình ngon lành.
3. Tạo Hình Ngáo Ngơ – Chơi Vui Bất Ngờ
Hệ thống nhân vật được chia thành bốn phe Ngụy, Thục, Ngô và Quần Hùng, mỗi tướng đều có tạo hình và biểu cảm rất riêng, vừa sinh động vừa có chút ngáo ngơ duyên dáng. Từ những khoảnh khắc vui nhộn trong trận đấu đến phong cách chiến đấu khác biệt. Hãy chiêu mộ ngay và bố trí đội hình chiến đấu độc đáo, sẵn sàng đóng khố cầm chầy quẩy tung chiến trường.
4. Kỹ Năng Tấu Hài – Anh Tài Combat
Kỹ năng chiến đấu của các anh tài có một không hai, mỗi lần tung chiêu là một lần khiến người chơi bật cười. Mỗi danh tướng đảm nhận một vai trò rõ ràng: người mở đường cầm cung, kẻ bày mưu cầm quạt... phối hợp nhịp nhàng trong đội hình 5vs5, kết hợp tung chiêu nhanh nhẹn từ các anh tài, để tạo ra vô số màn combat rất riêng và không đụng hàng.

5. Xây Dựng Bộ Tộc – Cầm Gậy Gộc Quất Thiên Hạ
Tự tay xây dựng bộ tộc của riêng mình, và bắt đầu hành trình đánh đâu thắng đó. Từ những trận PvP liên server như Tranh Bá Cửu Châu căng thẳng, đến hoạt động PvE hào hứng. Vừa phát triển bộ tộc ngày càng mạnh, vừa chiến đấu với gậy gộc thôi cũng đủ tạo nên những trận chiến đáng nhớ.

data.name: Tower of Win
data.description_full:
🏰 Tower of Win – Sketch Fast. Think Faster. Roll With the Colors. ⚡

Jump into the colorful chaos of Tower of Win, a quick-draw party game where speed matters and luck picks your crayon! 🍀 Can you finish your sketch when the color keeps swapping under your fingertips? 🖍️

🎮 How It Plays
You get 3 speedy rounds — 20 seconds on the clock each time. ⏱️
Every round hands you a new prompt to draw, from simple shapes like a car 🚗, cloud ☁️, fish 🐟 or cat 🐱 to a few playful surprises. 🎉
Here comes the catch… 🔄
Every 4 seconds your pencil automatically switches to a new color 🎨
…and that fresh color is the only one you can draw with next! 🌈
No picking. No warning. Just pure creative mayhem. 💥

⚡ Put Your Reflexes to the Test
• 1️⃣ Race to finish before the timer hits zero ⏳
• 2️⃣ Adjust the moment the color flips on you 🎨
• 3️⃣ Turn pure randomness into something fun 💡
• 4️⃣ Own every wonky, laugh-out-loud result 😂
Sometimes your fish turns out blue. 🐟 💙 Sometimes your cloud goes green. ☁️ 💚 That's exactly the fun of it!

🖼️ Results & Gallery
When the round set ends you can:
• ✅ Look back at all 3 of your sketches
• 😂 Giggle (or wince) at what you made
• 📚 Revisit your earlier games in a gallery of doodles
Watch your art go from messy chaos to… slightly tidier chaos. 🤣

✨ Why You'll Keep Playing
• 🖌️ Easy to start, tricky to truly master
• ⚡ Short, snappy rounds — ideal for a tiny break
• 🎲 A fresh, unpredictable prompt every single game
• 🆓 Free, casual entertainment for all ages

Grab your crayon, let the colors call the shots, and see what you can create in Tower of Win! 🎨 🏰

• Ultra-Satisfying Slicing: Clean, precise animations split fruit sprites exactly along your swipe path.

• Separated High Scores: Your personal records are tracked individually for each game mode.

• Stats Screen: Easily keep tabs on your all-time best performances.

🍊 Whether you’ve got 60 seconds while waiting for your coffee or a free half-hour on the couch, Fruits Deluxe is designed to be picked up instantly, played hard, and put down whenever you want. It’s clean, premium, and unapologetically fun.

🔪 Sharpen your blade. The arena is yours.

data.name: Arrow Nexus
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Nexus, a relaxing puzzle game where every move shapes the solution.
Study the board, choose the correct arrow, and clear every path without blocking the next move.
Every level presents a unique arrangement of arrows. Your goal is to discover the correct sequence that allows every arrow to leave the board.
