How to Play
Tap an arrow to send it moving in the direction it faces.
An arrow can only move when its path is completely clear.
Continue finding the correct sequence until the entire board is cleared.
Complete levels to unlock more challenging puzzles and increasingly complex layouts.
Helpful Visual Hint
Need a little help?
If no move is made for a short period of time, Arrow Nexus automatically highlights one available arrow to suggest a possible next step.
Enable the path preview feature to display each arrow's extended route across the board. This makes it easier to identify potential collisions and plan the perfect solution before making your move.
You can also choose from four different color themes to create the visual experience that suits you best.
Features
Hundreds of handcrafted logic puzzles
Simple controls with satisfying gameplay
Automatic move hints when you're stuck
Extended path preview for smarter planning
Four colorful visual themes
Smooth animations and clean puzzle design
No timers and no pressure
Suitable for players of all ages
Why You'll Love It
Arrow Nexus combines simple mechanics with surprisingly deep strategy. Every puzzle challenges your observation skills while rewarding careful planning and logical thinking.
Whether you're looking for a relaxing brain teaser or a satisfying puzzle challenge, Arrow Nexus offers endless opportunities to improve your strategy and clear one clever puzzle after another.

data.name: Chameleon Paint: Hide & Seek
data.description_full:

Chamo is a free online chameleon hide and seek game where paint is your superpower. Grab the brush, copy the colors around you, and become part of the map. Hide in plain sight while the seekers hunt you down — or take the seeker role yourself and spot the fakes.

🎨 PAINT YOUR OWN CAMOUFLAGE
Pick any color from the palette, or use the eyedropper to grab the exact shade of a wall. Paint your whole body, match the floor, the walls and the props around you, and disappear. No preset skins to hide behind — your camouflage is only as good as you paint it.

Don't just stand there. Press flat against a wall, lie down on the floor, squeeze into a corner. Special poses turn a decent paint job into chameleon camouflage that seekers walk straight past.

👀 SEEK AND FIND
When hiding time runs out, the seekers move in. Check every wall, every corner, every object that looks slightly off. Found a hider? They join your team and the hunt gets bigger every second.

📣 WHISTLES GIVE YOU AWAY
Hiders can't stay quiet forever. Every so often you whistle and everyone nearby hears it. Move, repaint, change your pose, outsmart the seekers.

🌍 ONLINE MULTIPLAYER WITH FRIENDS
Jump into a quick match with players from all over the world, or create a private room with a password and invite your friends. Up to 10 players per room, with map voting before every round.

👕 UNLOCK CHAMELEON SKINS
Earn coins every match and spend them in the skin shop. Show off your style right before you disappear into a wall.

• Free online hide and seek multiplayer, up to 10 players
• Paint yourself any color — total camouflage freedom
• Eyedropper tool to copy map colors exactly
• Poses to blend into walls, floors and corners
• Play as hider or seeker in every match

• Map voting, round timer, live scoreboard

• Simple mobile controls, short rounds, no PC needed
• Party game for all ages

🕹️ HOW TO PLAY
1. Join a room or create a private one and share the password with friends.
2. As a hider: paint your body to match a surface, find a spot, hold a pose, stay still.
3. As a seeker: sweep the map and tap anything that looks painted on.

Every round tells a new story. Someone melts into a graffiti wall. Someone becomes a shadow in the corner. Someone gets caught in the first ten seconds. Which one are you?

Khám phá thế giới Pokémon và tiếp tục hành trình trở thành Bậc thầy!

【Công nghệ mô hình 3D cho trải nghiệm sống động】 Mỗi Pokémon được tái tạo tỉ mỉ qua mô hình 3D độ chính xác cao, từ vẻ ngoài đáng yêu của Pikachu đến sự hiện diện uy nghi của Charizard. Hiệu ứng kỹ năng độc quyền vô cùng ấn tượng, với những tia chớp và ngọn lửa rực cháy tạo nên trải nghiệm trực quan mạnh mẽ. Hơn nữa, các kỹ năng tương tác với môi trường trong thời gian thực—lửa trong cỏ, điện trên mặt nước—tạo nên trải nghiệm thực sự sống động!

【Sự lựa chọn của bạn định hình nên một hành trình độc đáo】 Pokémon không chỉ là lực lượng chiến đấu của bạn mà còn là người đồng hành cùng bạn trưởng thành. Sự tương tác sâu sắc và huấn luyện cá nhân hóa làm cho mỗi Pokémon trở nên độc đáo. Căn cứ, đội hình và chiến thuật của bạn cùng nhau viết nên câu chuyện Huấn luyện viên độc đáo của bạn.

【Lối chơi thông minh, trải nghiệm niềm vui qua chiến thuật】 Hãy tạm biệt việc chỉ tập trung tăng chỉ số một cách mù quáng! Hiểu rõ mối quan hệ giữa các thuộc tính, kỹ năng và đội hình; tận dụng môi trường và chiến lược để giành chiến thắng. Trong các thử thách PVE và trận chiến đấu trường, mỗi chiến thắng là minh chứng cho cả trí tuệ và sự gắn kết.

【Lối chơi xây dựng căn cứ: Tạo nên một ngôi nhà Pokémon ấm cúng】 Lối chơi xây dựng căn cứ SLG sáng tạo cho phép bạn tự do đặt các công trình như Trung tâm Hồi phục Pokémon và Vườn Cây Năng Lượng. Bố cục cân bằng giữa tính thẩm mỹ và hiệu quả; các sự kết hợp chiến lược giúp tăng tốc độ hồi phục của Pokémon và tăng tốc thu kinh nghiệm, cho phép bạn tạo ra căn cứ độc đáo của mình.

Thế giới đã sẵn sàng, câu chuyện đang chờ đợi sự khởi đầu. Giờ thì hãy ném Poké Ball và hét lên: Ta chọn ngươi!

data.name: Color Sort Solitaire
data.description_full:
Color Sort Solitaire is a clean and engaging card game experience that combines color logic, visual sorting, and card-based strategy into a relaxing yet thoughtful puzzle. Designed for players who enjoy mind games, word games, logic puzzles, and wisely designed solitaire games, this experience turns colors into the core rule that drives every move while encouraging strategic thinking.

Each level presents a structured board filled with cards that may show numbers, letters, shapes, or objects. While their symbols vary — echoing the variety found in word puzzle and association-based games — every card follows one simple rule: color defines belonging.

Your task is to activate a color category and carefully guide each card to where it belongs. While the symbols on the cards may change, their visual identity remains the same. Mastery comes from observing the board, spotting connections, understanding how elements are associated, and thinking several moves ahead.

This is not a speed game. Every decision matters. Moves are limited, paths can block each other, and the board evolves as you play. The challenge grows from observation and foresight rather than memorization, offering a challenging yet rewarding experience inspired by the calm focus of a solstice moment.

🏆 How you win
- Correctly group all cards under their matching color categories
- Use your available moves efficiently and strategically

❌ When the game ends
- No valid color moves remain
- All moves are used before the board is cleared
Color Sort Solitaire is ideal for players looking for a calm but mentally engaging experience that blends visual logic with strategic thinking. Play at your own pace, enjoy the clarity of visual rules, and relax with a puzzle that stays thoughtful without becoming overwhelming. Fully playable offline, it’s a perfect choice for those moments when you want to focus — anywhere, anytime.

data.description_full:
◆本作の特徴◆
■出会いが物語を動かす——仲間と紡ぐ群像劇
世界を廻り、108星をはじめ多くのキャラクターとの出会いによって紡がれる物語。
仲間が増えるほど、冒険は広がり、物語の表情も豊かに描かれていきます。

■“奥行きのあるドット表現”で描かれる冒険世界
キャラクターもロケーションも、奥行きのあるドット表現で描写。
懐かしくも新しいRPGとしての体験が楽しめます。

■仲間の数だけ広がる、戦略とバトル体験
本作はタイムラインターンバトルを採用し、
仲間の組み合わせが、戦術の幅を広げていきます。
バトルでは通常戦闘に加えて、「幻想水滸伝」シリーズならではの戦争モードも実装。

◆ストーリー◆
世界を創造したとされる27ある真の紋章
“変化の紋章”はそのうちの1つ
時は、太陽暦453年。 赤月帝国の東にある湖畔の里に、突如惨劇が訪れた。
謎の敵の襲撃。炎に包まれる家々。逃げ惑う人々。
脅威が去った後、主人公は、ヒスイ、シーリーン、シャプールと共に里の復興を決意する。
その旅路で、主人公たちは歴史の大きなうねりに巻き込まれていくのであった。
人々を苦しめる帝国の非道とは何か。 ビクトール、フリック、オデッサ…… 様々な人物との出会いが導く運命とは何か。
小さな冒険は、やがて大きな志へと変化していく。

data.name: Jester Jumbles
data.description_full:
Fruits fall into a chaotic little world where everything shifts, stacks, and evolves into unexpected forms. A clown moves above the field, setting each moment in motion as the board slowly transforms into a living, growing puzzle of colorful combinations. With every falling piece, the space changes, creating a different layout each time.

How to play?

Tap the screen to move the clown, then drop a piece onto the board. When two identical fruits touch, they merge into the next stage of evolution, while different objects remain where they land. Continue building combinations through the full chain of fruits to earn points with each successful merge. When a higher stage is created, you are granted coins during the session that can be used for a bomb to clear part of the field and help keep space open. The game continues until the stack reaches the top of the field.

Why you'll enjoy the game?

Enjoy satisfying merge animations, smooth physics, and simple controls that make every drop feel natural. Random fruit generation keeps every game different, while endless gameplay lets you experiment with new combinations and improve your score at your own pace. Whether you're playing for a few minutes or aiming for a long session, there's always another combo waiting.
data.description_short: A playful challenge where every drop counts.

data.name: Destroy Shot
data.description_full:
Welcome to Destroy Shot. The cannon is your instrument, the arena your canvas, and every shot paints a picture of pure, unrelenting chaos. This isn't a game about careful nudges and gentle taps. This is about finding the one shot that tears through everything in its path. Every object in the arena — every jar, every crate, every stone fortress — is waiting for its final moment. Your job is simple: aim, fire, and erase it from existence.
What Makes Destroy Shot Special:
- The Art of Absolute Destruction Most games ask you to build or collect. Destroy Shot asks you to unmake. Each level presents a carefully constructed setup, and your job is simple in concept but deeply satisfying in practice: find the critical point and tear it all down. The physics engine ensures that every collision, every shatter, every collapse feels weighty and real. When you pull the trigger, the world responds with the full force of simulated destruction. There's nothing quite like watching a fortress crumble under the force of your single, perfectly aimed shot.
- Where Destruction Meets Celebration The arena is a festival turned spectacle. Colorful bunting stretches across crumbling walls. Lanterns sway as shockwaves ripple through the scene. The chaos is framed by celebration, making every explosion feel like a firework and every collapse feel like confetti falling. This is not violence for its own sake — it is destruction as theater, as performance, as the ultimate show.
- Precision That Rewards Mastery The controls are simple: aim, adjust power, fire. But mastering them is a journey. Understanding how different materials behave under impact, how objects interact in a chain, and how to read a setup for its critical weakness — this is the skill that separates a good shot from a legendary one. Every level teaches you something new, and every success feels earned.
Destroy Shot is for you if:
• You dream of the single perfect shot that changes everything.
• You find satisfaction in absolute, uncompromising destruction.
• You appreciate physics that feels real and weighty.
• You want a game that rewards precision but celebrates power.
• You believe that one well-placed shot is worth a hundred random ones.
Load the Cannon. Take Aim. Fire. Every level is a new setup waiting to be destroyed. Every shot is a new discovery. The arena is waiting for its grand finale — and you are the only one who can deliver it.
data.description_short: One shot to rule them all. Aim true, fire with intent, watch worlds fall.

data.name: Fishing Travel: Hook & Explore
data.description_full:
Fishing Travel: Hook & Explore — это лёгкая и атмосферная игра о рыбалке и исследованиях. Забрасывайте удочку в разных уголках мира: на тихих озёрах, бурных реках и в бескрайних морях. Каждая локация скрывает собственные виды рыб, и чтобы поймать редкие экземпляры, понадобятся мастерство и опыт.
Исследование и пейзажи
В игре вас ждут десятки уникальных точек для рыбалки — от уединённых природных уголков до оживлённых городских набережных. Открывайте новые места, любуйтесь красивыми видами и находите идеальные точки для поимки трофейной рыбы.
Стратегия и вызовы
Чем сложнее рыба — тем ценнее награда. Комбинируйте и улучшайте удилища, катушки и приманки, подбирая снаряжение под разные водоёмы и виды рыб. Соревнуйтесь с игроками со всего мира, доказывайте своё мастерство и выигрывайте ценные призы.

data.name: Save My Dog - Draw Puzzle
data.description_full:
One line. That's all you get.

Save My Dog is a draw puzzle where a Shiba Inu pup needs your help — and the only tool you have is your finger. Each level puts your dog on a platform with a beehive nearby. You draw a single line on the screen. That line becomes a shelter. Bees fly out. If your arc is in the right place, the dog sits calmly inside it. If it isn't, they get through.


HOW IT ACTUALLY WORKS

You're not dragging the dog anywhere. You're building a barrier with your finger.

Each level shows you the layout — where the dog is standing, where the hive sits, what's in between. You figure out the geometry. Then you draw one connected line that blocks the bees before they reach the pup.

The line follows your finger exactly. Short arcs, long sweeps, tight curves — the shape is yours to decide. But the bees don't care about almost. A gap in your line means the whole thing fails.


SPATIAL REASONING, NOT REFLEXES 🧠

This isn't a tap-fast game.

You're solving a geometry problem with your finger. The position, angle, and shape of your line all matter. Draw puzzles and one-stroke puzzle games live or die on whether the mechanic has depth — here, the bee path changes depending on your arc. A line that looks right can still leave a gap you didn't notice.

Players who enjoy brain teasers, physics puzzles, and creative drawing games will feel at home.


WHAT THE GAME DOESN'T HAVE 🔥

No energy system blocking your session. No waiting timers between levels. No heavy interruptions while you're mid-puzzle.

Pick it up, run through a few stages, put it down. Or lock in on one Expert level until you find the perfect line. Both play styles work equally well.


If you've been looking for a draw-to-save puzzle with a dog worth protecting, this is it. Draw the shelter. Keep the bees out.

data.name: Bolt Jam - Screw Puzzle
data.description_full:
Bolt Jam is a screw puzzle game where you tap bolts, twist them off their boards, and free up the slots before you run out of room. That's the core loop.
Each level gives you a holding bar with limited slots — your only buffer between a clean solve and a locked board. Tap the wrong bolt first, fill those slots too fast, and the whole board jams up. You'll see exactly where you went wrong. That part stings a little. 🎯


How the puzzle works

· Boards are shaped like cats, stars, and other objects — each one loaded with color-coded nuts and bolts stacked in layers
· Tap a screw to pull it off the board and into your holding bar. Match same color and they clear out automatically
· The catch: bolts underneath are blocked until the ones on top are removed. You're solving a layered sort puzzle, not just tapping randomly
· Run out of holding slots with no matches available — the board is jammed. Screw jam achieved. Start thinking faster


Who this is for

· If you liked water sort puzzle games, tile-matching, or any color block sort game, this scratches a similar itch — with a different tactile feel. Twisting bolts off a board just hits differently than sliding tiles.
· It works well in short sessions. Five minutes on a commute, a level or two before bed. There's no energy system pushing you to stop. Play as long as you want. 📱
· The bolt sort mechanic also means there's real replayability on harder levels — you'll try different sequences and learn from each failed run. Did you discover what happens when you clear the outer bolts before the center ones? Worth testing.


The details

· No time limit — pure logic puzzle challenge, no pressure mechanics
· Clean, readable board layouts — the bolt colors are distinct and easy to track even on small screens
· The nut and bolt puzzle boards are shaped objects (cats, stars) — makes the game feel a bit less generic than a flat grid


We built Bolt Jam because we wanted a casual puzzle game that made us pause before every tap. Not a reflex game. Not a time-pressure game. Just a clean screw and bolt puzzle where the board rewards thinking over speed.

Hope you enjoy it. If a level has you stuck for a while — good. That means it's working.

data.name: Snack Trek Rush

HOW TO PLAY
- Swipe up, down, left or right to steer the snake's head.

- Avoid the outer walls, in-level obstacles and the snake's own tail.

KEY FEATURES

Smooth Swipe Controls
Steer with intuitive directional swipes that respond instantly. Glide through tight corners, switch lanes in a flash, and chain quick turns to weave around your tail.

Level-Based Progression
Snack Trek Rush is split into bite-sized stages with clear apple targets. Every cleared level unlocks a fresh layout with more apples to eat, longer snake length and trickier walls and obstacles.

Classic Arcade, Modern Polish

Quick Sessions, Endless Replay
Levels are designed to fit into short breaks. Failed a run? A friendly Retry button gets you back into the action in a single tap.

PRO TIPS
- Plan two moves ahead - the longer your snake grows, the less room you have to maneuver.

WHY PLAYERS ENJOY IT

- Progressive levels that keep the challenge climbing.

data.name: Card Flip Merge
data.description_full:
Can you remember where every card is hiding? Card Flip Merge is an addictive memory card game that challenges you to flip cards, find matching pairs, and race against the countdown timer. With every level the grid grows larger, the clock gets tighter, and your memory is pushed to its limits.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap any card to flip it over and reveal the hidden icon underneath.
• Flip a second card — if the two icons match, the pair stays face-up and you earn points.
• If they don't match, both cards flip back down. Remember where they are!
• Find all pairs on the board before the timer reaches zero to clear the level.

KEY FEATURES

Progressive Challenge
Start with a small 3×4 grid in Level 1 and work your way up to massive boards with dozens of pairs. Each level adds more cards and less time, keeping the challenge fresh.

Timed Gameplay
A countdown timer keeps the pressure on. Earn bonus seconds by matching pairs quickly, and watch your score climb as you chain consecutive matches together.

Star Ratings & Rewards
Complete levels to earn up to three stars based on speed and accuracy. Collect coins with every victory and use them to unlock new card themes and board styles.

Brain Training Fun
Exercise your memory, focus, and pattern recognition skills while enjoying colorful, relaxing visuals. A perfect way to keep your mind sharp during short breaks.

PRO TIPS
• Start by flipping cards in corners and edges — they are easier to remember.
• Try to memorize two cards at a time instead of focusing on one.
• Chain consecutive matches to build combos and boost your score.
• Watch the timer closely; don't spend too long on a single pair.

WHY PLAYERS ENJOY IT
• Quick sessions that fit into any schedule — play a few levels or a long streak.
• Smooth, polished visuals and satisfying match animations.
• Easy to learn, hard to master — fun for all ages.
• New levels and challenges keep the game fresh every time you play.

Download Card Flip Merge now and prove your memory skills, one flip at a time!

data.name: Lucky Arrow Blast
data.description_full:
🚀 Lucky Arrow Blast – The Arrow Escape Puzzle 🚀
Tap any arrow → it blasts straight along its direction (↑↓←→ or diagonal) until it leaves the screen. But if that moving arrow touches any other arrow – even slightly – you lose. Your goal: clear every arrow from the board without a single collision.
🎯 Why “Lucky”?
Because finding the perfect tapping order takes both skill and a little luck. Some arrows point to empty edges – safe. Others aim into crowded clusters – dangerous. You must plan your sequence carefully. One wrong tap and the whole board flashes red.
💥 Game Modes
Classic – 150 hand‑crafted levels, from 5 arrows to 25.
Blitz – 60‑second timer. How many can you clear?
Lucky Draw – one random arrow clears a small radius around it when tapped first.
Daily Puzzle – a fresh challenge every day.
🎨 Visuals & Sound
Neon arrows on dark backgrounds, smooth animations, crisp blast sounds, and a gentle chime for perfect clears. Collisions buzz – you’ll learn to avoid that sound.
🧠 Helpful Tools
Hint – shows the next safe tap (earn more via optional ads).
Undo – rewind one move without restarting.
Collision Preview – dangerous arrows glow faintly red.
Move Counter – track your taps and aim for 3‑star solutions.
📈 Progression
Levels are grouped into worlds. New twists appear: rotating arrows, moving obstacles, and arrows that change direction. Replay old levels to improve your score.
🌟 Why You’ll Love It
One‑thumb control, no timers in Classic, sharpens your spatial thinking, and feels incredibly satisfying when the last arrow escapes cleanly.
🔮 Tips
1️⃣ Always check edges – border‑pointing arrows are safest.
2️⃣ Diagonal arrows cross multiple lanes – save them for later.
3️⃣ Sometimes tapping a “blocked” arrow first opens a path.
4️⃣ Use Undo to experiment freely.
🎁 Bonuses
Every 10 levels, unlock a random gift – extra hints, new colour themes, or fun stickers.
📱 Download Now
Free to play, no intrusive ads during gameplay, offline supported. Coming soon: Level Editor, Global Leaderboard, and new arrow types (split, warp, shield).
Can you blast every arrow off the screen without a single crash?
Tap smart, trust your luck, and enjoy the ride. 🍀🏹💨

Khi đô thị quen thuộc bỗng biến thành bãi săn của Ác Linh... “Cộc cộc cộc”, tiếng gõ cửa bí ẩn vang lên...

“Suỵt, khẽ thôi, không được mở cửa.”

Tất cả Ác Linh trong truyền thuyết đang phá vỡ chiều không gian, sẵn sàng tông sập cửa phòng bạn bất cứ lúc nào. Việc bạn cần làm là khóa chặt cửa, cùng dàn Anh Hùng khai hỏa trận chiến bảo vệ [Cánh Cửa] cực kỳ phấn khích nhưng cũng đầy kịch tính!

Từ trường học, bệnh viện, khách sạn đến phố xá hay văn phòng – mỗi bối cảnh đời thường đều trở thành một màn chơi Thủ Thành đầy kích thích. Tận hưởng niềm vui kép về cả thị giác lẫn thao tác chỉ với 5 phút mỗi trận!

[5 ĐIỂM ĐẶC SẮC – ĐỊNH NGHĨA LẠI DÒNG GAME THỦ THÀNH HẮC ÁM]
※ Chọn phòng, khóa cửa, nằm yên và thăng cấp!
Ác Linh đến rồi phải làm sao? Không thể chạy thoát? Vậy thì nằm xuống thôi!
Chọn đúng [Căn Phòng] của bạn, khóa chặt [Cánh Cửa], chỉ cần nằm xuống là có thể thăng cấp ngay trong mơ, đồng thời triệu hồi Anh Hùng xây dựng tuyến phòng thủ! Liệu bạn có trụ vững trước tiếng gõ cửa giữa đêm khuya hay không, tất cả phụ thuộc vào cách dàn trận của bạn.

※ Đảo ngược chiến thuật, đấu trí tâm lý
Không cần “đánh cược mạng sống”, cũng không cần trốn chạy! Giường có thể nâng cấp, Cửa có thể nâng cấp và Anh Hùng cũng vậy. Căn phòng chính là pháo đài của bạn. Hãy kết hợp đội hình và chiến thuật chuẩn xác để đối phó với mọi thử thách. Mỗi lần bảo vệ cửa thành công sẽ đem lại cảm giác thỏa mãn tột độ.

※ Trải nghiệm thị giác độc đáo
Phong cách nghệ thuật Gothic Chibi mang đến bầu không khí hắc ám nhẹ nhàng đầy lôi cuốn. Trong ly của ma cà rồng là rượu vang hay là một loại "chất lỏng bí mật" nào khác? Tại sao gã sát thủ cầm cưa máy lại đeo mặt nạ thỏ đáng yêu? Với hàng trăm thiết kế Anh Hùng và Ác Linh riêng biệt, bạn sẽ thấy chúng vừa đáng sợ, lại vừa dễ thương.

※ Hóa thân đa dạng, thách thức mọi bản đồ
Hóa thành thành viên của [Hội Gan Dạ] để thám hiểm những địa danh kỳ bí, từ đoàn tàu đầy Ác Linh, ký túc xá vang vọng tiếng hát đêm, đến hang động ngầm bí ẩn. Người chơi có thể tự do hóa thân thành nhiều nhân vật khác nhau. Hôm nay, bạn sẽ chọn “gương mặt” nào để tham gia vào trò chơi sinh tồn này?

※ Chiến đấu nhanh gọn và kịch tính
Mỗi ván chỉ 5 phút, hoàn toàn không áp lực! Hãy tận hưởng một trận đấu vào những lúc rảnh rỗi. Ngay cả trong thời gian ngắn ngủi, bạn vẫn có thể trải nghiệm game Thủ Thành chất lượng cao một cách dễ dàng nhất.

data.name: Sudoku Detective: Murder Case
data.description_full:
Sudoku Detective: Murder Case is a murder mystery Sudoku-style logic puzzle game where clues, suspects, and deduction help you find the killer.

Every case is a crime scene. Every clue matters. Place suspects on the logic grid, eliminate impossible cells, and solve the case step by step. This is not ordinary Sudoku, and it is not random guessing. It is a detective puzzle built around reasoning, evidence, and deduction.

If you enjoy Sudoku games, logic puzzles, murder mystery games, detective games, whodunit cases, crime puzzles, brain teasers, or puzzle games for adults, open your next case file.

SUDOKU LOGIC MEETS DETECTIVE DEDUCTION
In each case, the board becomes your investigation. Instead of filling numbers, you place suspects, victims, and case elements on a grid. Rooms, furniture, blocked cells, objects, and clues create a unique mystery puzzle.

Read each statement carefully. A clue may tell you where a suspect was seen, which room contains an object, who was near the evidence, or which positions are impossible. Combine clues to narrow the board until only one solution remains.

SOLVE MURDER CASES
You are the detective. The suspects are waiting. The victim has been found. The clues are hidden in plain sight.

To solve each murder case, reconstruct the scene using logic. Who could enter the room? Who was beside the evidence? Which suspect could not have been near the victim? Which clue changes everything?

Every correct placement brings you closer to the truth. The final solution reveals the killer.

WHY PLAY SUDOKU DETECTIVE?
• Sudoku-style logic with a murder mystery twist
• Detective cases built around clues, suspects, victims, rooms, and evidence
• Logic grid puzzle gameplay for fans of deduction games
• Crime case puzzles that reward careful thinking
• No random guessing required: solve with reasoning
• Brain teaser challenges from easy cases to harder investigations
• Helpful hints when a case gets difficult
• Classic mystery atmosphere with no gore
• A fresh puzzle game for Sudoku, whodunit, and detective fans

A NEW KIND OF LOGIC PUZZLE
Sudoku Detective: Murder Case gives every puzzle a purpose. You are not just completing a grid. You are solving a crime.

Some clues are direct. Others only make sense when combined with another statement. Some rooms contain important objects. Some suspects cannot be placed in certain rows, columns, or areas. The best detectives look at every possibility before making an accusation.

This case-based structure makes each level feel like a compact investigation: short enough to play in a break, deep enough to challenge your brain.

FIND THE KILLER
Each mystery asks one question: who is guilty?

Use deduction to place every suspect correctly. Rule out impossible positions. Follow the evidence. Catch contradictions. Complete the logic grid and discover who committed the murder.

If you like classic detective stories, cozy murder mysteries, crime investigation games, Sudoku-style puzzles, logic riddles, and smart brain games, Sudoku Detective is designed for you.

PURE DEDUCTION GAMEPLAY
This is not a hidden object game, an escape room, or a simple number puzzle. Analyze the board, compare clues, and solve each mystery with logic.

TRAIN YOUR DETECTIVE BRAIN
Every case challenges observation, memory, reasoning, and logical thinking. Easy cases teach the rules. Harder cases make you connect clues across suspects, rooms, and board positions.

Use hints only when needed. Improve your deduction skills. Build your case-solving instinct one mystery at a time.

PERFECT FOR FANS OF
Sudoku, logic puzzle games, detective games, murder mystery games, crime case games, deduction puzzles, brain teasers, whodunit stories, mystery case files, logic grid puzzles, and puzzle games for adults.

START YOUR INVESTIGATION
Download Sudoku Detective: Murder Case and solve murder mystery puzzles with Sudoku-style logic.

Read the clues. Place the suspects. Complete the grid. Solve the case. Find the killer

Trong khi đó, Thợ Săn phải vận dụng khả năng quan sát và phán đoán để truy tìm từng mục tiêu đang ẩn nấp. Liệu phe Trốn có thể cầm cự đến cuối cùng, hay sẽ bị quét sạch trước khi thời gian kết thúc?

Hạ gục Anh Em Quyền Ma để có cơ hội nhận được những vũ khí vĩnh viễn giá trị.

Chế độ C4 Phòng thủ vững chắc, tấn công bùng nổ. Một sai lầm nhỏ, cả team trả giá!
Trận chiến 5v5 chiến thuật kinh điển, nơi 10 người chơi chia hai phe: Black List và Global Risk. Một đội đặt bom và tấn công; đội còn lại phòng thủ và gỡ bom. Chiến lược, độ chính xác và phối hợp đồng đội quyết định thắng thua.

Chế Độ Team Deathmatch
Chế độ đấu đội căng từng giây, nóng từng nhịp. Hồi sinh chớp nhoáng, giao tranh không ngừng, từng giây từng phút đều quyết định thắng bại. Thử thách phản xạ, khẳng định bản lĩnh và làm chủ chiến trường!

data.name: Arrow Cash Go
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Cash GO!

Arrow Cash GO is a fast-paced, addictive puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by tapping on directional markers to remove them. Every successful tap earns you in-game cash, which you can accumulate and eventually withdraw as real money!

How to Play

The game presents you with a board filled with multiple lines, each marked with a direction indicator pointing either horizontally or vertically. Your task is to tap on these indicators to make the lines slide out of the board in the direction they point.

However, it's not as simple as it sounds! Lines can block each other. If the path a line needs to take is blocked by another line, it gets "stuck." A line can be blocked up to three times—if it gets blocked three times, the level is failed. You'll need to think strategically about which markers to tap first to clear the board successfully.


Earn & Withdraw Real Cash

Every time you successfully tap and clear a marker, you earn in-game bills. The more levels you complete, the more bills you collect! These bills can be exchanged for real cash withdrawals.

Select your preferred withdrawal method and follow the instructions to transfer your earnings to your account.

It's that simple—play, earn, and cash out!

Easy to learn, hard to master – Simple tap mechanics with increasingly challenging puzzles.

Earn real money – Every tap brings you closer to a real cash payout.

100% free to play – No upfront costs, just pure gaming fun.

### Basic Rules
1. **Goal**: Fill in the numbers (or letters) in the 9×9 grid so that each row, each column, and each 3×3 square contains 1-9 (or A-I)
2. **Rules**:
- Each line can only contain 1-9 (or A-I) once each
- Each column can only contain 1-9 (or A-I) once each
- Each 3×3 square can only contain 1-9 (or A-I) once each
- The initial number (black) cannot be modified
- The number entered by the user (blue) can be modified

### How to operate
1. **Select cells**: Click on any cell in the Sudoku grid

data.name: Majestic Mahjong
data.description_full:
Majestic Mahjong – Match Tiles & Collect Characters
In a forgotten world of tile layouts, every Mahjong tile is not just a symbol—but a fragment of dormant memory.
The moment you begin moving them, the story starts to reassemble itself.

■ This is not a typical match game
Majestic Mahjong reimagines classic Mahjong triple-match gameplay as a spatial puzzle ritual.
You are not simply clearing tiles—you are reorganizing a collapsing and reforming structure of memory.
Every successful match of three identical tiles triggers chain reactions—paths open, structures shift, and new possibilities emerge.

■ Core Gameplay
Search for connectable tiles within layered structures
Match three identical tiles to clear them
Continuously adjust paths within limited space
Clear the entire board to progress through levels
The rules are simple—but every stage forces you to think differently.

■ Character Collection System
Beyond the board lies a group of “witnesses of memory.”
As you progress, you will gradually unlock and collect new characters. They do not all appear at once, but join your journey step by step.
When you achieve milestone breakthroughs and clear key structures, these characters will appear and offer brief but genuine encouragement at moments of victory—confirming your choices and acknowledging your persistence.
As you continue forward, more companions will be added to your collection. They are not just entries in a gallery, but fellow travelers in your unfolding journey.
You are not merely collecting characters—you are building a growing network of companionship and memory.

■ No Repeated Levels
There is no concept of repetitive grinding.
Every board is a newly formed structural puzzle:
Maze-like blocked paths
Collapsing tower-like layers
Compressed fragments of memory
Each entry presents a new order to decipher.

■ Why it’s addictive
Not because it is simple—but because you always feel:
“One more round, and I can find a better solution.”
And eventually, you do.
More importantly, you are not alone.
You are not clearing puzzles by yourself—you are gradually meeting companions, together restoring order to a fragmented world of tiles.

■ Who it’s for
Players who enjoy light strategy puzzles
Players who enjoy character collection and progression
Players who want short, relaxing but engaging sessions
And anyone who enjoys finding order in chaos

data.name: Block Clear: Puzzle Master
data.description_full:
Block Clear: Puzzle Master.

It's a block puzzle game built on a single rule: fill a complete row or column, and it clears. Keep the board open for as long as you can. When no block fits anymore, the game ends. No tricks, no fluff — just you and the grid.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag block pieces onto the grid
- Fill a full row or column to clear it and score points
- Clear multiple lines at once to trigger a combo
- Blocks cannot be rotated, so plan carefully
- The game ends when no more blocks can be placed

The core of a classic block puzzle, but it pulls you in every time. No timer. No pressure. Just the next three pieces and the question of where they go.

FEATURES
- No time limit — think at your own pace
- Smooth drag-and-drop controls built for touch screens
- Brain-training gameplay that exercises spatial thinking and logic

If you enjoy block blast games, cube puzzle challenges, 1010-style grid games, or tetris-style brain teasers, Block Clear fits right in.

It works as a quick two-minute brain game on a coffee break, or a long session of deep block drop puzzle strategy. A casual game that quietly turns into a daily habit.

One more block. One more line. One more game.

data.name: Crackface: Guess the Character
data.description_full:
Crackface turns any table into a secret-character showdown for 2–4 players. Everyone secretly picks a character. Then you take turns asking yes/no questions — "Does your character wear a hat?" — and cross suspects off the board until just one is left. Be the first to call your opponent's character by name, and the case is closed.

No ten-minute rulebook. Swipe through three cards and you're playing.

It's the classic face-guessing game you grew up with — rebuilt for 2 to 4 players, three ways to play, and characters of your own.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Pass & Play — one phone for the whole table. Make your pick, hide it, hand it over.
• No-Pass — everyone on their own phone in the same room. Hand the phone over once at the start to set your secret pick, then play with no more passing.
• Online — host a room, give friends a 6-character code or QR, and everyone plays from their own phone.

TWO MATCH MODES
• Blitz — the first correct call wins. Fast, tense, one shot.
• Classic — everyone gets to answer; the winner is whoever needed the fewest turns (and the least time on a tie).

THEMED PACKS FOR EVERY TABLE
Start with animals, dinosaurs, sea life, professions, world mythology, mythical creatures, space, aliens, cyberpunk, the wild west, sweets and fast food — and plenty more. Some packs are free from the start; the rest unlock as an optional set.

BUILD YOUR OWN BOARD
The best packs are the ones you make yourself. Pull photos from your gallery or snap them on the camera and turn anything you love into the game — original characters, inside jokes, and the people who want to be on the board. Share a finished pack with other players as a single file.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• 2 to 4 players, easy to teach
• Plays in minutes — perfect for a coffee break, a road trip, a party, or breaking the ice
• Pick your board size and a turn timer to set the pace
• Track your stats: games played, fastest win, favourite packs
• Localized in 15 languages

Pick a face. Ask the right questions. Crack it before they crack yours.

data.name: Find the Way!
data.description_full:
Overwhelmed by scattered daily distractions and looking for rush-free leisure time?

Arrow Clear is a minimalist arrow puzzle for all ages, playable with zero puzzle experience.
With clean visuals and progressive logic levels, this game steps away from intense timed races. Observe arrow layouts, determine tapping sequences and clear grids with soft taps to block outside distractions and enjoy peaceful focus.

🧩 Delightful Arrow Escape Gameplay
Colorful arrows interlace on grids and only move along their pointing directions, blocking each other's paths. You need to examine the whole layout and predict blocking relations to find proper tapping sequences. Difficulty rises smoothly: simple grids for quick relaxation, intertwined arrows to train spatial vision, geometric levels for multi-step planning. You will feel soothing satisfaction as messy grids gradually clear up and ease daily weariness.

🎨 Distraction-free Immersive Audio & Visuals
Soft matte backgrounds match vivid arrows, with no flashy effects or pop-ups. Gentle colors reduce eye strain during extended play sessions. Mellow soundtrack and subtle haptic feedback are available, and you can toggle audio and vibration freely to customize your gaming vibe.

🧘 Handy In-game Assistance Tools
No full restart needed when stuck. Practical aids support you gently without ruining puzzle fun:
• 💡 Hint: Highlight arrows ready to exit to simplify your next move
• 🧽 Eraser: Remove single blocking arrows to adjust solving plans
• 🪄 Magic Wand: Trigger chain clearing to eliminate multiple unobstructed arrows
• 📏 Full Grid Zoom: View the whole board to check all exit paths clearly

✨ Core Game Highlights
• Flexible leisure gameplay: No timers or penalties, pause and resume anytime
• Carefully crafted levels: Varied grids and geometric shapes for diverse puzzle fun
• Offline support: Play without Wi-Fi during spare moments
• Low-interruption interface: Few pop-ups for continuous immersive play
• Gentle brain training: Improve spatial awareness and sequential planning casually
• Short-session friendly: Compact levels fit all small daily gaps

🌌 Balanced Experience of Relaxation & Thinking
Many casual games are either repetitive or overly challenging. This game strikes a balanced approach between relaxation and light thinking. Sorting arrow paths calms messy thoughts. It is perfect for killing spare time, easing stress or light daily brain exercise. Plan each tap carefully and enjoy stress-free puzzle fun.

Download Arrow Clear and start your gentle relaxing puzzle journey.

Refined Order & Market Management！
Expand your customer base via diversified marketing campaigns to attract buyers from all regions. Arrange order schedules reasonably to balance production and delivery, steadily boost overall revenue and achieve long-term growth for your timber trading business.

You will gain exclusive industry points upon every completed order. Allocate these points wisely to unlock global buffs that permanently lift your factory’s productivity and profit ceiling. data.name: Molten Spheres
data.description_full:
Deep inside a volcanic world, ancient spheres burn with hidden energy. The arena is alive with lava, fire, and motion — and every match brings the molten core closer to release.

Molten Spheres is an atmospheric 3D puzzle game built around classic match-style logic, but with a more immersive and flexible way to play. Instead of looking at a flat board, you enter a full 3D field filled with glowing orbs. Rotate the arena, change the angle, zoom in, zoom out, and look for matching lines from any direction.

Connect three and more matching spheres in a row and clear them from the field. Each successful match charges the molten orb in the corner of the screen. Once it is full, you get coins that can be used for helpful tools during the game.

Use Hint to reveal possible moves with pulsing orbs, Shuffle to rearrange the field when you want a fresh layout, or Clear to remove all spheres from the board. There is no final loss or strict ending — the game is endless, calm, and focused on finding matches, building rhythm, and enjoying the fiery 3D atmosphere.

Daily Tasks add extra goals to complete, giving you new objectives and rewards each day. The animated main screen, volcanic background, glowing effects, and lava-inspired design create a strong visual style from the first tap.

What Awaits You:

— Unique 3D match gameplay
— Fully rotatable and zoomable game field
— Endless puzzle experience
— Glowing molten spheres and volcanic atmosphere
— Helpful tools: Hint, Shuffle, and Clear
— Daily Tasks with extra objectives
— Smooth fiery animations and immersive effects

Molten Spheres is only at the beginning of its journey. We are continuing to refine the game with smoother effects, clearer interactions and future visual updates. Stay tuned!

data.name: 3D Bubble Pop：Relaxing ASMR
data.description_full:
🦦 Game Overview
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a stress-relieving gift brought to you by a perpetually chill capybara.
In this fresh take on the classic bubble shooter, there is only one thing to do: aim, shoot, and pop. The slightly tilted 3D perspective makes the trajectory of every bubble clearly visible. As colorful bubbles collide and burst in mid-air, you’re treated to more than just a rising score; finely tuned ASMR sound effects provide a dual relaxation experience for both your fingertips and your ears.
No complex storylines or maps to unlock here—just a capybara hanging out with you, a pristine 3D bubble world, and a journey of popping bubbles that lets your mind completely unwind.

---
🎮 Gameplay
Core Rules: Match colors to pop groups of three.
The rules are simple, though the shooting angle requires a bit of thought.
- Shoot Bubbles: A colored bubble is loaded into the launcher at the bottom of the screen. Aim at the cluster of bubbles above and fire.
- Clear Bubbles: When your shot connects with a group of three or more bubbles of the same color, that group pops and falls away.
- Clear the Level: Eliminate all the suspended bubbles to advance to the next level.
Strategy & Tips
- Use Ricochets: Bubbles bounce off the side walls. If a direct path is blocked, use the walls to bank your shot—this requires a little quick mental geometry.
- Watch for Gravity: When a group pops, unsupported bubbles will fall due to gravity; these falling bubbles count toward your score too. Targeting key support points first can trigger a satisfying chain reaction of falling bubbles. ---
🎨 Clean 3D Visuals
- Slightly Tilted Perspective: The game employs a slightly tilted 3D view, allowing you to clearly see the depth and layering of the stacked bubbles without making aiming difficult due to an extreme angle. This design preserves the classic bubble-shooter field of view while adding a sense of realistic spatial depth.
- Minimalist Background: There are no complex theme changes; the game features a single, soft, gradient background with a frosted-glass texture. All visual elements serve the gameplay—free of superfluous decorations—letting you focus entirely on the joy of shooting.
- Bubble Texture: Each bubble boasts a translucent, glossy sheen with light playing across its surface, accompanied by subtle expansion and contraction animations upon impact.
🧘 Stress-Free, Pure Gameplay
- No Time Limits: No countdown timers rush you through levels; take your time adjusting your aim to find the perfect shot trajectory.
- No Forced Tasks: There are no daily missions to complete, nor stars or keys to collect. Simply open the game, start popping, and pick it up or put it down whenever you like.

---
✅ Summary
"Aim, shoot, and listen to the bubbles pop. Let the Capybara keep you company during a gentle, leisurely break."
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a bubble-shooting game that returns to the classics with a focus on stress relief. It strips away complex progression and collection systems, leaving only the core fun of aiming, bouncing, and popping. Exquisite ASMR-quality sound effects, a calm Capybara companion, and clean 3D visuals combine to create a tranquil space where you can relax your mind anytime, anywhere.
Whether you are a veteran bubble-shooter player or simply looking for a way to unwind and find some peace, you’ll find your own rhythm here.
Open the game, adjust your angle, and join the Capybara in watching the bubbles bloom in the air.

We hope you enjoy the game! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

Help Row Manage the Town's Supermarket!

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

data.name: Jam Bus:Sandfall
data.description_full:
Jam Bus: Sandfall brings a fresh twist to bus jam, color puzzle, and traffic escape gameplay.
Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.
Plan carefully before you tap. Some buses may block each other. Some paths may cross. Some sand colors can only be cleared after the lower layers are gone. To win, you need to observe the board, choose the right order, and keep every bus moving without a crash.
How to play
• Tap a bus to move it along its route
• Match each bus with the same color sand
• Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
• Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
• Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
• Relaxing color-matching gameplay
• Clever bus parking jam puzzles
• Satisfying sand-clearing effects
• Increasingly tricky routes and layers
• Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
• Great for quick breaks and brain training
Every level is a small logic challenge. A bus may look ready to move, but its route might block another vehicle. A color may be visible, but the sand below it must be cleared first. Think ahead, follow the arrows, and find the perfect order to clear the whole sandfall.
If you enjoy bus games, parking jam puzzles, color sort games, traffic escape challenges, or relaxing logic games, Jam Bus: Sandfall gives you a colorful new puzzle to solve.
Start with one bus, clear one color, and let the sand fall into place.

• Polished Local High-Score Board: Monitor your progress effortlessly! The game automatically saves your final score after each session and displays:

- Your all-time personal best record.

• Smooth Animation Effects: Enjoy a highly responsive mobile interface with polished visual transitions, colorful 2D art styles, and satisfying feedback on every successful match.

• Pure Offline Experience: No internet connection or online profiles required. Play fully standalone and enjoy the dynamic arcade challenge wherever you go.

• Balanced Casual Flow: Short, structured sessions provide a perfect mental reset without any long-term commitments or stressful features.

🍎 Ready to test your coordination and conquer the leaderboard? Download Fruit Fortune today, watch the central line, and break your highest record!

Uma história inacabada, ninjutsu nunca antes visto, a paixão e a emoção que você nunca esqueceu, os laços de amizade que sempre carregou consigo – tudo será reiniciado agora!

Ninjutsu deslumbrante de tirar o fôlego

Combos e laços que retornam
Sistema de combos inovador com ataques rápidos e emocionantes. Reviva as engenhosas combinações de ataques e os fortes laços entre os personagens! data.name: Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle, the relaxing sorting game where colorful nuts are scattered across screws, and it’s up to you to bring order. Your goal is simple: move the nuts one by one until every screw holds a perfect stack of a single color. No timers. No rush. Just the calm satisfaction of watching messy piles transform into neat, matching towers.
Game Features:
- Sort, Stack, and Solve
Each level gives you a set of screws loaded with mixed-up colorful nuts. Pick up the top nut from any screw and place it onto another — but only if the colors match or the screw is empty. It’s easy to pick up, yet every move asks you to plan ahead.
- A Fresh Twist on Classic Sorting
If you love water sort or ball sort puzzles, you’ll feel right at home. Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle takes that familiar, deeply satisfying sorting loop and gives it a tactile new feel — Stacking nuts onto screws feels crisp, chunky, and impossibly satisfying.
- Relax at Your Own Pace
There are no clocks, no countdowns, and no fail states. Take as much time as you need. Undo a move, rethink your strategy, and enjoy the soothing rhythm of sorting. This is a puzzle game designed to calm your mind, not test your nerves.
- From Simple to Clever
Early levels are gentle and welcoming, with just a few colors and plenty of room to move. As you progress, more screws, more nuts, and tighter arrangements appear — turning each puzzle into a quietly rewarding brain teaser that keeps you engaged without ever feeling unfair.
- Satisfying Every Time
When the last nut clicks into place and a messy screw becomes a flawless single-color stack, the moment is pure satisfaction. Smooth animations and gentle sound effects make every completion feel like a small victory.
Why You’ll Love Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle:
- If you love sorting, organizing, and tidying things up, this game was made for you.
- If you enjoy puzzle games that let you play at your own speed — on the couch, on a break, or winding down at night — you’ll feel right at home.
- If you’re looking for a distraction-free game that keeps your mind quietly engaged without stress, this is it.
- If you find joy in watching scattered pieces come together into perfect order, you’ll keep coming back for more.
Download Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle today and start sorting the nuts, one move at a time.

data.name: Revolut Slots
data.description_full:
Diamond Shine is a gem-spotting reflex game built around a single sharp skill: telling a genuine diamond from a convincing fake in a fraction of a second.
Scatters of violet and clear stones pour onto the field, and only the stones with an icy brilliant cut are real. Tap genuine diamonds to build score and combo streaks, but every wrong tap on a violet pretender costs points and breaks your momentum. As levels climb, stones appear faster, vanish sooner, and the field fills with tricksters that copy the diamond shape with a deceiving purple tint, so the challenge keeps evolving instead of repeating.
What makes Diamond Shine distinct is its detective angle. Every third level is a double-score bonus round where shining stars drop alongside the stones, rewarding players who stay accurate under pressure. Earnings feed a focused upgrade vault: the Time Dial stretches every round, the Sleuth Lens briefly exposes every genuine diamond on demand, and the Jeweler Specs permanently train your eye by dimming false stones. Each purchase changes how the next hunt actually plays revolut slot.
A persistent hall of records keeps the ten best hunts with the level reached and the date, turning every run into an attempt to outdo your own sharpest performance. The interface is built in a violet shine style with purple and silver detailing, custom typography, and gemstone scenery, and it adapts cleanly to both small and large screens revolut casino.

Your goal is to drive every bus out of the lot, each one loaded with its matching passenger(s). Just a smooth, collision‑free operation.

data.name: IndonesianToTo
data.description_full:
"Gameplay Design
Core Gameplay:
The player clicks on two identical tiles. If the line connecting them is no more than three zigzags (i.e., two turns), the connection is successful and the tiles are removed.

The empty space after removal can be filled with surrounding tiles, or the entire tile remains unchanged.

Clearing all tiles within the specified time wins.

Game Interface Design
The main interface includes the following elements:
Game Area: A grid layout (e.g., 8x10), with an icon displayed per grid.

Top Bar:

Timer (e.g., 60-second countdown)

Score

Number of remaining hints (e.g., 3)

Back/Pause button

Bottom Bar:

Rearrange button

Hint button

Sound control

Game Logic Design
Tile Generation:
The number of tile types varies based on difficulty (6 for beginner, 8 for intermediate, and 10 for advanced).

Ensure that all tiles are matched at the beginning to prevent unsolvable puzzles.

Connection Verification:
Implement a ""path-finding algorithm"" to determine whether two tiles can be connected (with 0-2 turns).

You can use BFS (Breadth-First Search) with direction indicators.

Determine whether the two points can be ""traversed"" within the current grid state.

Removal Animation:
Use a connection effect (line drawing animation), and then gradually make the two tiles transparent.

Add special sound effects and a score-bouncing animation for each connection.

⚙️ Difficulty Design
Difficulty Grid Size Icon Type Time Limit Rearrangement
Easy 6x8 6 Types 90 Seconds ✅
Medium 8x10 8 Types 75 Seconds ✅
Hard 10x12 10 Types 60 Seconds ✅

UI/UX Style Recommendations
Keep fresh colors. Icons can use cartoon fruits, animals, or symbols.

Tile borders can have a slight shadow to enhance the three-dimensional effect.

Connection effects can be set to colored light or trails with particle effects.

Sound Effects and Special Effects
Background Music: Light and lively.

Sound Effects:

Clicking Sound

Clearing Sound (can simulate refreshing sounds like ""ding"" and ""click"")

Combo Sound for consecutive successful connections"

data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

data.name: Football Roar
data.description_full:
Football Roar is a football quiz game that challenges your knowledge of players, clubs, and national teams from around the world. Test yourself by matching famous footballers to their clubs or home countries — fast, fun, and competitive.

The game features two distinct modes. In Guess Country mode, you see a set of national flags and must assign each player to their correct country. In Guess Club mode, you match players to club logos from top leagues including the English Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, and Ligue 1.

Choose your difficulty level and customize the number of rounds to suit your mood — whether you have five minutes or an hour to spare. The game tracks your performance over time, storing your scores, accuracy, and session history so you can always see how you are improving.

A built-in statistics screen shows your total games played, overall accuracy, and best scores per game mode. Settings let you control background music, sound effects, and vibration independently. Football Roar is designed for football fans of all levels — whether you follow every transfer or just enjoy the beautiful game.

data.description_full:

data.name: Plunko Pin
data.description_full:
Welcome to Plunko Pin — a fast-paced arcade challenge where timing and precision make all the difference.

A ball drops from above, bouncing through a field of pins and changing direction with every contact. Your goal is to lock in the correct target zone at exactly the right moment and guide the ball to the perfect landing.

Each round is a test of focus, reaction speed, and prediction. The highlighted target changes quickly, the ball’s path shifts unpredictably, and even a small delay can change the outcome. As the pace increases, every decision becomes more intense and every successful hit feels more rewarding.

Score points through accurate timing and smart anticipation. Watch the movement, react at the right second, and aim for the exact landing zone before the ball reaches the bottom. With limited attempts and constantly changing motion, every drop matters.

Plunko Pin is easy to start, challenging to master, and built for those who love precision under pressure.

data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса
data.description_full:
Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Здесь власть не дают просто так. Её забирают силой, хитростью и верными людьми. Улицы полны денег, предательства и опасных сделок, а каждый район ждёт того, кто сможет подчинить его себе.

Начните путь с самых низов и станьте боссом криминальной империи. Нанимайте людей вне закона, головорезов, карателей и главарей, собирайте сильный отряд, усиливайте персонажей, забирайте ресурсы и расширяйте своё влияние. В этом городе вы либо правите, либо становитесь чьей-то добычей.

[Соберите свою банду]
Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]
Вас ждёт история амбиций, мести, опасных союзов и жестокой борьбы за влияние. Вы встретите союзников и противников, примете непростые решения и сами определите свою судьбу. Останетесь мелким уличным головорезом или станете главным боссом Города грехов?

data.name: Print Sort: Color Puzzle
data.description_full:
What if a puzzle game could stretch your brain, calm your nerves, and let you watch adorable little ducks take shape right before your eyes?
That's Print Sort: Color Puzzle.
Moving beyond traditional color-sorting mechanics, Print Sort brings together two unexpected worlds: path-solving puzzles and 3D printing. You're not just clearing a static grid — you're fueling a fleet of 3D printers, each one hungry for its own color.
🖨️ More Than a Puzzle — It's a Print Lab
When you open the game, here's what you'll see:
In the workspace above, a few 3D printers sit quietly, each holding an empty mold, ready to bring a duck to life.
Below, a maze of vibrant lines twists and crisscrosses the board. Each one acts as a tube of 3D printing filament, and along every line you'll find directional arrows — waiting for your command.
Your mission: tap the right arrows, route each color along its path, and deliver the material into the matching printer. With every line delivered, your duck grows a little more — collect them all, and it's complete.
That moment — watching a tiny duck slowly take shape — feels a little like childhood, the same joy as watching clay come alive.
🧠 Where's the Challenge?
It looks simple. It isn't:
- Multiple colors weave through each other — one wrong tap, and you'll lose a life. You only get three.
- Short routes often block longer ones — plan your order, or stay stuck.
- In later levels, a single arrow can change the flow of an entire line.
- Stuck? Hint bulbs light up a safe move when you need one.
Every level feels like unraveling a colorful ball of yarn — find the right thread to pull, and the whole puzzle opens up.
🌿 Designed for Calm Minds
We built Print Sort to be the little reset button in your day — for commutes, lunch breaks, or those last quiet minutes before sleep:
- No timer — think as slowly as you like.
- No energy system — play for one minute or even for one hour.
- Play offline — works on planes, subways, anywhere.
- Soft visuals — neon lines on dark backgrounds, easy on the eyes.
- Soothing sounds — every successful print rewards you with a gentle chime.
✨ Who Will Love It?
- Puzzle fans who want a brain workout without time pressure.
- Suckers for cute, soothing visuals.
- Busy people looking for a mindful pocket of calm.
- Gamers wanting an accessible puzzle that all skill levels can play together.
- Curious players who just couldn't resist the idea of a 3D-printing duck game.
🌈 Start Your Print Sort Journey
Tap your first arrow. Watch the color start to flow. The moment your first little duck takes shape, you'll know — this one's different.

data.description_full:
Giấy phép phát hành trò chơi điện tử: 113/GCN-SVHTT do Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao thành phố Hà Nội cấp ngày 17 tháng 3 năm 2026.

Chào mừng bạn đến với *Cẩm Tú Nhân Sinh*, tựa game mô phỏng cuộc đời gia tộc phong cách cổ trang đầy lôi cuốn. Với tư cách là gia chủ, bạn sẽ nâng cao năng lực của mình như thế nào? Bạn sẽ dẫn dắt gia tộc đi về đâu? Bạn sẽ chọn ai là người bạn đời đồng cam cộng khổ, và bạn sẽ dạy dỗ con cái ra sao? Tất cả đều nằm trong *Cẩm Tú Nhân Sinh*.

1. Thiết kế nhân vật và đồ họa phong cách cổ trang tối giản
Sử dụng phong cách cổ đại tươi mới, mộc mạc cùng những thay đổi tinh tế trên gương mặt nhân vật, mang đến cho người chơi trải nghiệm về sự thay đổi và trưởng thành của cuộc đời trong một bầu không khí nhẹ nhàng, thư thái.

2. Quản lý gia tộc và những lựa chọn định mệnh
Mục tiêu của bạn là xây dựng một gia tộc hưng thịnh. Sự trưởng thành của mỗi thành viên và lựa chọn của bạn trong từng sự kiện đều sẽ ảnh hưởng đến sự phát triển và vận mệnh của gia tộc. Bạn sẽ liên tục đưa ra các quyết định để thúc đẩy sự thay đổi của gia tộc, từ đó tạo dựng nên một cơ nghiệp vạn đời.

3. Bối cảnh thời đại
Bạn đang sống trong thời đại cổ xưa, nơi bạn có thể lựa chọn nhiều loại ngành nghề khác nhau. Mỗi nghề nghiệp đều có lộ trình thăng tiến và phẩm cấp tương ứng, đồng thời còn có các ẩn phẩm cấp có thể kích hoạt các nhiệm vụ bí mật giúp thay đổi cả triều đại.

4. Tích lũy tài sản
Người chơi có thể điều hành nhiều loại cửa hàng (như cửa hàng tạp hóa, tiệm rèn, hiệu thuốc, tiệm cầm đồ, v.v.), thông qua việc chiêu mộ gia nhân quản lý cửa hàng để tăng thu nhập, hoặc có thể thông qua việc buôn bán đường xa (thương nhân gia đình) để gia tăng đáng kể thu nhập cho gia tộc, từ đó giúp các thành viên có nhiều lựa chọn hơn khi đối mặt với các sự kiện phát sinh.

5. Cốt truyện phong phú và sự kiện ngẫu nhiên
Trong game, các sự kiện ngẫu nhiên sẽ liên tục xuất hiện (như đi học, bệnh tật, của cải bất ngờ, sự kiện nghề nghiệp, v.v.), thử thách khả năng ra quyết định của bạn. Những suy nghĩ khác nhau sẽ mang lại những ảnh hưởng khác nhau, tác động đến từng chỉ số cơ bản của bạn. Ngoài ra còn có vô vàn kỳ ngộ thú vị, khiến mỗi lần trải nghiệm đều là một hành trình hoàn toàn mới mẻ.

data.name: Sand Shape
data.description_full:
🔶 Sand Shape – Geometric Logic Puzzle

Step into a world of clever rules, satisfying transformations, and handcrafted logic puzzles. In Sand Shape, every level begins as a simple empty grid. Your goal is to divide the board into unique connected shapes by coloring cells and following each puzzle’s rules.

🎮 How to Play
- Color Connected Cells: Fill the board by coloring grid cells and turning them into connected shapes and regions.
- Follow Puzzle Rules: Each level introduces different logic rules that determine how shapes can be created, connected, and organized.
- Find the Perfect Solution: Use logic, planning, and creativity to solve handcrafted boards and reveal satisfying geometric patterns.

✨ Game Features
🧩 Creative Puzzle Mechanics - Draw, split, and connect colorful regions while following clever puzzle rules that constantly change the way you approach each board.
🧠 Train Your Brain - Some puzzles require much more thinking and planning than they first appear. Finding the perfect solution through pure logic feels incredibly satisfying.
🎯 Challenges Await - While the core idea stays simple, new rules and combinations continuously change the way puzzles are solved, keeping every level fresh and engaging.
🎨 Stunning Shape Patterns - Clean geometric visuals, vibrant colors, and satisfying transformations turn every completed board into a beautiful sand pattern.

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.

Your goal: tap arrows in the correct order to clear every arrow off the board without collisions. One wrong tap, and an arrow hits another — plan ahead, read the board, or start over.

- Tap arrows in the correct sequence to open a path for the others
- Avoid collisions — tap a blocked arrow and you lose a life

data.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
data.description_full:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

Then, by a twist of fate, you discover an ancient dragon egg. Raise it, hatch it, and gain a mighty dragon that will become your fiercest ally in war.

From village to town, from town to castle, you will expand step by step across this vast medieval world. March against enemies, seize territory, and prepare for the day you can strike back at the force that destroyed your kingdom.

Here, alliances shift as quickly as battle lines. You may face other Lords in open war, or join forces with them against greater threats. To survive, you must train troops, strengthen your heroes, and master the power of your dragon.

As your influence spreads across this foreign land, you will build mighty guilds, wage large-scale wars, and fight not only to restore your lost kingdom’s glory, but to claim the crown as the true ruler of the continent.

[Game Features]

[Number Gates, Instant Power]
Swipe to choose the right gate and boost your power in an instant. Break through enemy lines, overwhelm your foes, and enjoy fast, satisfying combat with simple controls.

[Heroes, Dragons, and Magic]
Recruit mighty heroes, including knights, warriors, priests, and mages. Their attacks come in many flavors: cold steel slashes, explosive magic runes, rapid-fire wand orbs – every strike is lethal! Discover ancient dragon eggs, hatch powerful dragons, and lead heroes and dragons into war together.

[Build, Trade, and Prosper]
Start with wheat, log, and iron, then turn raw materials into valuable goods through production and trade. Fulfill kingdom orders to earn gold and build your domain from a ruined village into a prosperous kingdom with your own hands.

[Real-Time Strategy, Full Control]
Command multiple troops in real time, combine different hero skills and unit types, and adapt your tactics on the battlefield. When the moment comes, unleash your dragon to shatter enemy defenses.

[Guild Warfare, Kingdom Conquest]
Create or join a powerful guild and fight alongside allies to capture castles, claim territory, and defeat rival forces. Use strategy, strength, and diplomacy to avenge your fallen kingdom and rule the continent!

data.name: โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉัน
data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!
กิจกรรมเล่นเกมลุ้นรับดอกไม้จริงเปิดให้ร่วมสนุกได้ตลอด พร้อมจัดส่งตรงถึงบ้านสำหรับผู้เล่นในประเทศไทย!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

data.name: Roll Raiders

The bugs do not wait. After your attack, they move closer and strike when they are in range. Some charge straight at you, others attack from distance, and massive boss bugs bring extra danger to the battlefield. Save leftover bullets between waves, plan your rolls, and build enough power to survive the final assault.
