✨ Core Features

🦖 A Massive Ecosystem
A unique Low Poly style brings over 70+ prehistoric species to life across sea, land, and air. Every creature possesses its own distinct survival instincts.

🧬 Unique Evolution System
Forget tedious XP bars. Progress through "Growth + Nesting = Evolution." Consume nutrient-rich food and breed to unlock more powerful prehistoric apex predators.

🫀 Hardcore Survival Mechanics
Stomach, lungs, and heart are interconnected. Hunger, stress, or injury directly damage organs and lower efficiency. Temperature, humidity, oxygen, and energy create a strict survival web where every choice matters.

⚔️ Strategic Combat
Featuring skill buffs, penetration, resilience, and a Locational Damage System. Striking different body parts yields unique damage multipliers and defensive returns. True Damage bypasses armor to deplete health and inflict trauma—high trauma will leave even fully armored players in despair by blocking heart health recovery.

🐣 Nesting and Breeding
• Diverse Paths: Choose parthenogenesis or find a mate. Temperature determines the offspring's gender; males naturally possess size and combat advantages.
• Build Your Nest: Gather stone and wood to build a nest that serves as your safe haven and respawn point. Defend it, as hostile players can destroy it.
• 🆕 Enhanced Brooding: Manually brooding eggs doubles hatching speed and stacks across generations to secure the strongest bloodline.

🧬 Genetic Inheritance
Offspring inherit traits from parents, with stats randomly breaking through limits. Shape a unique, peak bloodline through generations and selective brooding bonuses.

🤖 🆕 AI Companion & Offspring System
• Tame Wild Mates: Interact with opposite-sex wild dinosaurs of your species to build favorability and tame them as your exclusive AI mate.
• AI Offspring Management: Hatch eggs into AI offspring that follow your commands as loyal combat followers and territory guardians.
• Combat Commands: Issue orders like Follow, Attack Target, Standby, Defend, Protect, and Evade. AI companions assess threats and execute tactics independently.

🤖 Dynamic AI Herds
Encounter neutral and hostile AI herds with distinct behaviors. During special seasons, witness epic, massive migrations—a thrilling spectacle that brings both extreme danger and unmatched opportunity.

🌡️ Dynamic Climate Zones
The world is divided into distinct climate zones. Different species require specific temperature and humidity levels. Finding your ideal zone ensures survival and accelerates growth.

data.name: Skullburn

Skullburn is a cool mix of wilderness survival and action adventure in one unrivaled experience. In this post apocalyptic world, you must break things around for scrap metal, upgrade your skull crusher vehicles, and win every gang fight to survive. Experience the ultimate wasteland punk atmosphere where the scorched earth dictates the rules of apocalypse survival games.

A world that once thrived suddenly became a lawless territory after the apocalypse max event. All residents disappeared, and our main character needs to solve the mystery of the scorched earth. However, challenges and various wasteland punk factions will appear in the way, so the main goal is wilderness survival in these intense apocalypse survival games.

🏜️ EXPLORE THE SCORCHED EARTH

Explore the abandoned places of Skullburn to find out why the world turned into a lawless desert. Meet the scary details of post apocalyptic life: scrap metal piles, desert war zones, and unusual wasteland punk raiders watching you. To master wilderness survival, you must explore every corner of this action adventure.

Break things around you for resources and scrap metal. The better your skull crusher weapons, the easier it will be to ensure your wilderness survival in these dangerous apocalypse survival games. In this post apocalyptic world, crafting is your only way to survive the apocalypse max chaos.

🚗 DESERT WAR VEHICLES

Build the ultimate skull crusher to win the desert war! When changing locations in this action adventure, you will face a deadly gang fight on wheels. Use scrap metal to reinforce your ride and dominate the lawless roads of the scorched earth. Your skull crusher is your home in this wasteland punk reality.

👤 BECOME THE WASTELAND PUNK LEGEND

Pistol, machine gun, or a heavy skull crusher? Choose your weapon from a devastating arsenal of this action adventure. Use different fighting styles to win every gang fight and prove you are the king of wilderness survival. This post apocalyptic world respects only power.

🚧 CLEAR POST APOCALYPTIC RAIDS

Go on dangerous raids for scrap metal and rare resources. Each raid is a unique challenge in the apocalypse max era! Locations with enemies at every turn await you. Only by winning a gang fight can you secure your shelter and solve the mystery of the scorched earth.

👫 SAVE OTHER SURVIVORS

In this post apocalyptic RPG, it is important to join forces. Save other survivors from a lawless gang and protect them from the desert war dangers. Go with them for scrap metal and hunt for bosses in the best tradition of action games. Together, you can survive the apocalypse max nightmare.

🌵 PREPARE FOR THE GANG FIGHT

In Skullburn: Action Adventure, when the sun goes down over the scorched earth, you will need all your wilderness survival skills to escape from wasteland punk mutants. Prepare your skull crusher and gather your ammo for the most intense desert war of your life.

👁️‍🗨️️ SOLVE THE LAWLESS MYSTERY

Search for clues to learn the history of this post apocalyptic wasteland. Find out what triggered the apocalypse max and why the desert war never ends. In these adventure, every letter found on the scorched earth brings you closer to the truth.

In Skullburn: Post Apocalyptic survival, every moment is a desperate struggle to maintain your wilderness survival. Explore the scorched earth and lawless ruins in one of the most intense apocalypse survival games and action adventure titles. Win every gang fight, upgrade your skull crusher, and collect scrap metal to stay alive. Every mile of the desert war hides new wasteland punk dangers in this apocalypse max world.

Skullburn is a free-to-play action adventure where every piece of scrap metal matters. Test your courage in one of the most chilling apocalypse survival games. Only the bravest will manage wilderness survival in this post apocalyptic world of wasteland punk and desert war.

Enjoy real-time chat during your Mancala games. Talk to friends in private matches or interact with opponents while playing live.


📝 THE RULES OF MANCALA
Mancala (Kalaha) is a classic two-player strategy board game played on a board with twelve pockets and two stores. At the start of the game, each pocket contains four stones. Players take turns picking up all stones from one of their pockets and distributing them counter-clockwise, placing one stone in each pocket and their own store while skipping the opponent’s store.

If the last stone lands in your store, you earn an extra turn. If the last stone lands in an empty pocket on your side and the opposite pocket contains stones, you capture those stones and move them to your store. The game ends when one player has no stones left in their pockets or when a player concedes. The player with the most stones in their store wins.

Mancala is known around the world by many different names, including Congklak, Mangala, Sungka, Ô ăn quan, Congkak, Igisoro, Kalaha, Oware (Awale), Pallanguli, Dakon, Bao, Bohnenspiel and more.

data.name: Grill Fever: Food Sort
data.description_full:
Welcome to Grill Fever: Food Sort, a conveyor belt–inspired food sort puzzle set on a lively beach BBQ grill.
In this food sorting puzzle, your objective is simple and clear: guide the right ingredients into the correct grill positions to complete each BBQ dish. Every level presents a grill board with specific food requirements. When all required ingredients are placed correctly, the BBQ dish is finished and the level is complete.

Load, Sort, and Grill
Ingredients move across structured lanes toward the grill area. Your task is to manage the flow, sort food pieces strategically, and guide them into their matching cooking slots.
You must:
• Sort identical food items
• Organize skewers and grilled ingredients
• Send the right pieces toward the correct grill section
• Complete all required positions
• Keep the grill board clear
When every required slot on the grill is filled with the correct ingredient, the BBQ dish is ready.
The goal is not just matching food — it’s placing each item into the correct cooking position before the grill becomes crowded.

Conveyor Belt–Inspired Gameplay Flow
Grill Fever: Food Sort is built around a conveyor-style movement system. Ingredients appear and travel across lanes, creating a constant flow toward the grill board.
This moving flow means you must think ahead:
• Anticipate upcoming ingredients
• Sequence your sorting decisions
• Avoid blocking key positions
• Maintain smooth ingredient movement
If ingredients stack incorrectly, space becomes limited. Managing the order of movement is key to completing each BBQ recipe.
The conveyor-inspired system creates a steady rhythm: sort, guide, place, and complete.

Complete BBQ Dishes Step by Step
Each level includes clear objectives displayed above the grill. You may need to place a certain number of skewers, sausages, or grilled items into designated sections.
To finish a level:
- Match and sort ingredients
- Direct them into the correct grill zones
- Fill every required position
- Complete the BBQ dish

As levels progress:
• Ingredient combinations increase
• Grill sections become more structured
• Sorting decisions become tighter
• The flow becomes faster
Strategic planning becomes essential as the grill board grows more complex.
The game is set in a beachside BBQ, where the grill becomes the heart of the puzzle.

Core Features
🔹 Food Sort puzzle mechanics
🔹 Conveyor belt–inspired ingredient flow
🔹 Match food and guide to correct grill slots
🔹 Clear BBQ dish objectives
🔹 Tap-based sorting interaction
🔹 Progressive level difficulty
Grill Fever: Food Sort centers on organizing ingredients efficiently and loading them into the correct cooking positions to complete each BBQ order.
Every level challenges how you manage ingredient flow, sequence your matches, and control the grill board space.
If you enjoy food sort puzzle games with structured objectives and conveyor-style movement, Grill Fever: Food Sort delivers a focused BBQ sorting experience where placement, timing, and flow control determine your success.

Cube Tap Sort is a fresh and addictive color sort puzzle game that will challenge your logic, focus, and strategy. Your mission: dismantle a vibrant 3D structure of colored blocks in the correct order. Sounds easy? Think again.

Each level presents a unique 3D layout of colorful blocks. At the top of the screen, active order boxes display specific colors. Your goal is simple:
• Tap blocks that match the color shown in an active box

tapping:

data.name: Sky Build
data.description_full:
Feel the thrill with Sky Build and test your reaction speed! 🏗️⚡ Your task is to fill all three slots with the same symbol before time runs out.

The slots with three symbols quickly and cyclically change icons 🔄 Tap on a slot to lock the current symbol and tapping again will unlock it, but it will cost you 2 seconds ⏳ Plan your actions carefully, because every second counts.

Once all three slots are locked, the result is checked 🎯 If the symbols match, you win! If not, the slots will automatically unlock, giving you a chance to try again. For the daring, there is a “build” button 🚀 that locks all slots at once — a risky but sometimes very profitable move.

When the time runs out, the symbols are fixed where they stopped ⏱️ If they are the same, you win; if they are different, the game is over. Each level has a different time limit and the first stages are a little easier to start with. Sky Build is all about speed, strategy and excitement in every round!

Are you ready for a high-speed runner game that tests your reflexes and mastery of physics? Download Going Balls today and experience the most thrilling arcade adventure on mobile! Join millions of players worldwide in this addictive hyper-casual hit.

How to Play:
Swipe your screen to control the speed and direction of your ball. Master the art of balance as you navigate narrow paths, dodge unexpected obstacles (challenge!), and collect coins to unlock new balls and environments.

* Customize Your Ball: Collect thousands of coins and unlock a massive collection of cool, colorful, and unique balls. Personalize your runner experience!
* Intuitive One-Finger Control: The ultimate pick-up-and-play hyper-casual design. Simple to learn, but incredibly hard to master - perfect for quick bursts of fun or long endless sessions.
* Tons of Obstacles: Avoid swinging hammers, tricky ramps, massive wrecking balls, and unexpected gaps. Your speed and precision are your only allies!

Going Balls is more than just a runner - it's an immensely satisfying experience. The rush of barely making a jump, the joy of collecting a huge stack of coins, and the feeling of accomplishment after conquering a nearly impossible challenge makes this game highly addictive.

data.name: Arrow Knot: Brain Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
Tap arrows. Unblock the grid. Untangle the knot.

Arrow Knot is a minimalist brain puzzle game where every level is a tangle of arrows waiting to be unraveled. Tap an arrow with a clear path and it slides off the board, unblocking lanes for the next move. Plan the sequence, keep every route open, and clear the whole grid to solve the puzzle.

— WHY PLAYERS LOVE ARROW KNOT —

Most puzzle games bury you in flashy effects and noise. Arrow Knot takes the opposite path: a clean grid, focused mechanics, and pure logic. Every level is a small tangle to unpick — a satisfying brain workout that fits into any moment of your day. If you love block puzzle games, tap away games, or unblock-style brain teasers, this arrow puzzle will feel instantly familiar.

— HOW TO PLAY —

Look at the grid. Each arrow points in one direction. Tap an arrow whose path to the edge is unobstructed — it slides off the board. That unblocks lanes for the remaining arrows. One wrong move can block everything, so plan the order carefully.

• Tap an arrow with a clear path to launch it off the grid
• Each removed arrow opens new routes for others
• Clear the entire board to complete the level
• Long-press for Guidance mode to preview available paths
• Use hints when the sequence gets tricky
• Wrong taps cost a heart — aim for perfect clears

Simple to learn. Deeply strategic to master.

— FEATURES —

Hundreds of Brain Puzzle Levels
Handcrafted arrow puzzles ranging from relaxing warm-ups to mind-bending tangles. New levels added regularly so the grid always has a fresh knot for you.

Timed Challenges
Race the clock through gorgeous themed pattern boards — every shape a puzzle you'll want to screenshot. Beat the timer to unlock the next design and climb the challenge ladder. Beautiful, tense, and endlessly replayable.

Clean & Focused Design
A distraction-free interface designed to reduce visual noise. Soft colors, smooth animations, and zero clutter let you focus entirely on the arrow puzzle in front of you.

Satisfying Tap-Away Feedback
Watch arrows whoosh off the board with responsive tap controls and clear path feedback. The final arrow leaving the grid delivers a deeply satisfying mental reset — like ASMR for puzzle solvers.

Guidance & Hints
Stuck on a knot? Long-press any arrow to preview its route, or spend a hint to reveal the next best move. No level is unsolvable.

Brain Training Benefits
Every session exercises spatial reasoning, sequential planning, and pattern recognition. Short bursts of arrow puzzle play sharpen focus and quiet a busy mind — cognitive fitness in bite-sized rounds.

— TWO WAYS TO PLAY —

Endless mode: solve at your own pace, no timer, pure logic puzzle flow.
Timed Challenges: race through beautiful themed pattern boards for a shot of adrenaline.

Pick the mood, pick the mode.

— PERFECT FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS —

Ten minutes before a meeting. A short metro ride. Winding down after a busy day. Arrow Knot fits naturally into the gaps of your day without demanding a 30-minute commitment.

— WHO IS IT FOR —

Arrow Knot is built for thoughtful players who love logic puzzles, brain teasers, and pattern games. If you enjoy Sudoku, nonograms, block puzzle games, slide puzzles, or tap away puzzles, this brain puzzle game will feel like home.

— KEY HIGHLIGHTS —

• Arrow puzzle: tap arrows to unblock and slide them off the grid
• Brain puzzle game with hundreds of logic levels

Angler Fisher is a game for true fishing enthusiasts who seek authenticity, realism, and the opportunity to hone their skills in a virtual world virtually indistinguishable from the real thing.

data.name: Guild of Monster Girls
data.description_full:
Guild of Monster Girls is a pixel-art idle RPG full of fun and tactical strategy. As the Guild Master, you can recruit over 100 cute monster girls, mix and match them for powerful team synergies, and create the perfect build for every girl with 1,000+ unique gear pieces. Pick your best team strategy and send them out to explore: skip the tedious grinding and enjoy pure tactical decision-making!

STRATEGIC SYNERGY: YOUR GIRLS, YOUR WAY

Your first 10-pull guarantees the fan-favorite Legendary "Holy Blade." From there, over 100 monster girls await: bubbly slimes, beast-ears, elven maidens, mischievous mimics, and plenty more. Every girl has her own personality, skills, and combat style.

TACTICAL IDLE: ADVENTURE ON YOUR TERMS

The game is designed for portrait play, featuring an auto-battle system that keeps your squad moving while you do other things. You can play one-handed on your commute, check in on your loot over lunch, or just let your girls grind through the night.

THEME YOUR BUILD: 1,000+ UNIQUE GEAR PIECES

Over 1,000 one-of-a-kind gear pieces are hidden across the continent. Mix and match equipment to unlock powerful combos, build specialized setups for each girl, or just hit auto-equip if you'd rather keep things simple.

A COZY STRATEGY JOURNEY AWAITS

The game blends collecting, management and combat with lighthearted strategy and cozy progression. Put your squad together, explore uncharted lands, and see everything this pixel fantasy world has to offer. Your guild is up and running, and the adventure is just getting started.
